Education for everyone, everywhere Whether you're constrained by location, cost, time, or other life commitments, we're passionate about giving you access to higher education that fits into your busy, modern life. You decide how and where to study We offer a wide range of flexible undergraduate and postgraduate degrees in both our online and blended study modes. Full support both online and on-site We're also proud to offer non-standard entry, meaning your work experience and previous qualifications are taken into account when assessing your application. Strong focus on employability You will gain in-depth subject knowledge and transferable skills that employers from a huge range of industries will value. Many of our courses at Arden are also accredited by leading professional bodies in the UK. Course Overview Arden University’s dual-accredited MSc Business Psychology is designed for graduates and industry professionals seeking expertise in occupational psychology. It equips you to meet the growing demand in both public and private sectors for professionals with business psychology skills, giving you the competitive advantage needed to fill industry gaps. What you’ll learn This course covers core areas of business and occupational psychology, providing a strong foundation in research, theory, and practice. You will gain the highly sought-after ability to improve business operations at the individual, team, and organisational levels, and to tackle contemporary business issues such as improving employee well-being and performance and managing organisational change. You’ll graduate from the course with the key practitioner skills needed to strategically apply psychology in your current or future roles. Graduate career avenues Registered Occupational Psychologist This course is accredited by the British Psychological Society (BPS) and fulfils Stage One of the two-stage process to becoming a registered Occupational Psychologist with the Health and Care Professions Council (HCPC). After completing this programme, you would progress to Stage Two, which involves a period of supervised practice under an approved supervisor. To follow this route, you will also need to achieve Graduate Basis for Chartership (GBC). More information is available on the BPS website. Certified Business Psychologist (ABP accreditation) The course is accredited by the Association for Business Psychology (ABP), meaning graduates can leverage the ABP Certified Business Psychologist designation. This certification offers ABP members a pathway to attain 'Business Psychologist' status. More information can be found on the ABP website. Alternative career pathways Graduates with business psychology skills are in high demand across various organisations, with opportunities in areas such as employee well-being, leadership development, recruitment and selection, consultancy, and, with appropriate training, psychometric test administration and interpretation. Our programme equips you with a versatile skill set that opens doors to a wide range of career prospects. Our expert team Our School of Psychology consists of practitioners and academics with awards, publications, and industry experience spanning consultancy, coaching, well-being, knowledge transfer, neurodiversity, and assessment design and delivery. This means you’ll gain unique insights into both the academic and practitioner aspects of business psychology. We also collaborate with external practitioners, including occupational and coaching psychologists and consultants to align the programme with contemporary standards and practices. Accreditation and Memberships ABP Accredited Upon graduation, you will be awarded an ABP-accredited MSc, which allows a fast-track route to Certified Business Psychologist status. Accreditation with the ABP also gives you free student membership. BPS Accredited Upon graduation, you will be awarded a BPS-accredited MSc, which fulfils Stage One of the two-stage process to becoming a registered Occupational Psychologist. Quick tools Explore your brochure Download the course brochure to take a look at your course modules and syllabus content. Download brochure Speak to an advisor Want to speak to one of our subject experts? Our advisors are ready to answer your questions! Click below to get started. Show me how Professional accreditation This course is accredited by the Association for Business psychology (ABP) and the British Psychological Society (BPS). Learn more Course details and modules Within each module, you will explore the business world to develop a critical understanding of organisational issues, ethical considerations, and future research directions. We'll delve into contemporary psychology trends in the workplace, covering assessments, development, leadership, and organisational culture. You'll learn essential practitioner skills, such as the consultancy cycle, report writing, and finding relevant information. We’ll highlight the importance of psychological assessments, which facilitate objective comparisons, identify training needs, and support individual and organisational growth – crucial in today's business landscape focused on talent attraction, management, and diversity. Just some of the fascinating modules you’ll study on this course include: Coaching & Mentoring Examine unique coaching theories and models, including challenges and ethical considerations. Gain practical insights through optional coaching activities, providing a taste of coaching’s benefits and the opportunity to be a ‘coach for a day’ under guided supervision. Leadership, Motivation & Engagement Explore effective leadership and the role of business psychologists in developing strategic leaders who foster engaged and motivated teams. Topics include the impact of evolving work environments, promoting inclusive workplace cultures, and managing diverse global teams. Health and Well-Being at Work Consider the business case for employee well-being, addressing common workplace concerns like stress and physical inactivity. Gain current knowledge on approaches and factors related to workplace well-being and interventions targeting well-being at individual, team, leadership, and organisational levels. Arden is for winners. Nobody will beg you to sit down and start working on your career, if you don’t do it yourself! At Arden, if you have an honest interest for what you learn and you want to reach out for more, you will be welcomed, helped, and advised. But to do that, you must be determined. Bettina Finna BSc (Hons) Psychology Course Modules Psychological Assessment at Work (20 credits) Core Research Methods (20 credits) Learning, Training & Development (20 credits) Coaching & Mentoring (20 credits) Leadership, Motivation & Engagement (20 credits) Health and Well-being at Work (20 credits) Work Design, Organisational Change and Development (20 credits) Business Psychology Research Project (40 credits) Study options This course is currently available to students as a fully online programme, which gives you the convenience of being able to study from anywhere worldwide. I chose online learning because I do not currently have the capacity to attend classes as my days are full with running my household, my elderly parents’ household and tending to the needs of my 3-year-old. Online studying has been extremely helpful because it provides the flexibility I need in order to study at random times during the day or night. Cynthia Blow BSc (Hons) Psychology Part-time online learning How does it work? Studying the MSc Business Psychology online gives you the ultimate in convenience. You can enrol with Arden from anywhere in the world and study your degree from the comfort of home, without the requirement to attend classes in a physical location. Our online students study their degree through ilearn, Arden’s university campus in the cloud.  ilearn provides everything you need to study at University. It offers an integrated virtual learning experience, including your virtual classroom, lecture theatre, and access to our Library Portal. The portal includes an extensive digital library including thousands of journal titles, eBooks, and academic and industry databases which you can use to research your assignments and projects. All of these materials are provided to you free of charge, and contain all the research information you’ll need to complete your degree with us. Studying online doesn’t mean studying alone. As well as receiving regular feedback and guidance from your course tutor, you’ll be studying with like-minded students who you can meet with through our Unitu community, and you’ll have access to community message boards to discuss your course and the topics being raised within it. We’ve even set up community boards embedded into each of the course modules so you can have discussions with your tutor and classmates on the topics you’re currently learning. Online learning students resident in the UK can apply for a Maintenance Loan if they cannot attend their course in person because of a disability. Please find more information on our fees and funding page. If you're a student from Scotland, Wales or Northern Ireland you can find information on Living Cost Loans from your student finance body. Learn more about online learning Introducing your Digital Backpack Once you’ve enrolled on your MSc Business Psychology degree with Arden you’ll get access to your Digital Backpack, a toolkit of digital resources we’ve put together to help you succeed during your time studying with us. Here are some of the digital resources you’ll have available throughout your course: Office 365 subscription Integrated zoom video conferencing Careers support available through Arden Futures, your careers platform, to help you throughout your career journey whether you are a Career Starter, Changer or Developer Free online access to our Library Portal, which includes thousands of eBooks and journals, as well as industry databases which we’ve carefully hand-picked to support your studies – all yours for free while you study with us Subscription to Togetherall for an abundance of mental health support Entry requirements At Arden University we consider applications on a case by case basis. If you have significant work experience, have qualifications you have gained elsewhere, or a degree or qualification that isn't a clear pathway to this degree - we are more than happy to discuss your application. Eligibility To be eligible for our MSc Business Psychology, you should normally have: A UK Honours Degree at a minimum of second class (2.2) or equivalent, that is related to the field of psychology, social science or business (if you want to progress to the BPS Qualification in Occupational Psychology (Stage 2), this needs to be a BPS-accredited undergraduate degree in Psychology which provides Graduate Basis for Chartership (GBC)) In the absence of a UK Honours Degree, extensive professional work experience that is relevant to business psychology will be considered on a case-by-case basis A maths qualification or equivalent to at least Grade C at GCSE. In the absence of evidence of a GCSE or equivalent in mathematics applicants will be able to complete an assessment-free module before the start of the course to substitute for this. English proficiency IELTS 6.5 (no less than 6.0 in any element); or TOEFL iBT 90; or equivalent. Alternatively, evidence you have previously studied in English, such as a letter to show that the Medium of Instruction was in English can be accepted. Course fees and funding Funding and Scholarships We also offer a range of scholarships and funding support for eligible students, including options for UK, international, and UK-based international students. Start your application and an education advisor will be in touch to discuss your options. Refer a Friend When you help a friend or family member to study with Arden through our Refer a Friend programme, both you and the person you refer will receive a £500 Amazon e-voucher or £500 tuition fee credit. Meet the faculty The Faculty of Social Sciences and Technology is currently overseen by Professor Brian Smith, Deputy Provost. Bringing more than three decades of experience, Brian has been awarded the prestigious Higher Education Academy National Teaching Fellow for excellence in developing inspiring and innovative new learning and teaching models in global higher education. This work was core to his PhD to understand learner behaviour and ontological needs in the classroom, blended and online learning. He carries a wealth of experience and has touched a variety of disciplines – including healthcare, psychology, technology, law and engineering, to name a few. He also holds the title of Advance HE Principal Fellow, and Accreditor status for reviewing fellowships. Brian has contributed to several initiatives in his career, some of which has included authoring End point Assessments for Apprenticeships (Institute for Apprenticeships), Micro-credential characteristics (Quality Assurance Agency), TEF 2023 panel member (Office for Students), editor reviewer for journals, and authoring publications such as Creativity: An unsolved enigma. Professor Brian Smith Deputy Provost Career prospects The course will help you develop your existing skills and knowledge in business psychology, alongside the latest theoretical, practical, and emerging advancements in the field. Through this, you’ll gain the expertise needed to successfully apply business psychology across a range of exciting industries. Related courses MSc Psychology BSc (Hons) Psychology with Counselling BSc (Hons) Psychology Related articles Psychology articles Career Advice What will the MSc Business Psychology do for me? You’ll graduate from the course with the hands-on business psychology and leadership skills required to effectively bring about positive change in the workplace across individual, team, and organisational levels. Throughout your studies you’ll be provided with the valuable opportunity to: Gain in-depth knowledge of business and occupational psychology in a variety of industries. Understand the important and strategic role psychology plays in the workplace. Develop practical skills in applying appropriate psychological interventions at the individual, team, and organisational levels. Gain transferable skills for a range of exciting roles in both the public and private sectors. What can I do after Arden University? Employers today recognise the strategic advantage of having employees who are versed in applying psychology in the workplace, meaning you’ll graduate from your MSc Business Psychology degree ready to accelerate your career in the field. A few of the roles you might consider include: Registered Occupational Psychologist (after completing the BPS Qualification in Occupational Psychology (Stage 2)). Business Psychologist Employee or Leader Coach/Mentor Workplace Assessment/Training Recruitment and Selection Business Consultancy Business Manager HR Industry skills This course is accredited by the the Association for Business Psychology (ABP) and the British Psychological Society (BPS). The British Psychological Society The British Psychological Society (BPS) is the representative body for psychology and psychologists in the UK. The society is responsible for the development, promotion, and application of psychology for the public good. While you’re studying this course with us, we’ll cover the cost of your student membership with the BPS, which gives you access to a large range of useful resources including access to the British Psychological Society Library, the UK’s leading national resource in psychology. The Association for Business Psychology (ABP) The Association for Business Psychology (ABP) works to provide information, training, and support for those interested in business psychology, to promote professional excellence, and to demonstrate the effective application and impact of business psychology in the workplace. During your studies you’ll have free student membership with the ABP, giving you access to a wealth of professional resources, networking opportunities, careers advice, professional recognition and influence, as well as keeping you up-to-date with current trends and developments. Campaign for Social Science Arden University is a member of the Campaign for Social Science. The Campaign demonstrates how social science improves public policy, society, and all our lives. It highlights the value of applied social science research and advocates for its greater use in decision-making and in government. It is supported by a coalition of universities, social science societies, and publishers. As a member, Arden receives access to case studies, research into the value provided by social sciences, and insights into the employability of social science graduates. Through this, you will gain a better understanding of the skills you are learning and their value to employers. Education for everyone, everywhere Whether you're constrained by location, cost, time, or other life commitments, we're passionate about giving you access to higher education that fits into your busy, modern life. You decide how and where to study We offer a wide range of flexible undergraduate and postgraduate degrees in both our online and blended study modes. Full support both online and on-site We're also proud to offer non-standard entry, meaning your work experience and previous qualifications are taken into account when assessing your application. Strong focus on employability You will gain in-depth subject knowledge and transferable skills that employers from a huge range of industries will value. Many of our courses at Arden are also accredited by leading professional bodies in the UK. Course Overview Are you ready to accelerate your career in one of the most in-demand and financially rewarding fields today? Arden University's MSc Cyber Security programme is aligned with the NCSC academic framework and equips you with the skills necessary to thrive in highly lucrative cyber security roles. In recent studies, 57% of businesses said they currently have unfilled cyber security positions* , and 1.8 million jobs in the field went unfilled in 2022 alone**. With such huge skills gaps and a burgeoning demand for cyber experts across the globe, this course will arm you with the knowledge you need to excel as an expert in cyber security across almost limitless industries. What you'll learn Our programme goes deep into cyber security, covering everything from understanding core concepts and standards to identifying vulnerabilities and risks within modern networks and infrastructures. You'll gain the expertise to design secure systems, making them resilient against potential attacks. We'll also teach you the technical skills needed to become an ethical hacker and proactive security tester, as well as how to perform digital forensics and incident management. Additionally, you'll explore cloud, web, and mobile security concepts, becoming adept at recognising critical threats. We emphasise hands-on learning, allowing you to apply essential security techniques to test and protect against real-world attacks and recommend improvements. Beyond the basics Our commitment to your success goes beyond the classroom. Arden University offers access to industry-leading resources and certifications, such as Microsoft Security, Compliance, and Identity Fundamentals and Microsoft Azure Security Technologies. We cover the costs of these resources, so you only pay for your exams in many cases, making your degree great value for money. Arden University is a Cisco Network Academy, providing you with access to free Cisco resources. You can self-study for Cisco courses and receive badges in key areas such as networking, Python and Linux that you can add to your CV. Arden is also an AWS Academy, so you’ll gain access to further free course content to complement your degree. Award-Winning Cyber Security Programme Arden University stands among the world’s leading cybersecurity education providers, having received the 2025 EC Council Academia Circle of Excellence Award, a global mark of quality awarded to only a small number of institutions each year. Chosen from thousands of academic partners, this recognition showcases our dedication to innovative teaching, practical learning experiences, and strong certification outcomes. This means that by joining Arden you’ll study at a university that meets the highest international standards and is focused on preparing graduates for impactful careers in the rapidly growing cybersecurity sector. * Future of the Cybersecurity Job Market 2022 ** The Cybersecurity Skills Gap Won't Be Solved in a Classroom Why choose Arden Video • 1 min Accreditation and Memberships Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH) This certification is a comprehensive programme that trains individuals in ethical hacking and penetration testing techniques. Cisco Networking Academy Arden University is a Cisco Network Academy. On our MSc Cyber Security, you’ll receive Cisco resources so you can self-study and add many of the Cisco networking, cyber, coding, and OSes digital badges to your CV. Quick tools Explore your brochure Download the course brochure to take a look at your course modules and syllabus content. Download brochure Speak to an advisor Want to speak to one of our subject experts? Our advisors are ready to answer your questions! Click below to get started. Show me how Added industry skills Add to your skills with access to certified courses from Salesforce, Cisco, and Amazon. Find out how Course details and modules Our MSc Cyber Security course delivers exciting and up-to-date module content that guarantees you’ll develop essential workplace skills. Just a few course highlights embedded into your modules include: Building networks: Gain hands-on experience using Cisco IOS simulation software to design secure networks. You'll configure devices like firewalls, switches, and routers, ensuring network safety. Learn ethical hacking: Master ethical hacking with industry-standard tools like MITRE ATT&CK, Cyber Kill Chain, and Metasploit. Master digital forensics: Learn professional digital forensics and incident management skills, including evidence acquisition and analysis using industry-standard tools. Maintain ethical and legal standards during investigations. Find and mitigate risk from vulnerabilities: Explore common cyber security vulnerabilities and apply mitigations using OWASP Top 10 guidelines. Meeting the tutors and students online and then having the opportunity to meet again in person is such an incredible experience. The courses are well explicated and the tutors are great. Classes are engaging and students are supportive of each other. I’m proud to be an Arden student and I would certainly recommend this course to others. Youssef Yehya MSc Strategic Digital Marketing - Berlin Campus The global demand for cybersecurity professionals is surging, highlighting a critical shortage in skilled talent worldwide. Similarly, in the UK, businesses are grappling with significant cybersecurity skills gaps, emphasising the urgent need for qualified professionals to address evolving threats. Global skills gap: The global cyber security market was estimated at $222.66 billion in 2023 and is projected to grow at a compound annual growth rate of 12.3% until 2030. Cyber Security Market Size & Trends Global cybersecurity job vacancies grew 350% between 2013-2021, from 1 million openings to 3.5 million. The number of unfilled jobs remained at 3.5 million in 2023, but the disparity between demand and supply is predicted to persist through at least 2025. Cybersecurity Jobs Report: 3.5 Million Unfilled Positions In 2025 In 2023, research found that the global workforce grew to an all-time high of 5.5 million, an increase of 8.7% and 440,000 jobs compared to 2022. ISC2 Cybersecurity Workforce Study: Looking Deeper into the Workforce Gap UK skills gap: 50% of all UK businesses have a basic cybersecurity skills gap and 33% face advanced skills gaps. There were 160,035 cyber security job postings last year, marking a 30% increase from the previous year. 37% of vacancies were reported as hard-to-fill. An estimated 11,200 more professionals are needed to meet the demand in the cybersecurity workforce. Cyber security skills in the UK labour market 2023 Course Modules Information Security Management (20 credits) Network Security (20 credits) Secure System Design (20 credits) Offensive Security (20 credits) Cloud and Web Services Security (20 credits) Digital Forensics and Incident Management (20 credits) Advanced Computing Project (60 credits) For full details on your module content, click here to download the brochure . A modern assessment strategy This programme has been designed to ensure you undertake a range of practical and authentic assessments. These assessments will be portfolio-based, where you will submit real-world portfolio assets which you have created as a component of each course module using industry-standard tools and practices. This means that by the end of your degree, you’ll have a professional portfolio demonstrating your cyber security knowledge and skills which you can use to provide evidence of your advanced capabilities to employers. Other features of our assessment methodologies include: Practice-driven Your course assessments will be practice-driven, mirroring real-world practitioner skills to ensure that you graduate from your course ready to take on future challenges in cyber security with confidence. The Advanced Computing Project You’ll conclude your degree with your Advanced Computing Project. Here, you'll dive into a hands-on journey, solving real-world computing problems through research, design, and creation. You’ll be allocated a supervisor within your chosen topic area to support you through the project process and in the development of your project proposal – helping you emerge not just with a degree, but with practical industry-ready abilities to demonstrate to employers. Additional study skills through vendor programmes, provided free of charge The following vendor courses will be available for you to study in parallel with your degree. All the material on these programmes is completely free, giving you incredible savings and value for money. You will only need to pay for the final exams if you should choose to take them. Microsoft Security, Compliance, and Identity Fundamentals (SC-900) Digital badge with the option to pay for an exam to gain certification Microsoft Azure Security Technologies (AZ-500T00) Digital badge with the option to pay for an exam to gain certification EC Council CEH (ethical hacking) Arden covers the exam cost. Students will only need to pay an administration fee to take it. Multiple Cisco self-study courses Free Digital badges to study Self-study courses with free course content with the option to pay for exams Other additional learning resources you’ll have include: Access to EC Council CEH content, which includes e-books, labs, videos, and the opportunity to take a certification exam. Access to Cisco Packet Tracer, where you can build networks by configuring switches, routers, and firewalls, helping you advance your skills in a practical nature. Hands-on experience with cutting-edge virtual labs EC Council CEH – The supplementary EC Council CEH (ethical hacking) programme is integrated into the MSc syllabus through the Offensive Security and Cloud and Web Services Security modules. You'll also have access to the CEH content for self-study if you choose to take the exam, as well as the following industry-standard skills and tools: Open source/footprinting and scanning tools such as Melegor, Metasploit, Nmap Proxy and enumeration tools such as BurpSuite, Tor, Dig, NFS, SNMP Vulnerability analysis and exploitation tools such as CVSS, Nessus, OpenVas, John the Ripper, Hashcat, PSExec Anti-rootkit and malware generator tools such as Stinger, Divergent, Powershell Sniffers, DDOs, and session hijacking tools such as Wireshark, Cain & Abel, TCP Dump, HULK, OWASP ZAP, sslstrip IDS, anonymisers, and honeypot tools such as Snort, Boomproxy, SPECTOR Wireless, mobile, and IoT tools such as Air Suite, Agent Smith Attack, IoTSeeker Web and cloud tools such as ZAP, Burp AWS pwn, Sysdig Digital forensic tools such as Autopsy, FTK Imager, RegRipper, CAINE TryHackME - Students gain access to TryHackMe, a leading online platform for hands-on cyber security training. This provides a range of benefits designed to enhance your learning experience and help you build real-world skills: Secure Virtual Environment: Practice your skills in a safe, legal, and ethical online environment without needing to install software on your personal devices. Real-World Simulations: Engage in over 750+ labs covering both offensive and defensive security, from beginner to expert level, allowing you to experience realistic cyber security scenarios. Gamified Learning: Make learning interactive and fun with bite-sized lessons and challenges that earn you points, badges, and a spot on global leaderboards. Flexible Access: Study anytime, anywhere with web-based labs that are accessible from any device, making it perfect for distance learners. Custom Learning Paths: Follow tailored learning paths that align with your career goals or focus on specific skills, with the flexibility to explore individual topics at your own pace. Community and Collaboration: Join a global community of over 3 million users, where you can share knowledge, compete in challenges, and collaborate on Capture The Flag exercises. Continuous Access: After completing your studies, maintain your TryHackMe account to access free content or opt for a subscription to continue your professional development. Study options This course is available to study full-time at our campus in Berlin, Germany, or through our blended learning study mode in London Stratford and Manchester. The course is also available to students via online learning . This gives you the convenience of being able to study worldwide, providing you with the same high standards of teaching but with lower tuition fees. Part-time online learning How does it work? Studying this course online gives you the ultimate in convenience. You can enrol with Arden from anywhere in the world and study your degree from the comfort of home, without the requirement to attend classes in a physical location. Our online students study their degree through ilearn, Arden’s university campus in the cloud. ilearn provides everything you need to study at university. It offers an integrated virtual learning experience, including your virtual classroom, lecture theatre, and access to our Library Portal. The portal includes an extensive digital library including thousands of journal titles, eBooks, and academic and industry databases which you can use to research your assignments and projects. All of these materials are provided to you free of charge, and contain all the research information you’ll need to complete your degree with us. ilearn is also integrated with Zoom, making it easier to chat with your course tutor during your scheduled seminar sessions. You can even integrate our study materials into your Kindle, making it possible to study wherever you have your Kindle handy. Studying online doesn’t mean studying alone. As well as receiving regular feedback and guidance from your course tutor, you’ll be studying with like-minded students who you can meet with through our Unitu community, and you’ll have access to community message boards to discuss your course and the topics being raised within it. We’ve even set up community boards embedded into each of the course modules so you can have discussions with your tutor and classmates on the topics you’re currently learning. Online learning students resident in the UK can apply for a Maintenance Loan if they cannot attend their course in person because of a disability. Please find more information on our fees and funding page. If you're a student from Scotland, Wales, or Northern Ireland you can find information on Living Cost Loans from your student finance body. Full time, blended learning How does it work? Our blended learning study mode combines structured in-person learning with the flexibility of guided independent study. You’ll attend eight hours of timetabled, face-to-face classes each week, spread over two days at your chosen Arden University campus. Alongside this, you’ll spend approximately 25 hours each week on independent study. You’ll use iLearn, our digital learning platform, to access key resources, submit assignments, and stay connected with your tutors and classmates. Whether you prefer studying in our on-campus learning spaces or at home, you’ll be supported throughout your journey. Blended learning is ideal if you value regular in-person teaching and want the flexibility to balance your studies with other commitments. With classes concentrated over just two days, you’ll have more control over your time, while still benefiting from face-to-face interaction and access to university facilities. This course is also available to study full-time at our Berlin, Germany campus. Learn more about Blended Learning Entry requirements At Arden University we consider applications on a case by case basis. If you have significant work experience, have qualifications you have gained elsewhere, or a degree or qualification that isn't a clear pathway to this degree - we are more than happy to discuss your application. Standard entry requirements: A 2.2 Honours degree in a computing-related subject, or an equivalent 2.2 Honours degree with 18 months of relevant computing work experience. Typical non-standard entry requirements: A minimum of 3 years of relevant computing work experience. Your work experience should be in a computing or IT role. English proficiency Online Learning: IELTS 6.5 (no less than 6.0 in any element); or TOEFL iBT 90; or equivalent Blended Learning in the UK or full-time study in Berlin: IELTS 6.0 (no less than 5.5 in any element); or TOEFL iBT 60-78; or equivalent. Free English language support is also available at the Arden Berlin campus. Alternatively, evidence you have previously studied in English; a letter to show that the Medium of Instruction was in English can be accepted If you require a visa to study in the UK You must meet the academic entry requirements for this course. You’ll need an IELTS score of 6.0 (with no less than 5.5 in any element) or an equivalent Secure English Language Test (SELT) result. Meet the faculty Dr Steve Johnston joined Arden University in November 2025 as the new Associate Dean of the Faculty of Social Sciences and Technology. Steve holds an undergraduate degree in Astrophysics and Psychology from Keele University and earned a PhD at the Centre for Applied Mathematics and Computation (CAMAC) in Coventry in 2002. After early experience developing software for a 3D scanning firm, Steve transitioned to academia, focusing on brain imaging research at Bangor University. Following this, Steve lectured in Psychology at Brunel University before joining Swansea University in 2012 as Senior Lecturer. He became Associate Dean for the Faculty of Medicine, Health and Life Science in 2021 where he led the delivery of traditional and professional healthcare programmes, drove curriculum innovation, and implemented enhancement strategies informed by data-driven insights. He is a Fellow of the Higher Education Academy. Steve Johnston Acting Head of School – School of Applied Technology and AI Career prospects 100% of our Masters students studying a computing subject are employed within 2 years of graduation* *Source: 2020/21 Graduate Outcomes Survey Right now, careers in cyber security are positively thriving, driven by the relentless surge in cyber threats which businesses and organisations face. This demand has led to very competitive salaries, often surpassing those of other comparable professions. Career advice Data analytics articles related courses MSc Data Science What will the MSc Cyber Security do for me? Studying Arden University's MSc Cyber Security programme offers you a transformative opportunity to advance your career in a highly lucrative area of employment. In our era of escalating cyber threats and high demand for experts in the field, this degree guarantees you’ll learn cutting-edge knowledge and hands-on skills. With additional free access to industry certifications, practical experience, and alignment with industry standards, enrolling on the course paves the way for a successful future. Other key benefits for you include: Arden University has a diverse workforce, and your studies will be supported by a department of committed and enthusiastic senior lecturers and lecturers who are experts in their chosen fields and draw upon a wealth of academic and industry experience. In addition, many of our academic staff are members of professional and regulatory bodies. NCSC alignment: Our programme content aligns with the National Cyber Security Centre (NCSC), ensuring you learn the most up-to-date and relevant skills. Additional certifications: We offer access to a choice of certifications and badges through industry-leading organisations. This enhances your career prospects and opens doors to exciting opportunities. Free vendor courses: Gain technical skills through free vendor courses like Microsoft Certified: Security, Compliance, and Identity Fundamentals, listed among Forbes' 8 best Cyber Security Certifications for 2023. All the course content is completely free to our students, you’ll only have to pay for the exam. Cisco badges: Earn a series of Cisco badges such as in Linux and Python for free, further enhancing your expertise and employability. What can I do after Arden University? The modules you will study on this course each give you the underpinning you need to pursue or develop a well-paid and future-proof career in almost any field within cyber security. Here’s a breakdown: Information Security Management module Future careers: Cyber Risk Manager, Cyber Risk Analyst, Cyber Research Analyst, Cyber Incident Manager, or Information Security Manager. Networks Security module Future careers: Cyber Risk Manager, Cyber Risk Analyst, Cyber Research Analyst, Cyber Incident Manager, Cyber Security Engineer, or Cyber Security Design Engineer. Cloud and Web Services Security module Future careers: Web Application Security Analyst, Web Application Tester, Security Operation Centre (SOC) Analyst, or Solution Architects. Digital Forensics and Incident Management module Future careers: Cyber Risk Manager, Cyber Risk Analyst, Cyber Research Analyst, Cyber Incident Manager, Cyber Security Engineer, or Cyber Security Design. Offensive Security module Future careers: Penetration Tester, Information Security Coordinator, Network Security Pen Tester, Web Application Pen Tester, Cyber Risk Manager, Cyber Risk Analyst, or Cyber Research Analyst. Secure System Design module Future careers: IT Security Consultant, Security Architect, Systems Administrator, or Information Security Analyst. Our Masters students studying a computing subject have gone onto earn up to £90,000 within 2 years of graduation* *Source: 2020/21 Graduate Outcomes Survey Industry skills EC Council Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH) This certification is a comprehensive programme that trains individuals in ethical hacking and penetration testing techniques. It covers topics such as network security, vulnerability assessment, and countermeasures, enabling professionals to identify and address security vulnerabilities. CEH is highly respected in the cyber security industry, making it a sought-after credential for ethical hackers and security experts. Arden provides the course content free of charge and will cover the cost of the CEH exam. Students will only need to pay an administration fee. NCSC alignment Our programme content aligns with the National Cyber Security Centre (NCSC), ensuring you learn the most up-to-date and relevant skills. The course has been aligned to the NCSC accreditation framework, which consists of the following five security disciplines: Human, Organisation and Regulatory, Attack & Defence, System Security, Software Security, and Infrastructure Security.  Indicative topic coverage of the knowledge areas within these disciplines has been integrated into the modules and will be included as key content on the programme. Arden students will receive the course content to select Microsoft Learn courses for free and only need to pay for the exam. These include: Microsoft Security, Compliance, and Identity Fundamentals (SC-900) An introductory course designed to provide essential knowledge about Microsoft's security and compliance solutions. It covers key concepts, including threat protection, identity management, and information protection, enabling learners to understand and navigate Microsoft's robust security ecosystem. This certification is a foundational step for those looking to pursue a career in Microsoft's security and compliance domain. Microsoft Azure Security Technologies (AZ-500T00) An advanced-level course focusing on security solutions within the Azure cloud platform. It equips learners with the skills to implement security controls, detect and respond to security threats, and protect data and applications on Azure. AZ-500T00 is essential for professionals seeking expertise in Azure security. Cisco Network Academy Cisco offers a range of cyber security training courses, equipping professionals with skills vital for safeguarding networks and data. Arden University is a Cisco Network Academy. On our MSc Cyber Security, you’ll receive Cisco resources so you can self-study and add many of the Cisco networking, cyber, coding, and OSes digital badges to your CV. All these resources, which can cost upwards of thousands of pounds, are completely free for Arden students. Education for everyone, everywhere Whether you're constrained by location, cost, time, or other life commitments, we're passionate about giving you access to higher education that fits into your busy, modern life. You decide how and where to study We offer a wide range of flexible undergraduate and postgraduate degrees in both our online and blended study modes. Full support both online and on-site We're also proud to offer non-standard entry, meaning your work experience and previous qualifications are taken into account when assessing your application. Strong focus on employability You will gain in-depth subject knowledge and transferable skills that employers from a huge range of industries will value. Many of our courses at Arden are also accredited by leading professional bodies in the UK. Course Overview Are you ready to launch or accelerate your career in data science and AI? The demand for qualified data scientists far exceeds the current supply, and the industry faces a significant global skills gap. Our online MSc Data Science programme is designed to bridge this gap by providing you with the relevant practical skills and expertise needed to excel in data-related roles, giving you a pathway to establishing a fulfilling and potentially lucrative career. What you'll learn Our data science degree covers everything from fundamental mathematical concepts to advanced topics like artificial intelligence, machine learning, deep learning, and cloud computing. You'll master essential tools and programming languages such as Python, in addition to gaining proficiency in software tools like Jupyter Notebooks and Tableau. You’ll also tackle real-world scenarios through our programme's individual modules. Whether you're exploring the ethical and legal constraints of data science or delving into the intricacies of machine learning and deep learning, you'll be immersed in practical applications. Our "Learn by Doing" philosophy ensures you can apply your knowledge to make meaningful business decisions using real data sets. Ultimately, you'll gain genuine insight into how data science operates, from data gathering and processing to analysis for operational and strategic purposes -- developing a strong understanding of the ethical and legal considerations that shape the role of data science professionals. High earning potential Right now, data scientists are in high demand, commanding competitive salaries. With a few years of experience, you can expect to earn between £40,000 and £60,000. For those who rise to lead or chief data scientist positions, salaries can exceed £100,000 [Prospects: Data Scientist job profile ]. Study support and assessments A practical assessment strategy Our MSc Data Science programme adopts a modern assessment approach designed to immerse you in practical, real-world challenges. Assessment methods include portfolio submissions featuring tangible assets created during each course module using industry-standard tools. By the programme’s end, you'll have a professional portfolio demonstrating your data science expertise, providing compelling evidence of your skills. This gives you the convenience of being able to study worldwide, providing you with the same high standards of teaching but with lower tuition fees. Part-time online learning How does it work? Studying this course online gives you the ultimate in convenience. You can enrol with Arden from anywhere in the world and study your degree from the comfort of home, without the requirement to attend classes in a physical location. Our online students study their degree through ilearn, Arden’s university campus in the cloud. ilearn provides everything you need to study at university. It offers an integrated virtual learning experience, including your virtual classroom, lecture theatre, and access to our Library Portal. The portal includes an extensive digital library including thousands of journal titles, eBooks, and academic and industry databases which you can use to research your assignments and projects. All of these materials are provided to you free of charge, and contain all the research information you’ll need to complete your degree with us. ilearn is also integrated with Zoom, making it easier to chat with your course tutor during your scheduled seminar sessions. You can even integrate our study materials into your Kindle, making it possible to study wherever you have your Kindle handy. Studying online doesn’t mean studying alone. As well as receiving regular feedback and guidance from your course tutor, you’ll be studying with like-minded students who you can meet with through our Unitu community, and you’ll have access to community message boards to discuss your course and the topics being raised within it. We’ve even set up community boards embedded into each of the course modules so you can have discussions with your tutor and classmates on the topics you’re currently learning. Online learning students resident in the UK can apply for a Maintenance Loan if they cannot attend their course in person because of a disability. Please find more information on our fees and funding page. If you're a student from Scotland, Wales, or Northern Ireland you can find information on Living Cost Loans from your student finance body. Full time blended learning How does it work? Our blended learning study mode combines structured in-person learning with the flexibility of guided independent study. You’ll attend eight hours of timetabled, face-to-face classes each week, spread over two days at your chosen Arden University campus. Alongside this, you’ll spend approximately 25 hours each week on independent study. You’ll use iLearn, our digital learning platform, to access key resources, submit assignments, and stay connected with your tutors and classmates. Whether you prefer studying in our on-campus learning spaces or at home, you’ll be supported throughout your journey. Blended learning is ideal if you value regular in-person teaching and want the flexibility to balance your studies with other commitments. With classes concentrated over just two days, you’ll have more control over your time, while still benefiting from face-to-face interaction and access to university facilities. This course is also available to study full-time at our Berlin, Germany campus. Subscription to Togetherall for an abundance of mental health support Entry requirements At Arden University we consider applications on a case by case basis. If you have significant work experience, have qualifications you have gained elsewhere, or a degree or qualification that isn't a clear pathway to this degree - we are more than happy to discuss your application. Standard entry requirements: A 2.2 Honours degree in a numerate subject where many of the modules were mathematics-based. Examples include, but are not limited to maths, finance, computing, science, and engineering. Or an equivalent 2.2 Honours degree with 18 months of relevant computing work experience. Typical non-standard entry requirements: A minimum of 3 years of relevant work experience. Your work experience should be in a data-based role, for example, finance, engineering, science, data analysis, etc. You will need to have worked with maths and/or data analysis in your current role to be eligible. English proficiency Online Learning: IELTS 6.5 (no less than 6.0 in any element); or TOEFL iBT 90; or equivalent Blended Learning in the UK or full-time study in Berlin: IELTS 6.0 (no less than 5.5 in any element); or TOEFL iBT 60-78; or equivalent. Free English language support is also available at the Arden Berlin campus. Alternatively, evidence you have previously studied in English; a letter to show that the Medium of Instruction was in English can be accepted If you require a visa to study in the UK You must meet the academic entry requirements for this course. You’ll need an IELTS score of 6.0 (with no less than 5.5 in any element) or an equivalent Secure English Language Test (SELT) result. Meet the faculty Dr Steve Johnston joined Arden University in November 2025 as the new Associate Dean of the Faculty of Social Sciences and Technology. Steve holds an undergraduate degree in Astrophysics and Psychology from Keele University and earned a PhD at the Centre for Applied Mathematics and Computation (CAMAC) in Coventry in 2002. After early experience developing software for a 3D scanning firm, Steve transitioned to academia, focusing on brain imaging research at Bangor University. Following this, Steve lectured in Psychology at Brunel University before joining Swansea University in 2012 as Senior Lecturer. He became Associate Dean for the Faculty of Medicine, Health and Life Science in 2021 where he led the delivery of traditional and professional healthcare programmes, drove curriculum innovation, and implemented enhancement strategies informed by data-driven insights. He is a Fellow of the Higher Education Academy. Steve Johnston Acting Head of School – School of Applied Technology and AI Career prospects 100% of our Masters students studying a computing subject are employed within 2 years of graduation* *Source: 2020/21 Graduate Outcomes Survey Right now, careers in data science are positively thriving, driven by the rise of AI and the ever-increasing importance of data in making business decisions. Advancements in technologies such as edge computing and machine learning have also fuelled the growth of the Internet of Things, providing new avenues for business efficiency. This demand has led to very competitive salaries, often surpassing those of other comparable professions. Why study this degree rather than a boot camp course? This brand-new MSc Data Science course provides a structured pathway that enables you to get cutting-edge skills while developing your critical thinking and presentation abilities. Whilst boot camps can be great for acquiring a small amount of new knowledge in a short period of time, a degree course such as ours is a much better option if you want to develop a wide range of data science skills over a longer period and gain an accredited, globally recognised qualification with industry currency and lifetime value. Here are some other reasons why many students choose a master’s degree over a boot camp: Although boot camps provide high-level or general overviews that may help improve some skills in a certain role, they tend to struggle to deliver in-depth skills and knowledge in the way that a master’s degree course can. Many industries, especially well-paying ones, require a master’s in data science before you’ll be considered for employment, this is especially true in Europe and the U.S. Bootcamps don’t give you the opportunity to create a portfolio of deliverables that you can use to showcase your skills to employers in the way that our MSc Data Science does. Here's how the skills you acquire can shape your future: Programming expertise You'll develop robust programming skills, essential for transforming data into actionable insights. This capability enables you to work with data effectively, creating innovative solutions and automating data-driven processes. Data handling, analysis, and visualisation Proficiency in handling, analysing, and visualising data empowers you to extract meaningful insights from vast datasets. This skill is in high demand across industries seeking data-driven decision-making. Neural network development With the ability to develop neural networks, you enter the realm of artificial intelligence and machine learning, unlocking opportunities to create intelligent systems and predictive models. Get ahead with essential maths The course equips you with a deep understanding of the mathematical underpinnings of data science. This proficiency sets you apart in an industry where professionals sometimes lack detailed maths skills, allowing you to add substantial value to organisations after you graduate. Career Pathways : Upon completing your degree, you can enter diverse career paths, including: Data Analyst : Dive into the world of data analysis, where you'll explore data sets, derive insights, and support data-driven decision-making. Machine Learning Engineer : Take on roles that involve building and deploying machine learning models to solve complex problems. Artificial Intelligence Specialist : Lead projects focused on creating AI-powered solutions, from chatbots to autonomous vehicles. Data Scientist : Utilise your expertise to uncover hidden patterns, trends, and insights, driving business strategies and innovation. Industry skills In this postgraduate data science and AI programme, you'll master essential programming languages like Python, along with associated libraries like NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, Seaborn, SciPy, and Scikit-learn. Study abroad in UK London                   Stratford Manchester Apply today Speak to an advisor Register interest What makes Arden University special? Education for everyone, everywhere Whether you're constrained by location, cost, time, or other life commitments, we're passionate about giving you access to higher education that fits into your busy, modern life. You decide how and where to study We offer a wide range of flexible undergraduate and postgraduate degrees in both our online and blended study modes. Full support both online and on-site We're also proud to offer non-standard entry, meaning your work experience and previous qualifications are taken into account when assessing your application. Strong focus on employability You will gain in-depth subject knowledge and transferable skills that employers from a huge range of industries will value. Many of our courses at Arden are also accredited by leading professional bodies in the UK. Course Overview Study your master’s in engineering management with Arden and inspire change in your organisation. Learn how to spearhead innovative projects with the latest leadership and management skills. Want to scale up your managerial know-how and secure your place at the top levels of engineering management? There is currently a huge demand across industries for professionals with engineering management expertise. Our CMI-accredited MSc Engineering Management degree examines the most vital and contemporary areas in the field, all while helping you develop the leadership skills today’s employers are looking for. The course provides an entry route into engineering management across all engineering disciplines.  It is suitable for managers without an engineering background as well as qualified engineers looking to break into management roles. With a strong focus on how to manage modern engineering projects in a global context, you’ll cover areas of pan-sector relevance such as agile methodology, supply chain management, Big Data, working in cross-disciplinary teams, stakeholder engagement, and much more. This course is accredited by the Chartered Management Institute (CMI). That means you’ll be awarded a Level 7 Diploma in Strategic Management and Leadership and Foundation Chartered Manager status upon graduation, giving you a fast-track route to Chartered Manager status. Find out more about Engineering Management at Arden Video • 1 min Accreditation and Memberships CMI Accredited This course awards a CMI Level 7 Diploma in Strategic Management and Leadership Practice and grants graduates Foundation Chartered Manager Status. BGA Membership Arden University is a member of the Business Graduates Association (BGA), meaning students will receive complementary BGA membership. Quick tools Explore your brochure Download the course brochure to take a look at your course modules and syllabus content. Download brochure Speak to an advisor Want to speak to one of our subject experts? Our advisors are ready to answer your questions! Click below to get started. Show me how Professional accreditation This course is accredited by the Chartered Management Institute, supporting your career and connecting you with likeminded professionals. Learn more Course details and modules We’ve recently refreshed your modules to provide you with the practical, real-world, and most up-to-date skills needed to deliver successful engineering projects and make a positive impact on the structure and success of an organisation. I’ve found that studying my degree online with Arden has given me a much more comprehensive foundation of knowledge around the topics I don’t often encounter in my work role, including financial decision-making, ethics and strategy. This knowledge will enable me to progress to more strategic roles in the future. Simon Henry MBA Online Modules Before earning your master’s in engineering management, you’ll study 180 credit hours divided over the following 7 modules: Management of Traditional Engineering Projects (20 credits) Competitive Strategy within Engineering Management (20 credits) Agile Methodologies in the Business Environment (20 credits) Developing People, Leadership and Capabilities (20 credits) Introduction to Supply Chain Management (20 credits) Analysing big data (20 credits) Engineering Transformation Project (60 credits) For full details on your module content, click here to download the brochure . How do we assess you? The way we assess our masters students provides you with the opportunity to demonstrate your strengths and abilities. That’s why we choose a range of methods to keep track of your progress. These include: Portfolio development Case study reports Risk assessments Business Transformation Project Study options This course is available to study full-time at our campus in Berlin, Germany, or through our blended learning study mode in London Stratford and Manchester. The course is also available to students via online learning . This gives you the convenience of being able to study from anywhere in the UK or worldwide, providing you with the same high standards of teaching but with lower tuition fees. The staff and the support along the way has been amazing. Any questions or enquiries are answered. I cannot thank the admissions team enough for their part in advising and supporting me through this course. It is a big step to make and having the support through the whole process really helped. Clare Gillon MA Strategic Marketing Full-time blended learning How does it work? Our blended learning study mode combines structured in-person learning with the flexibility of guided independent study. You’ll attend eight hours of timetabled, face-to-face classes each week, spread over two days at your chosen Arden University campus. Alongside this, you’ll spend approximately 25 hours each week on independent study. You’ll use iLearn, our digital learning platform, to access key resources, submit assignments, and stay connected with your tutors and classmates. Whether you prefer studying in our on-campus learning spaces or at home, you’ll be supported throughout your journey. Blended learning is ideal if you value regular in-person teaching and want the flexibility to balance your studies with other commitments. With classes concentrated over just two days, you’ll have more control over your time, while still benefiting from face-to-face interaction and access to university facilities. This course is also available to study full-time at our Berlin, Germany campus. Part-time online learning How does it work? Studying your degree online with Arden means you can earn your anywhere in the world without the requirement to attend classes in a physical location. Our online students study their degree through iLearn, Arden’s university campus in the cloud. Online learning students resident in the UK can apply for a Maintenance Loan if they cannot attend their course in person because of a disability. Please find more information on our fees and funding page . If you're a student from Scotland, Wales or Northern Ireland you can find information on Living Cost Loans from your student finance body. Learn more about online learning Ilearn Our online students study their degree through iLearn, Arden’s university campus in the cloud.  iLearn provides everything you need to study at University. It offers an integrated virtual learning experience, including your virtual classroom, lecture theatre, and access to our Library Portal. Library portal The library portal includes an extensive digital library including thousands of journal titles, eBooks, and academic and industry databases which you can use to research your assignments and projects. All of these materials are provided to you free of charge, and contain all the research information you’ll need to complete your degree with us. Entry requirements At Arden University we consider applications on a case by case basis. If you have significant work experience, have qualifications you have gained elsewhere, or a degree or qualification that isn't a clear pathway to this degree - we are more than happy to discuss your application. Eligibility To be eligible for this MSc in Engineering Management, we need to see that you have: A UK Honours Degree at a minimum of second class (2.2) or equivalent. English Proficiency Online Learning: IELTS 6.5 (no less than 6.0 in any element); or TOEFL iBT 90; or equivalent Blended Learning in the UK or full-time study in Berlin: IELTS 6.0 (no less than 5.5 in any element); or TOEFL iBT 60-78; or equivalent. Free English language support is also available at the Arden Berlin campus. Alternatively, evidence you have previously studied in English; a letter to show that the Medium of Instruction was in English can be accepted We are happy to consider an application from you if you can show us you have the motivation to study this engineering management course. We’ll ask you for a personal statement that demonstrates your ability to study the course. We may also want references and evidence of relevant experience. If you require a visa to study in the UK You must meet the academic entry requirements for this course. You’ll need an IELTS score of 6.0 (with no less than 5.5 in any element) or an equivalent Secure English Language Test (SELT) result. You can find more information here Course fees and funding Funding and Scholarships We also offer a range of scholarships and funding support for eligible students, including options for UK, international, and UK-based international students. Start your application and an education advisor will be in touch to discuss your options. Meet the faculty Hassaan Khan brings 15 years of experience as a senior academic in higher education. Hassaan studied accounting and finance at the University of Kent, followed by an MSc and PhD in Finance from Durham University. Prior to joining Arden, he was associate dean at the Global Banking School, looking after the finance and business management degrees. Hassaan was director of programmes at BPP University where he was responsible for degrees in finance and applied management as well as professional courses and degree apprenticeships in accountancy. Dr. Hassaan Khan Head of School - School of Management and Executive Education Career prospects The ability to handle data and manage operations is in huge demand among modern business, giving you the competitive edge when it comes to career progression. After completing the course, you may decide to continue with your current employer or embark on a fresh challenge. Thanks to the flexibility of the skills you’ll have learned, the choice will be in your hands. Related courses MSc IT Security Management MSc Project Management Engineering Articles Business and Management Articles Career Advice What can an MSc in Engineering Management do for me? Graduating from an MSc Engineering Management course will give you an opportunity to develop leadership skills within the engineering arena, either to upskill into management or reskill from another specialism. Whilst studying, you’ll: Gain an advanced understanding of engineering management and its real-world applications. Demonstrate you can apply your knowledge and skills at a strategic management level. Learn how to deliver successful engineering projects that drive organsational success. Develop the leadership skills today’s employers are looking for. Use problem-solving skills to find innovative solutions to engineering challenges. Demonstrate the ability to use data and risk assessment in your decision-making. Develop confident communication skills and adapt these to a variety of contexts. What can I do after Arden University? Skilled engineering management graduates are in high demand in today’s job market due to an increase in emerging innovations calling for large-scale engineering projects. This degree will provide you with the specialised knowledge and skills to design, plan, direct, and oversee projects across diverse industries, helping you fill growing skills gaps in the field. The type of roles you might look into after graduation include: Management of Technology Management Engineering Consultant Sustainability Manager Engineering Manager in a variety of disciplines Operations Manager IT Manager Engineering Project Manager Supply Chain Manager Industry skills Chartered Management Institute (CMI) This course awards a CMI Level 7 Diploma in Strategic Management and Leadership Practice and offers CMI Foundation Chartered Manager Status * The Chartered Management Institute (CMI) promotes excellence in UK management and leadership. As the CMI possesses a Royal Charter, they are the only organisation in the UK that can award Chartered Manager status to their members – the gold standard in management. With 140,000 members, the institute aims to boost career development across the management sector and connect like-minded professionals. As an Arden student, you’ll have free CMI Membership throughout your studies, giving you access to a range of additional resources including a mentoring service and invitations to networking events both online and offline. Upon completion of this CMI-accredited course, you will be awarded CMI Level 7 Diploma in Strategic Management and Leadership Practice and gain CMI Foundation Chartered Manager Status. This recognises you have the skills needed to be an effective manager, helping you stand out from the competition and start your management career journey - with a CMI qualification and a clear pathway to full Chartered Manager status. *Upon completion of your course, the CMI award and level of chartered status awarded will depend on your level and length of study, whether you entered your course with Recognition for Prior Learning (RPL) or if any compensation is applied on your modules throughout the duration of study. If this criteria applies to you, you may receive one of the 2 different levels; an Award or Certificate. Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business (AACSB) membership. Arden University is a member of the prestigious Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business (AACSB). AACSB International is a global association of leaders in education and business dedicated to supporting and advancing quality business education worldwide. This membership reflects the fact that Arden University has successfully matched the high standards required by the AACSB, and enables the sharing of ideas and the exchange best practises between global business schools. Membership also gives our faculty members access to in-depth data and research to support the development of our courses and teaching methods, ensuring that we are able to provide you with the best possible university experience. Business Graduates Association The BGA is a membership and quality assurance body. As a member, Arden University have signed up to the BGA Charter, committing their institution to responsible management practices and lifelong learning, positively impacting their students, communities, and the economy. This shows our students that we are demonstrating responsible management ourselves, as well as it being a central theme that runs through our own courses. As Arden University is a member of the Business Graduates Association (BGA), students will receive complementary BGA student and graduate membership. Through this membership, current students will have access to the BGA Career Development Centre, packed with interactive tools, e-learning content, partner discounts and the latest job opportunities. This is a lifetime access, which means students will continue to have access to these services even after they graduate. Course Overview Advance your health and social care career by completing your postgraduate studies and earning a master’s qualification. The MSc Health and Care Management (Top-Up) programme is designed to help you achieve this by providing a pathway to a full master’s degree through completing a single research module. This qualification can unlock opportunities for career progression, promotions to senior positions, and access to a broader range of roles across the health and social care industry. By applying your previous studies to address significant issues in the sector, this programme equips you with the advanced skills needed for higher-level roles, including problem analysis, project proposals, implementation plans, risk management, and leadership. In addition to enhancing your career, this top-up programme offers a valuable opportunity for those interested in academia. During the course, you will consolidate your learning by integrating and applying knowledge from previous postgraduate studies into a practical research project. This process enhances your research skills, including research methodology, and paves the way for further academic pursuits such as publishing research or pursuing a PhD. Learn more Course details and modules The core component of this top-up course is the research project. This module enables you to apply your academic knowledge to real-world scenarios, focusing on enhancing, improving, or transforming health and social care services. The project encourages you to explore your personal and professional skills, contributing to your overall confidence and competence. Delivering face-to-face care to my patients with the knowledge and skills I have learned at Arden University helps me a to be a lot to be more confident in my professional role. Helen Okpoh BA (Hons) Healthcare Management Modules Research Project (60 credits) How do we assess you? This course is assessed based on an independent project focusing on a current issue in public health. If you're already working in health and care, you’ll have the opportunity to address a real-world situation from your workplace. You will work on this issue in a simulated setting with guidance from our academic team. Project requirements Organisation selection: Choose an organisation you know or one with accessible public or academic information. Project proposal: Outline the significance and relevance of your research to the chosen organisation or sector. Ethics approval: Start the ethics approval process early if your project involves primary data collection. Final report: Present the completed report as an industry-related document, suitable for the management or executive team. Support and supervision Each student will be assigned a supervisor to guide them from the conception of the project idea to the submission of the final report. This support ensures you can confidently navigate the research process and produce high-quality, industry-relevant work. Skills development Research practitioner: Gain advanced skills in research methodology, critical analysis, and data interpretation. Healthcare leadership: Develop leadership skills for managing and implementing change in the sector. Analytical and digital skills: Improve problem-solving, risk management, and proficiency with digital tools for health research and decision-making. Cemene Wellington BA (Hons) Healthcare Online learning How does it work? Studying this course online gives you the ultimate in convenience. You can enrol with Arden from anywhere in the world and study your degree from the comfort of home, without the requirement to attend classes in a physical location. Our online students study their degree through ilearn, Arden’s university campus in the cloud. ilearn provides everything you need to study at university. It offers an integrated virtual learning experience, including your virtual classroom, lecture theatre, and access to our Library Portal. The portal includes an extensive digital library including thousands of journal titles, eBooks, and academic and industry databases which you can use to research your assignments and projects. All of these materials are provided to you free of charge and contain all the research information you’ll need to complete your degree with us. ilearn is also integrated with Zoom, making it easier to chat with your course tutor during your scheduled seminar sessions. You can even integrate our study materials into your Kindle, making it possible to study wherever you have your Kindle handy. Studying online doesn’t mean studying alone. As well as receiving regular feedback and guidance from your course tutor, you’ll be studying with like-minded students whom you can meet with through our Unitu community, and you’ll have access to community message boards to discuss your course and the topics being raised within it. We’ve even set up community boards embedded into each of the course modules so you can have discussions with your tutor and classmates on the topics you’re currently learning. Online learning students resident in the UK can apply for a Maintenance Loan if they cannot attend their course in person because of a disability. Please find more information on our fees and funding page. If you're a student from Scotland, Wales, or Northern Ireland you can find information on Living Cost Loans from your student finance body. If you have significant work experience, have qualifications you have gained elsewhere, or a degree or qualification that isn't a clear pathway to this degree - we are more than happy to discuss your application. Eligibility To be eligible for our MSc Health and Care Management (Top-Up), you should have: 120 credits at postgraduate level in a relevant discipline(s) or Senior Leader Apprenticeship, Level 7, UK IfATE ST0480. English proficiency IELTS 6.5 (no less than 6.0 in any element); or TOEFL iBT 90; or equivalent Alternatively, evidence you have previously studied in English, such as a letter to show that the Medium of Instruction was in English, can be accepted.
