Meet the faculty Dr. Stephanie West joined Arden University in November 2020 and is the Head of the School of School of Leadership & Service Industry Management. In addition to her wealth of healthcare industry experience, Stephanie has held a number of Senior Academic and Leadership positions in Health, Social Care and Applied Science faculties at a variety of universities across the UK. Stephanie will provide leadership to the School of School of Leadership & Service Industry Management, ensuring that it delivers high quality academic provision and student satisfaction across all courses. Professor Stephanie West Head of School - School of Leadership & Service Industry Management Career prospects Upon completing the course, you will be equipped to propose and lead transformative projects within your workplace, contribute to significant changes across the sector, and pursue further educational opportunities such as PhD research. related courses Global Health Management Master of Public Health Health and Social Care Articles Career Advice What will the MSc Health and Care Management (Top-Up) do for me? This course is designed with input from leading employers to equip you with essential skills for the health and care sector, preparing you for senior managerial or leadership roles upon graduation. During the course, you will: Gain the ability to understand, analyse, critique, and review key challenges in the health and care sector, identifying potential improvements. Become skilled in undertaking industry-focused research and developing potential industry projects. Confidently propose transformative projects in your workplace, lead changes across key areas of the sector, and pursue further educational pathways such as PhD research. Acquire key skills for public health practice, management, and research at local, national, and international levels. Be ready to work as a public health practitioner in NGOs, charities, public sectors, or academic institutions. What can I do after Arden University? The MSc Health and Care Management (Top-Up) offers opportunities to advance within your current career or transition to a new path. Potential roles include: Policy Analyst​ Programme Manager​ Health Advisor​ Health Consultant​ Health Educator​ Health Researcher​ Health Leader/Manager​ Academic/Researcher This opens up opportunities to work with local authorities, national leaders​, non-governmental organisations and well-known national and international charities. Industry skills Business Graduates Association (BGA) The BGA is a membership and quality assurance body. As a member, Arden University has signed up to the BGA Charter, committing their institution to responsible management practices and lifelong learning, positively impacting their students, communities, and the economy. This shows our students that we are demonstrating responsible management ourselves, as well as it being a central theme that runs through our own courses. As Arden University is a member of the Business Graduates Association (BGA), students will receive complimentary BGA student and graduate membership. Through this membership, current students will have access to the BGA Career Development Centre, packed with interactive tools, e-learning content, partner discounts and the latest job opportunities. This is a lifetime access, which means students will continue to have access to these services even after they graduate. Stratford Manchester Apply today Speak to an advisor Register interest What makes Arden University special? Education for everyone, everywhere Whether you're constrained by location, cost, time, or other life commitments, we're passionate about giving you access to higher education that fits into your busy, modern life. You decide how and where to study We offer a wide range of flexible undergraduate and postgraduate degrees in both our online and blended study modes. Full support both online and on-site We're also proud to offer non-standard entry, meaning your work experience and previous qualifications are taken into account when assessing your application. Strong focus on employability You will gain in-depth subject knowledge and transferable skills that employers from a huge range of industries will value. Many of our courses at Arden are also accredited by leading professional bodies in the UK. Course Overview Arden University’s MSc International Business Management is tailor-made for future global leaders and managers. This programme is designed to help you master the intricacies of today’s interconnected and digitalised business world. You will gain critical skills to navigate global markets, understand international trade, manage supply chains, and appreciate cultural differences. Our approach combines both theory and practical application, ensuring that you not only learn the foundational concepts but also have the opportunity to apply them through assessments and learning tools. This blend of knowledge prepares you to tackle contemporary challenges and seize opportunities in a global business environment. You will explore a broad range of subjects, including international trade, marketing, team management, project management, business transformation, and innovation. Guided by faculty with hands-on experience in international business, you will refine your leadership style and strategic vision, equipping you to thrive in a dynamic and evolving marketplace. The program culminates in a transformation project, where you’ll put your learning into practice by addressing a real-world business challenge. This comprehensive experience prepares you to excel as a leader. Explore postgraduate Business degrees Video • 2 mins Quick tools Explore your brochure Download the course brochure to take a look at your course modules and syllabus content. Download brochure Speak to an advisor Want to speak to one of our subject experts? Our advisors are ready to answer your questions! Click below to get started. Show me how Career development resources You'll have online access to a huge range of career development tools from the day you start studying. Learn more Course details and modules This course is designed to give you the advanced knowledge and practical skills you need to succeed in today’s global business landscape. This course combines essential management principles, strategic insights, and modern digital skills, preparing you to tackle the challenges of a fast-changing global marketplace. Here at Arden we know the decision to undertake postgraduate study is a major one for all students. Is now the right time to study a master's degree? Modules Managing Digital Transformation & Innovation (20 credits) Explore the latest digital business models and innovation strategies to drive change in organisations. Leading Global Teams & Organisations (20 credits) Develop strategies for managing culturally diverse teams across global contexts. Financial Management (20 credits) Explore investment and financial decision-making within global and domestic markets. Managing the Global Market (20 credits) Gain insights into international trade, cross-cultural marketing, and global supply chains. Developing Globally Sustainable Strategy (20 credits) Formulate strategies for long-term success and sustainability in global markets. Competing in the Digital Economy (20 credits) Analyse the impact of digital advancements on competition, consumer behavior, and marketing strategies. Transformation Capstone Project (60 credits) Conduct an independent study on a real-world business challenge, applying research to develop actionable recommendations. For full details on your module content, click here to download the brochure . How do we assess you? Assessments​ Unlike many traditional master’s programmes, the MSc International Business Management at Arden University does not require you to sit for exams. Instead, this course emphasises practical application, ensuring you can align your studies with real-world operations after graduation. Practice-driven​ All assessments are practice-driven, focusing on your experiences as an industry practitioner while fostering peer-to-peer collaboration and knowledge exchange. This approach encourages you to systematically apply your knowledge to organisations or data sets, whether through examining industry case studies or relating concepts to your own organisation. Industry-led research project​ The course with an independent study assessment known as the Transformation Capstone Project. In this module, you’ll choose a management topic that interests you and conduct your own research. You will build on the knowledge gained from your course modules and present recommendations that offer real-world, practical benefits to the organisation involved. Other assessment methods Throughout the course, you’ll have the opportunity to apply your learning through additional assessments, including: Summative assessments Case study assignments Workplace reports Presentations Reflective journals Study options This course is available to study full time through our blended learning study mode at our campus in London Stratford and Manchester. I chose Arden University Berlin because they provide an environment to further your knowledge and pursue opportunities in a new field. Jasvir Markandy MSc IT Security Management graduate, Arden University Berlin Full time, blended learning How does it work? Our blended learning study mode combines structured in-person learning with the flexibility of guided independent study. You’ll attend eight hours of timetabled, face-to-face classes each week, spread over two days at your chosen Arden University campus. Alongside this, you’ll spend approximately 25 hours each week on independent study. You’ll use iLearn, our digital learning platform, to access key resources, submit assignments, and stay connected with your tutors and classmates. Whether you prefer studying in our on-campus learning spaces or at home, you’ll be supported throughout your journey. Blended learning is ideal if you value regular in-person teaching and want the flexibility to balance your studies with other commitments. With classes concentrated over just two days, you’ll have more control over your time, while still benefiting from face-to-face interaction and access to university facilities. This course is also available to study full-time at our Berlin, Germany campus. Learn more about Blended Learning Entry requirements At Arden University we consider applications on a case by case basis. If you have significant work experience, have qualifications you have gained elsewhere, or a degree or qualification that isn't a clear pathway to this degree - we are more than happy to discuss your application. Eligibility To be eligible for our MSc International Business Management, you need to meet the following criteria: Standard Entry A UK Honours degree at 2:2 or above (or an equivalent qualification A degree in a business-related subject is preferred, but we’ll also consider other subject areas. Non-Standard Entry Don’t have a degree? We still welcome your application if you can show at least 5 years of relevant work experience. Experience in a business-related area is ideal, but we’ll also look at other professional backgrounds. Professional Qualifications You’re also encouraged to apply if you hold a qualification with one of the following: Chartered Management Institute (CMI) Institute of Leadership and Management (ILM) Chartered Institute of Marketing (CIM) We’ll also consider other relevant professional memberships. English proficiency Online Learning: IELTS 6.5 (no less than 6.0 in any element); or TOEFL iBT 90; or equivalent Blended Learning in the UK or Berlin: IELTS 6.0 (no less than 5.5 in any element); or TOEFL iBT 60-78; or equivalent. Free English language support is also available at the Arden Berlin campus. Alternatively, evidence you have previously studied in English; a letter to show that the Medium of Instruction was in English can be accepted If you require a visa to study in the UK You must meet the academic entry requirements for this course. You’ll need an IELTS score of 6.0 (with no less than 5.5 in any element) or an equivalent Secure English Language Test (SELT) result. You can find more information here Course fees and funding Funding and Scholarships We also offer a range of scholarships and funding support for eligible students, including options for UK, international, and UK-based international students. Meet the faculty Hassaan Khan brings 15 years of experience as a senior academic in higher education. Hassaan studied accounting and finance at the University of Kent, followed by an MSc and PhD in Finance from Durham University. Prior to joining Arden, he was associate dean at the Global Banking School, looking after the finance and business management degrees. Hassaan was director of programmes at BPP University where he was responsible for degrees in finance and applied management as well as professional courses and degree apprenticeships in accountancy. Dr. Hassaan Khan Head of School - School of Management and Executive Education Career prospects Related Courses Master of Business Administration (MBA) MSc Supply Chain Management and Logistics MSc Strategic Digital Marketing Business and Management Articles Career Advice What will an MSc International Business Management do for me? In your MSc International Business Management course, you will develop a diverse set of management, leadership, and technical skills. By adopting a broader perspective and taking an international view of business issues, you will learn to analyse managerial and organisational challenges from a global, cross-cultural standpoint. Throughout your studies, you will also enhance your ability to: Integrate theories and concepts with real-world practices Create value for shareholders from an interdisciplinary perspective as a general manager Make business decisions while considering the interests of multiple stakeholders Communicate confidently and adapt your communication style to various settings and contexts Use problem-solving skills to find innovative solutions to business challenges What can I do after Arden University? The MSc International Business Management will provide you with the opportunity to explore a variety of senior-level career options, including:​ CEO​ Strategy Consultant​ Account Director​ Managing Director​ Head of Business Development ​ Entrepreneur​ Department/Functional Head​ Team Leader​ Head of Procurement/Logistics Operations​ Head of International Business/Operation​ Intrapreneur Industry skills Chartered Management Institute (CMI) The Chartered Management Institute (CMI) promotes excellence in UK management and leadership. The institute aims to boost career development across the management sector and connect you with likeminded professionals across diverse sectors. As the CMI possesses a Royal Charter, they are the only organisation in the UK that can award Chartered Manager status to their members – the gold standard in management. They are also active in business policy making across the globe and ensure that their more than 140,000 members are represented in policy decision making. Study abroad in UK London                   Stratford Manchester Apply today Speak to an advisor Register interest What makes Arden University special? Education for everyone, everywhere Whether you're constrained by location, cost, time, or other life commitments, we're passionate about giving you access to higher education that fits into your busy, modern life. You decide how and where to study We offer a wide range of flexible undergraduate and postgraduate degrees in both our online and blended study modes. Full support both online and on-site We're also proud to offer non-standard entry, meaning your work experience and previous qualifications are taken into account when assessing your application. Strong focus on employability You will gain in-depth subject knowledge and transferable skills that employers from a huge range of industries will value. Many of our courses at Arden are also accredited by leading professional bodies in the UK. Course Overview Designed for anyone who wants to fast-track their career in the sector, our MSc Project Management course is enables you to take on greater challenges in project management and increase your competitive edge in the eyes of employers. On the course, you’ll develop strategic project management skills that are highly sought after in sectors across all areas of international business – from project analytics and data handling to managing teams and understanding Big Data. The syllabus has been designed to reflect upon and consider contemporary project management practice and the challenges facing the global business environment right now, as well as providing the strategic leadership and management skills that every business needs. To support your career development, this course is accredited by the Chartered Association of Project Management (APM), and is the only project management master’s degree in the UK offering a Chartered Management Institute (CMI) Level 7 Diploma in Strategic Management and Leadership*. With this in mind, our master’s in project management will bring you up-to-speed with the latest project management practices, trends, and developments. As an example, the recent coronavirus pandemic has demonstrated the importance of project management in finding solutions to unprecedented challenges. In fact, project management skills are vital in fields including engineering, technology, education, healthcare, events management, as well as tourism and many more creative and service fields. Because of this, your degree qualification will have wide reaching employer-appeal and is your ticket to a highly rewarding career. *Correct at the time of publishing Save on your online MSc Project Management degree We’re offering UK distance learning students the chance to enrol in our MSc Project Management programme for just £6,500. This new price is designed to widen participation and access to this valuable course, helping support the next generation of project management professionals. Alongside your MSc, you’ll also gain a CMI-accredited Level 7 Diploma in Strategic Management and Leadership, giving you a competitive edge in today’s job market. Plus, you can use the remaining portion of your Postgraduate Student Loan (up to £12,858 for eligible applicants) to help cover living costs, making it easier to invest in your future. Eligibility: Open to UK residents studying via distance learning. Terms and conditions apply . MSc Project Management Video • 2 mins Accreditation and Memberships APM Accredited This course is accredited by the Chartered Association of Project Management (APM). CMI Accredited This course awards a CMI Level 7 Diploma in Strategic Management and Leadership Practice and grants graduates Foundation Chartered Manager Status. BGA Membership Arden University is a member of the Business Graduates Association (BGA), meaning students will receive complementary BGA membership. AACSB Membership Arden University is a member of the prestigious Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business (AACSB). Quick tools Explore your brochure Download the course brochure to take a look at your course modules and syllabus content. Download brochure Speak to an advisor Want to speak to one of our subject experts? Our advisors are ready to answer your questions! Click below to get started. Show me how Professional accreditations This course is accredited by both the Association for Project Management (APM) and Chartered Management Institute (CMI) Learn more Course details and modules Our project management degree will provide you with the knowledge and confidence required to execute large scale global projects. You’ll become a forward-thinking project manager who understands the importance of data metrics in project analysis and future planning. Each of our postgraduate level modules are informed by professional and academic expertise, helping you to become better equipped to lead and manage high-level projects. Project management is a valuable role, helping daily operations run more smoothly. Let’s look at some high profile failures in project management that could have been avoided with better planning. The Arden team were always really nice, the support team. And the teachers were always trying to help you out, answering your questions. And I really liked working on my thesis – it was fun. Daniel MSc Project Management, Berlin Modules Core modules (20 credits each) Management of traditional projects Project analytics Agile methodologies in the digital business environment Project management tools and techniques Developing people, leadership, and capabilities. Elective, choose one (20 credits) Managing cloud-based business solutions Managing customer and user experience Analysing big data Introduction to Supply Chain Management Final project (60 credits) Business Transformation Project *The order and availability of the optional modules within each level may vary depending on intake and subject to demand. For full details on your module content, click here to download the brochure . How do we assess you? The assessment strategy centres on a strong alignment with real world project management issues and embraces a range of group and individual based assessment types including: Reflective analysis Portfolio development Work products Narrated presentations Case study reports Risk assessments Proposals for agile implementation Digital business transformation project (as above) Students are expected to apply knowledge and theory explored in the modules and produce assessments that simultaneously focus on real business situations and demonstrate the high levels of critical and diagnostic thinking required to meet the standards of a Level 7 business qualification. The programme culminates in the submission of the independent study assessment (Business Transformation Project) that builds upon content examined in the other modules and requires students to develop a digital transformation project plan. Study options This course is available to study full-time at our campus in Berlin, Germany, or through our blended learning study mode in London Stratford and Manchester. The course is also available to students via online learning . This gives you the convenience of being able to study from anywhere in the UK or worldwide, providing you with the same high standards of teaching but with lower tuition fees. This course is being offered via full-time for International students at our Tower Hill campus. Find out more here. I have enjoyed doing my master’s here because it’s not like a traditional university where you sit in a classroom and a lecturer talks and you write down everything. I like that when we come here there’s actually a discussion and we do a lot of analysis. Oscar Bustillo MSc Project Management student, Arden University Berlin Full-time blended learning How does it work? Our blended learning study mode combines structured in-person learning with the flexibility of guided independent study. You’ll attend eight hours of timetabled, face-to-face classes each week, spread over two days at your chosen Arden University campus. Alongside this, you’ll spend approximately 25 hours each week on independent study. You’ll use iLearn, our digital learning platform, to access key resources, submit assignments, and stay connected with your tutors and classmates. Whether you prefer studying in our on-campus learning spaces or at home, you’ll be supported throughout your journey. Blended learning is ideal if you value regular in-person teaching and want the flexibility to balance your studies with other commitments. With classes concentrated over just two days, you’ll have more control over your time, while still benefiting from face-to-face interaction and access to university facilities. This course is also available to study full-time at our Berlin, Germany campus. Learn more about blended learning Part-time online learning How does it work? Studying your degree online with Arden means you can earn your anywhere in the world without the requirement to attend classes in a physical location. Our online students study their degree through iLearn, Arden’s university campus in the cloud. Online learning students resident in the UK can apply for a Maintenance Loan if they cannot attend their course in person because of a disability. Please find more information on our fees and funding page . If you're a student from Scotland, Wales or Northern Ireland you can find information on Living Cost Loans from your student finance body. Learn more about online learning Entry requirements At Arden University we consider applications on a case by case basis. If you have significant work experience, have qualifications you have gained elsewhere, or a degree or qualification that isn't a clear pathway to this degree - we are more than happy to discuss your application. Eligibility To be eligible for this MSc project management course at Arden University, you must normally have: A UK Honours Degree at a minimum of second class (2:2) or equivalent. Some of our students decide to join us straight after they complete their undergraduate studies. Or, for those joining us after time in the workplace, we recommend that they have five years of experience as a manager of people or projects. English Proficiency Online Learning: IELTS 6.5 (no less than 6.0 in any element); or TOEFL iBT 90; or equivalent Blended Learning in the UK or full-time study in Berlin: IELTS 6.0 (no less than 5.5 in any element); or TOEFL iBT 60-78; or equivalent. Free English language support is also available at the Arden Berlin campus. Alternatively, evidence you have previously studied in English; a letter to show that the Medium of Instruction was in English can be accepted If you require a visa to study in the UK You must meet the academic entry requirements for this course. You’ll need an IELTS score of 6.0 (with no less than 5.5 in any element) or an equivalent Secure English Language Test (SELT) result. You can find more information here Course fees and funding Funding and Scholarships We also offer a range of scholarships and funding support for eligible students, including options for UK, international, and UK-based international students. Start your application and an education advisor will be in touch to discuss your options. Refer a Friend When you help a friend or family member to study with Arden through our Refer a Friend programme, both you and the person you refer will receive a £500 Amazon e-voucher or £500 tuition fee credit. Meet the faculty Hassaan Khan brings 15 years of experience as a senior academic in higher education. Hassaan studied accounting and finance at the University of Kent, followed by an MSc and PhD in Finance from Durham University. Prior to joining Arden, he was associate dean at the Global Banking School, looking after the finance and business management degrees. Hassaan was director of programmes at BPP University where he was responsible for degrees in finance and applied management as well as professional courses and degree apprenticeships in accountancy. Dr. Hassaan Khan Head of School - School of Management and Executive Education Career prospects Project management expertise is required in nearly every business and in every sector, so your future career opportunities are almost limitless. This master’s degree will give you the skills you need to demonstrate senior-level project management expertise, greatly enhancing your employability in the eyes of global organisations. Wherever you want to take your career next, you’ll have the knowledge to achieve your ambitions to the fullest. Related courses Master of Business Administration (MBA) MSc Strategic Human Resource Management Business and Management Articles Acentas PM Career Advice What will a master’s in project management do for my career? Our master’s in project management has been designed with industry in mind and is updated regularly to ensure the experience and skills that you gain can be applied to the workplace when you graduate. You’ll get the skills required to be an efficient, digitally savvy, and agile project manager. Because we focus on the practical application of what you learn, you’ll find that this knowledge and expertise is valuable to a range of different roles. Whilst studying, you’ll: Gain critical and detailed analysis of the theory and practice relating to the role of project management within organisations. Practice management theory related to project management within a global context. Tackle data metrics and analysis from real life business scenarios and use data analytics to drive project management decisions and processes. Complete a detailed piece of research relating to a project management issue. Explore sustainability and business ethics. Apply knowledge of project management theory and models to complex issues, both systematically and creatively, to improve business and management practice Utilise a stimulating online academic environment, which is based upon the values of academic openness and critical appraisal. Develop a variety of transferable skills suited to an extensive range of project management roles What can I do after Arden University? This course will help you develop the right skills and knowledge to accelerate your career to a senior leadership role. Whether you want to join an already established business, start your own company or become a consultant, this degree can give you everything you need to explore any avenue. Some roles you might want to consider are: Operations Project Manager Project Director Project Executive Technical Project Manager Technical Project Lead Business Project Lead Programme Manager Industry skills The Chartered Association for Project Management (APM) This degree is accredited by the Association of Project Management (APM), which tells employers that your knowledge meets latest standards of the project management industry, helping to enhance your future career options. The Chartered Association for Project Management (APM) is a body committed to developing and promoting project management excellence. The organisation is the only chartered body for the profession, and has more than 30,000 members and over 500 organisations participating in its partnership programmes. Chartered Management Institute (CMI) This course awards a CMI Level 7 Diploma in Strategic Management and Leadership Practice and offers CMI Foundation Chartered Manager Status * The Chartered Management Institute (CMI) promotes excellence in UK management and leadership. As the CMI possesses a Royal Charter, they are the only organisation in the UK that can award Chartered Manager status to their members – the gold standard in management. With 140,000 members, the institute aims to boost career development across the management sector and connect like-minded professionals. As an Arden student, you’ll have free CMI Membership throughout your studies, giving you access to a range of additional resources including a mentoring service and invitations to networking events both online and offline. Upon completion of this CMI-accredited course, you will be awarded CMI Level 7 Diploma in Strategic Management and Leadership Practice and gain CMI Foundation Chartered Manager Status. This recognises you have the skills needed to be an effective manager, helping you stand out from the competition and start your management career journey - with a CMI qualification and a clear pathway to full Chartered Manager status. *Upon completion of your course, the CMI award and level of chartered status awarded will depend on your level and length of study, whether you entered your course with Recognition for Prior Learning (RPL) or if any compensation is applied on your modules throughout the duration of study. If this criteria applies to you, you may receive one of the 2 different levels; an Award or Certificate. Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business (AACSB) membership. Arden University is a member of the prestigious Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business (AACSB). AACSB International is a global association of leaders in education and business dedicated to supporting and advancing quality business education worldwide. This membership reflects the fact that Arden University has successfully matched the high standards required by the AACSB, and enables the sharing of ideas and the exchange best practises between global business schools. Membership also gives our faculty members access to in-depth data and research to support the development of our courses and teaching methods, ensuring that we are able to provide you with the best possible university experience. Business Graduates Association (BGA) The BGA is a membership and quality assurance body. As a member, Arden University have signed up to the BGA Charter, committing their institution to responsible management practices and lifelong learning, positively impacting their students, communities, and the economy. This shows our students that we are demonstrating responsible management ourselves, as well as it being a central theme that runs through our own courses. As Arden University is a member of the Business Graduates Association (BGA), students will receive complementary BGA student and graduate membership. Through this membership, current students will have access to the BGA Career Development Centre, packed with interactive tools, e-learning content, partner discounts and the latest job opportunities. This is a lifetime access, which means students will continue to have access to these services even after they graduate. Education for everyone, everywhere Whether you're constrained by location, cost, time, or other life commitments, we're passionate about giving you access to higher education that fits into your busy, modern life. You decide how and where to study We offer a wide range of flexible undergraduate and postgraduate degrees in both our online and blended study modes. Full support both online and on-site We're also proud to offer non-standard entry, meaning your work experience and previous qualifications are taken into account when assessing your application. Strong focus on employability You will gain in-depth subject knowledge and transferable skills that employers from a huge range of industries will value. Many of our courses at Arden are also accredited by leading professional bodies in the UK. Course Overview This online MSc Psychology conversion course is designed for anyone passionate about understanding human behaviour or looking to start a career in psychology. As a conversion course, most students are new to the subject, so the programme begins with core Research Methods to build skills and confidence before progressing to more advanced assessments. Successful completion of the course grants eligibility for the Graduate Basis for Chartered Membership (GBC), which is often a pre-requisite for further training as a professional psychologist. It also means that you can apply to be a graduate member with the British Psychological Society (BPS), which grants access to the post-nominal letters GMBPsS. You’ll develop the research skills modern psychologists need. From day one, you’ll explore both quantitative and qualitative methods using practices that reflect how research is carried out in psychology today. On the course, you’ll study the human lifespan, mental health, brain-behaviour links, and current debates in personality and intelligence research. You’ll benefit from the experience of our academic staff in a collaborative, international learning environment, gaining real-world insight through opportunities such as volunteer research assistant opportunities, student conferences, guest speakers, professional interest groups, employability events, and more. Earning your MSc Psychology online with Arden gives you control over your studies without the need to relocate. Our tutors use a mix of lectures, online tutorials, and self-directed learning to bring the full university experience to you wherever you are. This degree prepares you to apply psychological concepts in careers such as human resource management, teaching, counselling, and beyond. After your first study block, we will submit your application for BPS Student Membership and cover the cost for the rest of your MSc if accepted, subject to BPS terms of membership. If you prefer not to be automatically enrolled with BPS, please let us know before the end of your first study block. Once you have completed your first study block with us, we will submit an application for your membership with BPS, if this is accepted we will pay for your membership for the remainder of your MSc Psychology course at Arden. You will be subject to the BPS terms of membership which can be found here . If you do not want us to automatically enrol you please let us know prior to the end of your first study block. Find out more about our MSc in Psychology Video • 2 mins Accreditation and Memberships BPS Accredited Upon graduation you'll receive Graduate Basis for Chartered Membership (GBC) conferred by the British Psychological Society (BPS). Quick tools Explore your brochure Download the course brochure to take a look at your course modules and syllabus content. Download brochure Speak to an advisor Want to speak to one of our subject experts? Our advisors are ready to answer your questions! Click below to get started. Show me how Professional accreditation This course is accredited by the British Psychological Society, the representative body for professional psychologists in the UK. Learn more MSc Psychology conversion course details and modules Achieving your online MSc Psychology conversion course allows you to start your journey in psychology and opens pathways to more senior positions, including management and leadership roles. This course focuses on mastering the fundamentals of psychology, learning to critically analyse theory and research, and exploring how psychology can be applied across a range of settings. You’ll cover core topics such as behavioural neuroscience, individual differences, lifespan development, and mental health. Using a modular approach, you’ll engage with modern psychology concepts including how different brain types influence human behaviour, human memory, states of consciousness, and the development of neurological conditions. You’ll also explore human growth and change across the lifespan, from childhood and adolescence to adulthood and older age. Alongside these core areas, the course emphasises innovation and technology in psychology. You’ll investigate modern debates, from brain imaging and cognitive functions to the use of AI and machine learning in mental health research. Innovative tools, such as bodyswaps (AI avatars), are integrated into the programme to help you develop practical skills including interviewing and assessment techniques. Flexible learning that fits around you As a fully online MSc Psychology student, you can fit your study hours around your life. Arden University’s online degrees are flexible, accessible, and designed to help you boost your career prospects and expand your knowledge from anywhere in the world. Whether you’re working full- or part-time, living with a disability, or caring for children, there are no barriers to studying with Arden—just opportunities to unlock your full potential. If you can’t attend a live session, don’t worry. All sessions are recorded and available to watch at a time that suits you, so you never miss out on important content. Arden is for winners. Nobody will beg you to sit down and start working on your career, if you don’t do it yourself! At Arden, if you have an honest interest for what you learn and you want to reach out for more, you will be welcomed, helped, and advised. But to do that, you must be determined. Bettina Finna BSc (Hons) Psychology Modules To earn your online MSc Psychology conversion degree, you need a total of 180 credits, completed through the following modules: Research Methods (20 credits) Social Psychology (20 credits) Behavioural Neuroscience (20 credits) Individual Differences and Mental Health (20 credits) Lifespan Development (20 credits) Cognitive Psychology (20 credits) Advanced Research Project (60 credits) This part-time course is designed to be completed in 15 months. In your first two study blocks, you’ll study one module at a time, giving you the opportunity to build strong academic and analytical foundations before progressing to a more flexible study pattern. After this, you can choose to continue studying one module at a time or take two modules alongside each other, depending on your preferred pace. Each 20-credit module typically requires around 200 learning hours over a 10-week period, which works out to a minimum of 20 hours per week. How do we assess you? Our assessments are designed to help you develop practical skills for your future role, rather than just testing knowledge through exams. You’ll have the opportunity to demonstrate your strengths in a variety of ways and track your progress throughout the course. For the online MSc Psychology conversion course, assessment methods include: Quantitative and qualitative empirical research report Empirical research proposal Self-reflective writing Literature review Case study Poster Presentation Dissertation/Empirical Journal Article You’ll also have the chance to submit draft work for feedback before final assessments, and in some modules, you can choose between written or presentation formats, allowing you to play to your strengths. The Advanced Research Project Your final 60-credit module, the Advanced Research Project, lets you shape your academic journey around your passions, career goals, and professional interests. During this module, you will: Choose a research topic that sparks your curiosity and aligns with your personal interests. Tailor your project to your preferred style and depth, with the option to submit a comprehensive 12,000-word thesis or a concise 7,000-word journal article. Obtain ethical approval for your project, which counts for 10% of the module grade—an important step in line with professional psychology practice. Receive 1-to-1 guidance from experienced academics across diverse psychology disciplines, gaining insights and support throughout your research journey. Collaborate with your supervisor to explore opportunities for sharing your work with the wider academic community via journals, conferences, blogs, and more. Study support Custom-made support for your psychology conversion degree studies Alongside the extensive support available to all Arden students, our online MSc Psychology conversion course offers a personalised support system to help you succeed. Supporting your studies: Live and asynchronous teaching: Each module includes 10 asynchronous lessons (9 for new modules) with interactive activities available as soon as you enrol, plus 8 live teaching sessions per week delivered by your module lecturers. This combination ensures flexibility while maintaining a structured learning experience. Draft feedback opportunities: Every module allows submission of draft work (up to 1,200 words) for formative feedback, helping you refine your work before final assessment. 1-to-1 support: You can book weekly live drop-in sessions with your module lecturer for personalised guidance. Peer guides and learning assistants: Peer guides are active Arden students who have completed your modules and provide fresh perspectives, while learning assistants help make new topics more accessible. Quarterly programme leader feedback: Work with your programme leader to co-create your learning experience and ensure it aligns with your ambitions. Access to specialist research software: Licences for Jamovi (data analysis) and Gorilla (experiment design) are included, giving you hands-on research experience. Free BPS student membership: Gain access to a wealth of resources and networking opportunities within the psychology profession. Study skills workshops: Join workshops and study groups to build strong academic skills, particularly useful at the start of your degree. This tailored combination of live teaching, draft feedback, 1-to-1 support, and specialist tools ensures you gain practical research skills and confidence throughout your MSc Psychology conversion course. Supporting your future: Hear from industry experts who share their insights and experiences, giving you a unique view of the career opportunities a psychology MSc can open up, and helping you build your professional network. You’ll also benefit from extracurricular opportunities to enhance your employability, including annual student conferences where you can showcase your work and make valuable professional connections. Psychology conversion course study options This MSc Psychology conversion course is available to students as a fully online programme, which gives you the convenience of being able to study from anywhere worldwide. The assignments were challenging -in a good way. They were relevant to what we learned and interesting to complete. Being able to contact my module tutor - either in the discussion forums or by email- was tremendously helpful. I feel that my concerns and questions were taken seriously, and the feedback was genuinely helpful. Rudolf Eigenheer MSc Psychology Online learning How does it work? Studying this course online gives you the ultimate in convenience. You can enrol with Arden from anywhere in the world and study your degree from the comfort of home, without the requirement to attend classes in a physical location. Our online students study their degree through ilearn, Arden’s university campus in the cloud.  ilearn provides everything you need to study at University. It offers an integrated virtual learning experience, including your virtual classroom, lecture theatre, and access to our Library Portal. The portal includes an extensive digital library including thousands of journal titles, eBooks, and academic and industry databases which you can use to research your assignments and projects. All of these materials are provided to you free of charge, and contain all the research information you’ll need to complete your degree with us. iLearn is also integrated with Zoom, making it easier to chat with your course tutor during your scheduled seminar sessions. You can even integrate our study materials into your Kindle, making it possible to study wherever you have your Kindle handy. Studying online doesn’t mean studying alone. As well as receiving regular feedback and guidance from your course tutor, you’ll be studying with likeminded students who you can meet with through our Unitu community, and you’ll have access to community message boards to discuss your course and the topics being raised within it. We’ve even set up community boards embedded into each of the course modules so you can have discussions with your tutor and classmates on the topics you’re currently learning. Learn more about online learning Psychology conversion master's entry requirements What do you need to study with us? Our aim is to make learning as accessible as possible by ensuring that you can study your degree in a flexible and convenient way. That's why we keep our requirements simple. All you need is a laptop or desktop PC (we recommend one running the latest version of Windows), and a good internet connection. Please note that if you’re using a Chromebook, only those released in 2020 onwards support Jamovi, which is an essential requirement for the statistical elements of the course. Through ilearn, our online university campus in the cloud, you'll be able to access your course calendar, support services, learning materials, and our online library containing almost half a million texts, as well as creating assignments, keeping notes, and collaborating with other students on your course. Eligibility Our online MSc Psychology conversion (BPS accredited) degree has standard entry requirements. To be able to study this course, we need to see that you have: A UK honours degree or equivalent in any subject at 2:2 or above. If your degree is in psychology, it must not be accredited by the BPS. A Third Class UK honours degree or equivalent in psychology if you also possess a master’s-level degree. Students that do not hold a UK (Hons) degree, or have a degree without honours will need to evidence independent research shown through, for example, a final year project dissertation or thesis. You may provide this evidence from Master's level if your undergraduate degree didn’t include this. If you hold a degree on an accredited psychology programme where the empirical component of the course was failed, your application will be reviewed on a case by case basis. We also require a maths qualification or equivalent to at least Grade C at GCSE. However if you are unable to evidence a GCSE or equivalent in maths, you will be able to complete a maths mini module which has no formal assessment. Applications for admission with advanced standing on the basis of prior certificated learning will be considered on an individual basis up to a maximum of 60 credits. English Proficiency IELTS 6.5 (no less than 6.0 in any element); or TOEFL iBT 90; or equivalent Alternatively, a letter to show that the Medium of Instruction was in English is accepted We will consider alternative qualifications to evidence the maths component, as this qualification includes research methods which involves statistics. We’ll ask you for a personal statement that demonstrates your ability to study the course. We may also want references and evidence of relevant experiences. If you don’t already have a degree, we may be able to offer you a place on one of our undergraduate degree programmes, such as our BSc (Hons) Psychology degree . Course fees and funding Funding and Scholarships We also offer a range of scholarships and funding support for eligible students, including options for UK, international, and UK-based international students. Start your application and an education advisor will be in touch to discuss your options. Meet the faculty The Faculty of Social Sciences and Technology is currently overseen by Professor Brian Smith, Deputy Provost. Bringing more than three decades of experience, Brian has been awarded the prestigious Higher Education Academy National Teaching Fellow for excellence in developing inspiring and innovative new learning and teaching models in global higher education. This work was core to his PhD to understand learner behaviour and ontological needs in the classroom, blended and online learning. He carries a wealth of experience and has touched a variety of disciplines – including healthcare, psychology, technology, law and engineering, to name a few. He also holds the title of Advance HE Principal Fellow, and Accreditor status for reviewing fellowships. Brian has contributed to several initiatives in his career, some of which has included authoring End point Assessments for Apprenticeships (Institute for Apprenticeships), Micro-credential characteristics (Quality Assurance Agency), TEF 2023 panel member (Office for Students), editor reviewer for journals, and authoring publications such as Creativity: An unsolved enigma. Professor Brian Smith Deputy Provost Career prospects At postgraduate level, you’ve probably already got solid career goals in mind. Our aim is to take you on the journey to achieving those goals, equipping you with a range of transferable skills that will give you the upper hand as a future employee – in whichever industry you feel is right for you. Related courses BSc (Hons) Psychology (BPS) MSc Business Psychology BSc (Hons) Psychology with Counselling BSc Psychology with Counselling and Mental Health Psychology Articles Career Advice What can an online MSc psychology conversion degree do for me? Achieving a degree at master’s level in psychology will open up a world of career opportunities. While studying, you’ll become proficient in: How our brain influences our perception of the world Social interaction Psychopathological conditions Approaches to intelligence testing Childhood development Behavioural neuroscience What can I do after Arden University? After successfully completing your MSc psychology conversion course via distance learning, you’ll have acquired a range of skills that will be appealing to several industries. Employers know that a successful psychology graduate at master’s level can go above and beyond when it comes to understanding and analysing human behaviour. With that in mind, a few career options for you could include: Civil Service Marketing Consultant Teacher Researcher HR Professional Management Business Leader Or if you want to continue your journey towards becoming a registered Practitioner Psychologist it will allow you to apply for MSc accredited courses in Psychology specific disciplines.  Keep a look out for future MSc discipline specific courses with us at Arden University. Our MSc Psychology students have gone onto earn up to £80,000 within 2 years of graduation* *Source: 2020/21 Graduate Outcomes Survey Industry skills The British Psychological Society (BPS) The British Psychological Society (BPS) is the representative body for psychology and psychologists in the UK. The society is responsible for the development, promotion, and application of psychology for the public good. Arden’s BSc MSc Psychology (Conversion) course is accredited by the BPS. This means that upon graduation students will be eligible for the society’s Graduate Basis for Chartered Membership - the prerequisite requirement to go on to further training as a professional psychologist after graduation. While you’re studying your BPS accredited course with us, we’ll cover the cost of your student membership with the BPS, which gives you access to a large range of useful resources including access to the British Psychological Society Library, the UK’s leading national resource in psychology. The British Psychological Society (BPS) and the Psychological Society of Ireland (PSI) have a memorandum of Cooperation to recognise one another's accreditations, meaning that a BPS accredited degree can qualify you for graduate membership to the PSI, which is the pathway to work as a psychologist in Ireland. After your first study block, we’ll submit your application for BPS Student Membership and cover the cost for the rest of your MSc if accepted. You will be subject to the BPS terms of membership, which can be found here. If you do not want us to automatically enrol you, please let us know prior to the end of your first study block. Campaign for Social Science Arden University is a member of the Campaign for Social Science. The Campaign demonstrates how social science improves public policy, society, and all our lives. It highlights the value of applied social science research and advocates for its greater use in decision-making and in government. It is supported by a coalition of universities, social science societies, and publishers. As a member, Arden receives access to case studies, research into the value provided by social sciences, and insights into the employability of social science graduates. Through this, you will gain a better understanding of the skills you are learning and their value to employers. Study abroad in UK London                   Stratford Manchester Apply today Speak to an advisor Register interest What makes Arden University special? Education for everyone, everywhere Whether you're constrained by location, cost, time, or other life commitments, we're passionate about giving you access to higher education that fits into your busy, modern life. You decide how and where to study We offer a wide range of flexible undergraduate and postgraduate degrees in both our online and blended study modes. Full support both online and on-site We're also proud to offer non-standard entry, meaning your work experience and previous qualifications are taken into account when assessing your application. Strong focus on employability You will gain in-depth subject knowledge and transferable skills that employers from a huge range of industries will value. Many of our courses at Arden are also accredited by leading professional bodies in the UK. Course Overview This dual professionally accredited (DMI and CIM) MSc Strategic Digital Marketing course will teach you the core principles and skills at use in marketing today. Given the constantly evolving marketing landscape, this course is designed for professional marketers looking to move into more senior roles. It provides complementary knowledge of the latest trends in marketing such as big data, user experience (UX), Martech, and AI alongside skills in brand building, leadership, and digital creativity. Taking a modern, global, and practice-based approach, this master’s in strategic digital marketing is regularly updated to reflect the latest insights from leading industry experts and academics. Throughout the course, you’ll have the chance to analyse current areas of marketing practice by examining live client case studies taken from real-world practice. This provides the skill set you’ll need to respond to future changes in marketing technology and consumer experience, helping you future-proof your career through the ability to adapt your marketing knowledge to any environment. Designed to open up a variety of career opportunities in marketing, the course will show you how to create structured, strategic marketing plans with digital tactics and tools for any organisation or business – a highly sought-after skill in today’s job market. The course integrates a variety of leading-edge digital tools and software, helping you evaluate the application of marketing strategies and tactics in context. That means you’ll graduate with a deeper understanding of how to successfully shape high-level marketing activities and manage creative global marketing plans. Find out more about Business at Arden Video • 2 mins Accreditation and Memberships DMI Accredited The Digital Marketing Institute is the gold standard in digital marketing certification, and gives students free membership during their studies. CIM Accredited CIM accreditation means students will be able to gain industry-recognised qualifications at an accelerated pace. BGA Membership Arden University is a member of the Business Graduates Association (BGA), meaning students will receive complementary BGA membership. Quick tools Explore your brochure Download the course brochure to take a look at your course modules and syllabus content. Download brochure Speak to an advisor Want to speak to one of our subject experts? Our advisors are ready to answer your questions! Click below to get started. Show me how Professional accreditation This course is accredited by the Chartered Institute of Marketing (CIM) and Digital Marketing Institute (DMI), both respected professional bodies in the promotion of successful marketing courses. Learn more Course details and modules During the course, you’ll explore the general marketing environment as a whole and then consider the impacts of digitisation on the contemporary marketing environment. You’ll develop the ability to critically analyse data and apply marketing theories from technical and creative perspectives, helping you become a highly capable and employable marketing professional. The course will help you build practical skills in areas such as social media scheduling, Google ads, social media marketing, UX design, SEO, and AI, as well as the ability to develop advanced digital marketing strategies. You’ll also have the opportunity to gain an international marketing perspective while networking with students from around the world. Meeting the tutors and students online and then having the opportunity to meet again in person is such an incredible experience. The courses are well explicated and the tutors are great. Classes are engaging and students are supportive of each other. I’m proud to be an Arden student and I would certainly recommend this course to others. Youssef Yehya MSc Strategic Digital Marketing - Berlin Campus Core Modules Digital Marketing Environment (20 Credits) Building and Managing Digital Brands (20 Credits) Contemporary Marketing Communications Planning (20 Credits) Big Data, Analytics and Martech (20 Credits) Managing Customer & User Experience (20 Credits) Social Media Marketing (20 Credits) Digital Transformation Project (Capstone Project, 60 credits) For full details on your module content, click here to download the brochure . How do we assess you? Your assessment takes place entirely through coursework that has been designed to mirror professional marketing practice to enhance your employability. This will give you the opportunity to apply the knowledge and skills gained in each module in the context of ‘real world’ strategic digital marketing scenarios. These include: The creation of marketing campaign plans The design of digital marketing artefacts Building customer journey maps Live client briefs tackling real marketing challenges Digital marketing consultancy project Study options This course is available to study full-time at our campus in Berlin, Germany, or through our blended learning study mode in London Stratford and Manchester. The course is also available to students via online learning . This gives you the convenience of being able to study worldwide, providing you with the same high standards of teaching but with lower tuition fees. Denise's Story: How distance learning is helping me add to my experience Read now Full time, blended learning How does it work? Our blended learning study mode combines structured in-person learning with the flexibility of guided independent study. You’ll attend eight hours of timetabled, face-to-face classes each week, spread over two days at your chosen Arden University campus. Alongside this, you’ll spend approximately 25 hours each week on independent study. You’ll use iLearn, our digital learning platform, to access key resources, submit assignments, and stay connected with your tutors and classmates. Whether you prefer studying in our on-campus learning spaces or at home, you’ll be supported throughout your journey. Blended learning is ideal if you value regular in-person teaching and want the flexibility to balance your studies with other commitments. With classes concentrated over just two days, you’ll have more control over your time, while still benefiting from face-to-face interaction and access to university facilities. This course is also available to study full-time at our Berlin, Germany campus. Learn more about Blended Learning Part time, online learning How does it work? Studying this course online gives you the ultimate in convenience. You can enrol with Arden from anywhere in the world and study your degree from the comfort of home, without the requirement to attend classes in a physical location. Our online students study their degree through ilearn, Arden’s university campus in the cloud. ilearn provides everything you need to study at University. It offers an integrated virtual learning experience, including your virtual classroom, lecture theatre, and access to our Library Portal. The portal includes an extensive digital library including thousands of journal titles, eBooks, and academic and industry databases which you can use to research your assignments and projects. All of these materials are provided to you free of charge, and contain all the research information you’ll need to complete your degree with us. ilearn is also integrated with Zoom, making it easier to chat with your course tutor during your scheduled seminar sessions. You can even integrate our study materials into your Kindle, making it possible to study wherever you have you Kindle handy. Studying online doesn’t mean studying alone. As well as receiving regular feedback and guidance from your course tutor, you’ll be studying with likeminded students who you can meet with through our Unitu community, and you’ll have access to community message boards to discuss your course and the topics being raised within it. We’ve even set up community boards embedded into each of the course modules so you can have discussions with your tutor and classmates on the topics you’re currently learning. Learn more about online learning Entry requirements At Arden University we consider applications on a case by case basis. If you have significant work experience, have qualifications you have gained elsewhere, or a degree or qualification that isn't a clear pathway to this degree - we are more than happy to discuss your application. Eligibility To be eligible for our MSc Strategic Digital Marketing, we need to see that you have: A UK bachelor’s degree at a minimum of second class (2.2) or equivalent Individuals who have HND/HNC/Dip HE, with three to four years strong professional work experience with evidence of managerial/supervisory responsibilities are also encouraged to apply. We also consider applications from candidates who lack formal qualifications but possess at least five years of relevant managerial experience in any discipline. English proficiency Online Learning: IELTS 6.5 (no less than 6.0 in any element); or TOEFL iBT 90; or equivalent Blended Learning in the UK or full-time study in Berlin: IELTS 6.0 (no less than 5.5 in any element); or TOEFL iBT 60-78; or equivalent. Free English language support is also available at the Arden Berlin campus. Alternatively, evidence you have previously studied in English; a letter to show that the Medium of Instruction was in English can be accepted If you require a visa to study in the UK You must meet the academic entry requirements for this course. You’ll need an IELTS score of 6.0 (with no less than 5.5 in any element) or an equivalent Secure English Language Test (SELT) result. Meet the faculty For over twenty years, Gillian worked in senior marketing positions leading teams and directing the marketing strategy for several high-profile tourism, events, and cultural venues in the UK. Gillian joined Arden, where she has been responsible for setting up the department and planning an innovative suite of digital marketing and sales programmes. In her role at Arden, Gillian strives to help our ambitious students to grow faster, equipping them with the latest innovative marketing skills for them to be successful in their marketing careers. Gillian McCurdy Head of Department - Marketing Career prospects Studying your master’s in strategic digital marketing degree with Arden University is all about preparing yourself for a successful future career. As well as mastering a number of advanced skills, you’ll graduate with a stand-out CV that sets you apart in today’s competitive job market. So, whether you want to progress to more senior positions in your current organisation, or you want to begin a new career in marketing after working in a different discipline, this course will provide you with the knowledge and competencies you need to succeed. related courses MSc Business Transformation Master of Business Administration (MBA) Business and Management Articles Marketing Articles Career Advice What will MSc Strategic Digital Marketing do for me? You’ll gain a wide range of leadership, technical, and creative skills and the knowledge to develop successful innovative marketing strategies. And, because we focus on the practical application of your studies to the real world, you’ll find that these marketing skills are transferable across a wide range of roles. Whilst studying, you will: Develop analytical and planning skills in a digital marketing context. Develop skills in designing and implementing marketing strategies in the digital business environment. Explore the challenges presented by “big data” sets in a marketing context. Evaluate, interrogate, and analyse marketing-focused data sets relating to consumer user experience and behaviour, brands, and communications. Evaluate the potential and effectiveness of relevant proprietary software and digital marketing tools. Gain practical skills in areas such as website analytics, SEO, email marketing, social media marketing, digital advertising, website creation, copywriting, and graphic design. Develop a variety of transferable skills suited to an extensive range of marketing positions. What can I do after Arden University? This strategic digital marketing course will help you develop the right skills and knowledge to accelerate your career to a senior marketing role. Our academics work to ensure that the modules you study on the course cover real marketing scenarios and are career focused. This means that when you graduate, you’ll have the skills required to enter a variety of professional marketing roles. Knowledge of digital marketing and marketing theory is applicable to a range of business sectors, from technology and FMCG to healthcare and the non-profit/charity sector. Some future roles that you might want to consider after graduation include: Marketing Director Digital Marketing Manager Senior Marketing Executive/Analyst Head of Sales and Marketing Email Marketing Specialist Social Media Planner/Manager Brand/Product Manager UX Designer Video Content Developer Business Owner/Entrepreneur Industry skills Dual accredited by the Digital Marketing Institute (DMI) and Chartered Institute of Marketing (CIM) Arden University is one of the few institutions offering dual accreditation by the DMI and CIM, meaning your degree will give you valuable professional recognition across the globe. Digital Marketing Institute (DMI) Highly acclaimed and globally recognised across the digital marketing sector, the Digital Marketing Institute (DMI) is the gold standard in digital marketing certification and works to support today’s marketers in achieving their full professional potential. The DMI partners with representatives from leading brands such as Google, Facebook, Microsoft, and LinkedIn to build a framework that bridges the digital skills gap, ensuring your curriculum is up-to-date and meets the real employability needs of the digital marketing industry. While you’re studying your DMI accredited course with us, we’ll cover the cost of your student membership , giving you access to a wide range of valuable resources, including exclusive industry-focused short courses, webinars, articles, and toolkits, careers guidance, and networking opportunities with its 170,000+ global members. Chartered Institute of Marketing (CIM) Students completing this course will gain exemptions for CIM Certificate and Diploma qualifications, meaning you will only need to complete one or two modules instead of three. The Chartered Institute of Marketing (CIM) is the world’s largest organisation for professional marketers and plays a key role in setting industry standards. The CIM helps and supports its members at every stage of their marketing careers, helping you develop your marketing capabilities and keeping you informed about industry developments and employment opportunities across the sector – focusing on providing you with the ‘4Cs’ of CIM membership: Career, Capability, Community and Content. The cost of your CIM Affiliate Membership is included while you are studying with us, which gives you access to all of these resources and more. Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business (AACSB) membership. Arden University is a member of the prestigious Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business (AACSB). AACSB International is a global association of leaders in education and business dedicated to supporting and advancing quality business education worldwide. This membership reflects the fact that Arden University has successfully matched the high standards required by the AACSB, and enables the sharing of ideas and the exchange best practises between global business schools. Membership also gives our faculty members access to in-depth data and research to support the development of our courses and teaching methods, ensuring that we are able to provide you with the best possible university experience. Business Graduates Association (BGA) The BGA is a membership and quality assurance body. As a member, Arden University have signed up to the BGA Charter, committing their institution to responsible management practices and lifelong learning, positively impacting their students, communities, and the economy. This shows our students that we are demonstrating responsible management ourselves, as well as it being a central theme that runs through our own courses. As Arden University is a member of the Business Graduates Association (BGA), students will receive complementary BGA student and graduate membership. Through this membership, current students will have access to the BGA Career Development Centre, packed with interactive tools, e-learning content, partner discounts and the latest job opportunities. This is a lifetime access, which means students will continue to have access to these services even after they graduate.
