Meet the faculty Hassaan Khan brings 15 years of experience as a senior academic in higher education. Hassaan studied accounting and finance at the University of Kent, followed by an MSc and PhD in Finance from Durham University. Prior to joining Arden, he was associate dean at the Global Banking School, looking after the finance and business management degrees. Hassaan was director of programmes at BPP University where he was responsible for degrees in finance and applied management as well as professional courses and degree apprenticeships in accountancy. Dr. Hassaan Khan Head of School - School of Management and Executive Education Career prospects Ready to progress to a senior management role? Our Executive MBA (Finance) degree gives you with the skills you need, from strategic thinking, to personal transformation, to change leadership. Whichever stage of the economic cycle we find ourselves in, the specialist attributes you will develop on this course are highly valued by private and public sector organisations alike. Related courses Executive MBA Executive MBA (Data Analytics) Related Articles Business and Management Articles Accounting and Finance Articles Career Advice What can the MBA (Finance) do for me? If you’re already working in a professional role and looking to take the next step to senior management, the Executive MBA (Finance) will help you to develop and demonstrate the skills you need. Whilst studying, you’ll: Demonstrate your planning, problem-solving and strategic-thinking skills Become a confident communicator in all business scenarios Develop your financial management knowledge and skills Develop deep knowledge in your chosen specialist area Develop the ability to take a wider-world perspective on issues such as diversity and ethics Completed projects and activities that have had a positive impact on your organisation What can I do after Arden University? Where do you want to go next? Our Executive MBA prepares you for senior and leadership roles, whether you choose to stay with your current employer or embark on a fresh challenge. Industry skills Chartered Management Institute (CMI) This course awards a CMI Level 7 Diploma in Strategic Management & Leadership Practice * The Chartered Management Institute (CMI) promotes excellence in UK management and leadership. As the CMI possesses a Royal Charter, they are the only organisation in the UK that can award Chartered Manager status to their members – the gold standard in management. With 140,000 members, the institute aims to boost career development across the management sector and connect like-minded professionals. As an Arden student, you’ll have free CMI Membership throughout your studies, giving you access to a range of additional resources including a mentoring service and invitations to networking events both online and offline. Upon completion of this CMI-accredited course, you will be awarded CMI Level 7 Diploma in Strategic Management & Leadership Practice. This recognises you have the skills needed to be an effective manager, helping you stand out from the competition and start your management career journey - with a CMI qualification and a clear pathway to full Chartered Manager status. *Upon completion of your course, the CMI award and level of chartered status awarded will depend on your level and length of study, whether you entered your course with Recognition for Prior Learning (RPL) or if any compensation is applied on your modules throughout the duration of study. If this criteria applies to you, you may receive one of the 2 different levels; an Award or Certificate. The Institute of Enterprise and Entrepreneurs (IOEE) Arden University is an approved IOEE Centre of Excellence, highlighting our commitment to staying at the forefront of education and industry standards. We continuously update our services to meet market and student needs and offer IOEE membership to our staff, students, and learners. This course awards the IOEE Professional Extended Diploma in Business Innovation and Growth The Institute of Enterprise and Entrepreneurs (IOEE) is the first learning institute dedicated to developing and recognising enterprise and entrepreneurial skills. Arden University has been recognised as an IOEE Academy and our courses are accredited. This demonstrates our commitment to enterprise and equipping students with the skills needed to set up and run their own business, work in a small enterprise, or bring entrepreneurial skills to a larger organisation. Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business (AACSB) membership. Arden University is a member of the prestigious Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business (AACSB). AACSB International is a global association of leaders in education and business dedicated to supporting and advancing quality business education worldwide. This membership reflects the fact that Arden University has successfully matched the high standards required by the AACSB, and enables the sharing of ideas and the exchange best practises between global business schools. Membership also gives our faculty members access to in-depth data and research to support the development of our courses and teaching methods, ensuring that we are able to provide you with the best possible university experience. Business Graduates Association (BGA) The BGA is a membership and quality assurance body. As a member, Arden University have signed up to the BGA Charter, committing their institution to responsible management practices and lifelong learning, positively impacting their students, communities, and the economy. This shows our students that we are demonstrating responsible management ourselves, as well as it being a central theme that runs through our own courses. As Arden University is a member of the Business Graduates Association (BGA), students will receive complementary BGA student and graduate membership. Through this membership, current students will have access to the BGA Career Development Centre, packed with interactive tools, e-learning content, partner discounts and the latest job opportunities. This is a lifetime access, which means students will continue to have access to these services even after they graduate. Arden Enterprise Incubator As an Arden University student, you’ll have access to the Arden Enterprise Incubator (AEI) online platform to support you in the area of entrepreneurship. Whether students are exploring the idea of setting up their own company or need help and guidance launching or growing an existing business, the AEI provides everything students need to kick start their entrepreneurial journey, as well as to support and empower them along the way. The AEI has a wealth of resources available including monthly master classes, boot camps, podcasts, blogs, external events, and mentorship. Mentors include Arden University lecturers and industry experts, so our students receive the very best support and expertise. As an IOEE Centre of Excellence, we foster an entrepreneurial culture among our students. We are dedicated to supporting their continuous growth by promoting enterprising thinking and practical entrepreneurial skills. Education for everyone, everywhere Whether you're constrained by location, cost, time, or other life commitments, we're passionate about giving you access to higher education that fits into your busy, modern life. You decide how and where to study We offer a wide range of flexible undergraduate and postgraduate degrees in both our online and blended study modes. Full support both online and on-site We're also proud to offer non-standard entry, meaning your work experience and previous qualifications are taken into account when assessing your application. Strong focus on employability You will gain in-depth subject knowledge and transferable skills that employers from a huge range of industries will value. Many of our courses at Arden are also accredited by leading professional bodies in the UK. Course Overview Our new MBA course has been specifically developed to provide you with a gateway to management and leadership roles. Whether you already have management experience, or preparing for your first role in business, this MBA qualification will provide you with the skills and competence you need to excel in your career. The ideal option if you’re fresh out of your undergraduate degree or have limited work experience, this course gives you the unique opportunity to use your MBA qualification as a gateway into a managerial role. You’ll develop in-depth industry knowledge of contemporary business operations and the ability to apply emerging trends and innovations to leverage strategic business transformations. Through its focus on the most up-to-date, practice-based learning, the course will help you gain the specialised skills required to start a successful career in today’s dynamic business environment. You’ll also be introduced to state-of-the-art virtual business simulations, helping you in responding to the many opportunities and challenges you might face in your future management role. By placing professional development at its core, you’ll graduate from the MBA with the workplace readiness to enter the business world with confidence. That means that by the end of the course, you’ll have developed the real-world skills needed to lead and manage in today’s agile working environment. This, combined with your knowledge of how to  drive positive business change will give you a powerful, modern skillset sought after by leading employers in a range of exciting industries. The UK’s number two Online MBA as ranked by CEO Magazine for two years running Graduate Interview with Simon Henry Video • 1 min Accreditation and Memberships CMI Accredited This course awards a CMI Level 7 Diploma in Strategic Management and Leadership Practice and grants graduates Foundation Chartered Manager Status. BGA Membership Arden University is a member of the Business Graduates Association (BGA), meaning students will receive complementary BGA membership. AACSB Membership Arden University is a member of the prestigious Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business (AACSB). The Institute of Enterprise and Entrepreneurs (IOEE) This course awards the IOEE Professional Extended Diploma in Business Innovation and Growth. Quick tools Explore your brochure Download the course brochure to take a look at your course modules and syllabus content. Download brochure Speak to an advisor Want to speak to one of our subject experts? Our advisors are ready to answer your questions! Click below to get started. Show me how Professional accreditation This course is accredited by the Chartered Management Institute, supporting your career and connecting you with likeminded professionals. Learn more Course details and modules This MBA will engage and inspire you through course modules that have been devised by our experienced business and management practitioners to give your studies a ‘real world’ focus. Our use of live client case studies and practice-based learning will build your confidence in making strategic managerial decisions and provide you with in-demand skills for your future career. Throughout the course you’ll be encouraged to work closely with your peers, exchanging your professional experiences to learn and grow as a group. This will help you establish an international network of fellow professionals with whom you can continue to build inspiring relationships long after your degree comes to a close you complete your studies with us. You’ll also be taught by an expert and skilled academic team with a diverse mix of business practitioner, consultancy, and research experience, and with some having published in leading-edge academic journals. I’ve found that studying my degree online with Arden has given me a much more comprehensive foundation of knowledge around the topics I don’t often encounter in my work role, including financial decision-making, ethics and strategy. This knowledge will enable me to progress to more strategic roles in the future. Simon Henry MBA Online Course Modules Professional Practice in Business & Management (20 credits) Competitive Strategy (20 credits) Financial Management (20 credits) Introduction to Supply Chain Management (20 credits) Leading People (20 credits) Social Media Marketing (20 credits) Business Project (60 credits) For full details on your module content, click here to download the brochure . How do we assess you? Assessments Unlike on more traditional business degrees, you won’t be sitting any exams on this course. Assessments on this MBA have been designed to help you apply your learning to real-word scenarios by engaging in live client case studies and business simulations. This means you’ll have the opportunity to align your studies to how you can help transform your future organisation’s operations and functions once you have completed the course. Practice-driven Your course assessments will be practice-driven, drawing from your learning material , while also encouraging discussion and collaboration with your international peers. This modern approach will encourage you to apply your knowledge to new organisational challenges within both local and global contexts. Virtual simulations During your studies you’ll have the opportunity to use virtual simulations to predict, model, and scenario build for future business decisions and operations, enabling you to respond to real life opportunities and challenges that may appear in your future managerial or leadership roles. Through these virtual simulations, you’ll have the freedom to try out different solutions within a safe environment, without the potential consequences that could arise from ‘trial and error’ in the real world. This will help you build up confidence in decision-making, preparing you for the hands-on experience of real-world business practice. Other assessment methods Throughout the course you’ll have the opportunity to apply your learning through additional assessments. Designed with industry feedback to meet the needs of today’s employers, each assessment will impart both subject knowledge and desirable workplace skills. These include: Transformation plan Group work Negotiated assessment Personal audit Presentation Critical reflection Portfolio Podcasts/Vodcasts Marketing plan and social media campaign Project/consultancy report Study options This course is available to study full-time at our campus in Berlin, Germany , or through our blended learning study mode in London Stratford and Manchester . The course is also available to students via online learning . This gives you the convenience of being able to study from anywhere in the UK or worldwide, providing you with the same high standards of teaching but with lower tuition fees. This course is being offered via full-time for International students at our Tower Hill campus. Find out more here. As a mature student the key factors that I wanted when deciding which university was best for me was quality content, a flexible learning schedule, and programme accreditation. During my research I found that Arden really stood out, and I could study without having to give up my job. Abdulrahaman Usman Master of Business Administration Full-time blended learning How does it work? Our blended learning study mode combines structured in-person learning with the flexibility of guided independent study. You’ll attend eight hours of timetabled, face-to-face classes each week, spread over two days at your chosen Arden University campus. Alongside this, you’ll spend approximately 25 hours each week on independent study. You’ll use iLearn, our digital learning platform, to access key resources, submit assignments, and stay connected with your tutors and classmates. Whether you prefer studying in our on-campus learning spaces or at home, you’ll be supported throughout your journey. Blended learning is ideal if you value regular in-person teaching and want the flexibility to balance your studies with other commitments. With classes concentrated over just two days, you’ll have more control over your time, while still benefiting from face-to-face interaction and access to university facilities. This course is also available to study full-time at our Berlin, Germany campus. Learn more about blended learning Part-time online learning How does it work? Studying your degree online with Arden means you can earn your degree from anywhere in the world without the requirement to attend classes in a physical location. Our online students study their degree through iLearn, Arden’s university campus in the cloud. Online learning students resident in the UK can apply for a Maintenance Loan if they cannot attend their course in person because of a disability. Please find more information on our fees and funding page . If you're a student from Scotland, Wales or Northern Ireland you can find information on Living Cost Loans from your student finance body. Learn more about online learning Entry requirements At Arden University we consider applications on a case by case basis. If you have significant work experience, have qualifications you have gained elsewhere, or a degree or qualification that isn't a clear pathway to this degree - we are more than happy to discuss your application. Eligibility To be eligible for our MBA, you should normally have: A bachelor’s degree at 2.2 or above, or international equivalent. If your degree was completed over 5 years ago, you will be required to submit a CV with your application. Applicants who hold professional qualifications and have 2 years relevant work experience are also encouraged to apply. English proficiency Online Learning: IELTS 6.5 (no less than 6.0 in any element); or TOEFL iBT 90; or equivalent Blended Learning in the UK or full-time study in Berlin: IELTS 6.0 (no less than 5.5 in any element); or TOEFL iBT 60-78; or equivalent. Free English language support is also available at the Arden Berlin campus. Alternatively, evidence you have previously studied in English; a letter to show that the Medium of Instruction was in English can be accepted If you require a visa to study in the UK You must meet the academic entry requirements for this course. You’ll need an IELTS score of 6.0 (with no less than 5.5 in any element) or an equivalent Secure English Language Test (SELT) result. Meet the faculty Hassaan Khan brings 15 years of experience as a senior academic in higher education. Hassaan studied accounting and finance at the University of Kent, followed by an MSc and PhD in Finance from Durham University. Prior to joining Arden, he was associate dean at the Global Banking School, looking after the finance and business management degrees. Hassaan was director of programmes at BPP University where he was responsible for degrees in finance and applied management as well as professional courses and degree apprenticeships in accountancy. Dr. Hassaan Khan Head of School - School of Management and Executive Education Career prospects The skills you gain on this course will be transferable to the public and private sector, so the opportunities are endless. By providing you with the same competencies as a traditional MBA, this MBA degree  will give you the portfolio you need to demonstrate senior-level leadership, enhancing your CV for current and future employers. Related courses Executive MBA MBA (Top-Up) Executive MBA (Finance) Related articles Business and Management articles Career Advice What will the MBA do for me? You’ll graduate from the course with a full MBA and hands-on managerial and technical experience, giving you the tools you need to power successful business management. You’ll also have expanded your knowledge of contemporary business fundamentals and practices , all within a real-world context. Due to this focus on the practical application of your syllabus, you’ll find that the knowledge and expertise you’ve gained is valuable across diverse professional roles. This course provides you with the valuable opportunity to: Understand and apply the management and leadership skills required to succeed in the contemporary business environment. Explore the analytical challenges presented by Big Data sets. Evaluate the contribution of technology to inform the development of innovative strategic plans and competitive advantage. Analyse the effectiveness of technology relevant to contemporary business management and transformations. Develop your managerial and leadership skills What can I do after Arden University? The MBA will help you develop the right skills and knowledge to accelerate your career to a senior leadership role in business management, change, and transformation. Whether you want to join or continue working for an already established business, start your own company, or become a consultant, the course will give you everything you need to explore multiple career paths. Some roles you may want to consider after graduation include: Marketing Manager HR Manager Business Consultant Management Consultant Business Development Manager Business Operations Manager Product Manager Our MBA students have gone onto earn up to £82,600 within 2 years of graduation* * Source: 2020/21 Graduate Outcomes Survey Industry skills Chartered Management Institute (CMI) This course awards a CMI Level 7 Diploma in Strategic Management & Leadership Practice and offers CMI Foundation Chartered Manager Status * The Chartered Management Institute (CMI) promotes excellence in UK management and leadership. As the CMI possesses a Royal Charter, they are the only organisation in the UK that can award Chartered Manager status to their members – the gold standard in management. With 140,000 members, the institute aims to boost career development across the management sector and connect like-minded professionals. As an Arden student, you’ll have free CMI Membership throughout your studies, giving you access to a range of additional resources including a mentoring service and invitations to networking events both online and offline. Upon completion of this CMI-accredited course, you will be awarded CMI Level 7 Diploma in Strategic Management & Leadership Practice and gain CMI Foundation Chartered Manager Status. This recognises you have the skills needed to be an effective manager, helping you stand out from the competition and start your management career journey - with a CMI qualification and a clear pathway to full Chartered Manager status. *Upon completion of your course, the CMI award and level of chartered status awarded will depend on your level and length of study, whether you entered your course with Recognition for Prior Learning (RPL) or if any compensation is applied on your modules throughout the duration of study. If this criteria applies to you, you may receive one of the 2 different levels; an Award or Certificate. Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business (AACSB) membership. Arden University is a member of the prestigious Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business (AACSB). AACSB International is a global association of leaders in education and business dedicated to supporting and advancing quality business education worldwide. This membership reflects the fact that Arden University has successfully matched the high standards required by the AACSB, and enables the sharing of ideas and the exchange best practises between global business schools. Membership also gives our faculty members access to in-depth data and research to support the development of our courses and teaching methods, ensuring that we are able to provide you with the best possible university experience. Capsim Capsim is an award-winning, market-leading provider of business simulations. Founded in 1985, Capsim has more than 35 years’ experience in creating business simulations and comprehensive assessments for educational programmes. While studying this degree with us, you’ll have free student access to Capsim, where you’ll be able to build the real-world business skills you need to grow and succeed. Through intuitive, easy-to-use simulations, Capsim tools will provide you with hands-on experience making strategic business decisions in an immersive, engaging environment. Using Capsim, you’ll have a risk-free environment to apply concepts, test new ideas, and gain quality feedback as you compete to grow your business in a dynamic environment. Business Graduates Association (BGA) The BGA is a membership and quality assurance body. As a member, Arden University have signed up to the BGA Charter, committing their institution to responsible management practices and lifelong learning, positively impacting their students, communities, and the economy. This shows our students that we are demonstrating responsible management ourselves, as well as it being a central theme that runs through our own courses. As Arden University is a member of the Business Graduates Association (BGA), students will receive complementary BGA student and graduate membership. Through this membership, current students will have access to the BGA Career Development Centre, packed with interactive tools, e-learning content, partner discounts and the latest job opportunities. This is a lifetime access, which means students will continue to have access to these services even after they graduate. Arden Enterprise Incubator As an Arden University student, you’ll have access to the Arden Enterprise Incubator (AEI) online platform to support you in the area of entrepreneurship. Whether students are exploring the idea of setting up their own company or need help and guidance launching or growing an existing business, the AEI provides everything students need to kick start their entrepreneurial journey, as well as to support and empower them along the way. The AEI has a wealth of resources available including monthly master classes, boot camps, podcasts, blogs, external events, and mentorship. Mentors include Arden University lecturers and industry experts, so our students receive the very best support and expertise. As an IOEE Centre of Excellence, we foster an entrepreneurial culture among our students. We are dedicated to supporting their continuous growth by promoting enterprising thinking and practical entrepreneurial skills. and Innovation Locations Online Attendance Flexible (Online) Duration Part-time: 1 year+ (Online) Apply today Speak to an advisor Register interest What makes Arden University special? Education for everyone, everywhere Whether you're constrained by location, cost, time, or other life commitments, we're passionate about giving you access to higher education that fits into your busy, modern life. You decide how and where to study We offer a wide range of flexible undergraduate and postgraduate degrees in both our online and blended study modes. Full support both online and on-site We're also proud to offer non-standard entry, meaning your work experience and previous qualifications are taken into account when assessing your application. Strong focus on employability You will gain in-depth subject knowledge and transferable skills that employers from a huge range of industries will value. Many of our courses at Arden are also accredited by leading professional bodies in the UK. Course Overview In the current uncertain business climate, there’s never been a better time to add value to your existing qualifications. The MBA (Top-Up) is a globally recognised qualification that gives you the opportunity to build on your prior academic qualifications to unlock enhanced career prospects. In just a few months of study, you’ll join the ranks of MBA-level professionals and will have the skills you need to apply for senior management roles in practically any industry. In fact, on Arden’s MBA (Top-Up) degree course, we go far beyond the standard business and management curriculum. While studying with us, you’ll learn everything there is to know about the development and implementation of business strategies, how to manage and sustain large organisations and steer them to success, and how to be an influential and respected leader in your chosen industry. During this postgraduate top-up degree course, you’ll also study a wide range of management disciplines - with ideas, experiences, and case studies taken from organisations and thought leaders across the world. You’ll have the opportunity to put your learning into practice from the moment you start studying, creating an immediate impact on your career trajectory and providing lasting value to your organisation. Explore postgraduate Business degrees Video • 2 mins Accreditation and Memberships CMI Accredited This course awards a CMI Level 7 Certificate in Strategic Management and Leadership Practice and grants graduates Foundation Chartered Manager Status. BGA Membership Arden University is a member of the Business Graduates Association (BGA), meaning students will receive complementary BGA membership. AACSB Membership Arden University is a member of the prestigious Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business (AACSB). Quick tools Explore your brochure Download the course brochure to take a look at your course modules and syllabus content. Download brochure Speak to an advisor Want to speak to one of our subject experts? Our advisors are ready to answer your questions! Click below to get started. Show me how Professional accreditation This course is accredited by the Chartered Management Institute, supporting your career and connecting you with likeminded professionals. Learn more Course details and modules This top-up master’s degree is designed for practising managers who are looking to take the next step up in their careers. When creating the course modules, we listened to our graduates and alumni and worked with experienced industry leaders to produce a well-rounded, innovative course of study for students. As a mature student the key factors that I wanted when deciding which university was best for me was quality content, a flexible learning schedule, and programme accreditation. During my research I found that Arden really stood out, and I could study without having to give up my job. Abdulrahaman Usman Master of Business Administration Modules Transformation Capstone Project (60 credits) How do we assess you? A big part of your online MBA (Top-Up) work will be the opportunity to create and take ownership of a detailed piece of research relating to a management issue. To back your development, Arden will provide you with academic support to make sure you have the skills and resources you need to successfully complete the assessments. Your tutor will also be able to give you suggestions and tips for improvement - and help you learn how to apply your newly-acquired skills to real life settings. A variety of methods are used to assess your progress, allowing you to demonstrate your strengths as you study. These assessments include: Case studies Proposals Dissertation Study options This course is available to students as a fully online programme, which gives you the convenience of being able to study from anywhere worldwide. I’ve found that studying my degree online with Arden has given me a much more comprehensive foundation of knowledge around the topics I don’t often encounter in my work role, including financial decision-making, ethics and strategy. This knowledge will enable me to progress to more strategic roles in the future. Simon Henry MBA Online Online learning How does it work? Studying this course online gives you the ultimate in convenience. You can enrol with Arden from anywhere in the world and study your degree from the comfort of home, without the requirement to attend classes in a physical location. Our online students study their degree through ilearn, Arden’s university campus in the cloud.  ilearn provides everything you need to study at University. It offers an integrated virtual learning experience, including your virtual classroom, lecture theatre, and and access to our Library Portal. The portal includes an extensive digital library including thousands of journal titles, eBooks, and academic and industry databases which you can use to research your assignments and projects. All of these materials are provided to you free of charge, and contain all the research information you’ll need to complete your degree with us. ilearn is also integrated with Zoom, making it easier to chat with your course tutor during your scheduled seminar sessions. You can even integrate our study materials into your Kindle, making it possible to study wherever you have you Kindle handy. Studying online doesn’t mean studying alone. As well as receiving regular feedback and guidance from your course tutor, you’ll be studying with likeminded students who you can meet with through our Unitu community, and you’ll have access to community message boards to discuss your course and the topics being raised within it. We’ve even set up community boards embedded into each of the course modules so you can have discussions with your tutor and classmates on the topics you’re currently learning. Learn more about online learning Entry requirements At Arden University we consider applications on a case by case basis. If you have significant work experience, have qualifications you have gained elsewhere, or a degree or qualification that isn't a clear pathway to this degree - we are more than happy to discuss your application. Eligibility To be eligible for this MBA (Top-Up) course, we need to see that you have: 120 credits at Level 7 in a broadly-based business/management award, such as a Postgraduate Diploma in Business, or an equivalent international qualification. English Proficiency If your Level 7 qualification was taught in English, this can serve as your proof of English proficiency. If you studied outside the UK, your institution may be able to provide a medium of instruction letter demonstrating that your Level 7 Postgraduate Diploma was taught in English Alternatively, an English Language proficiency equivalent to IELTS 6.5 (no less than 6.0 in each component) if English is not your first language. If you don’t already have the required qualifications for this MBA (Top-Up), Arden may be able to offer you a place on our full MBA programme. You can also explore our MBAs . Course fees and funding Funding and Scholarships If you’re an international student, we have a number of Regional Offers that can help you save money on your tuition fees. Refer a Friend When you help a friend or family member to study with Arden through our Refer a Friend programme, both you and the person you refer will receive a £500 Amazon e-voucher or £500 tuition fee credit. Meet the faculty Hassaan Khan brings 15 years of experience as a senior academic in higher education. Hassaan studied accounting and finance at the University of Kent, followed by an MSc and PhD in Finance from Durham University. Prior to joining Arden, he was associate dean at the Global Banking School, looking after the finance and business management degrees. Hassaan was director of programmes at BPP University where he was responsible for degrees in finance and applied management as well as professional courses and degree apprenticeships in accountancy. Dr. Hassaan Khan Head of School - School of Management and Executive Education Career prospects By graduating with an MBA (Top-Up) degree, you’ll be setting yourself up to take on senior leadership challenges in any organisation or business, both in the public and private sector. An MBA (Top-Up) qualification will equip you with the skills you need to progress to a senior management role in diverse industries all over the world. The specialist skills you’ll possess after graduating are highly valued by employers, giving you a competitive edge in the job market. Related courses Executive MBA Executive MBA (Data Analytics) Executive MBA (Finance) Related Articles Business and Management Articles Career Advice What will I gain from completing this degree? After graduating, you’ll have: Demonstrated you can apply knowledge and skills at a strategic level Undertaken activities that have improved your own organisation Used your personal development and planning skills to contribute to society and the workplace Used your problem-solving skills to find innovative solutions Shown genuine deep knowledge in your chosen specialist area Taken a world view, demonstrating that you understand global issues, diversity and ethical questions Developed your communication skills What can I do after Arden University? So where will your career take you next? Our MBA (Top-Up) gives you the scope to take on new and exciting challenges while preparing you for senior and leadership roles in any industry of your choosing. Industry skills Chartered Management Institute (CMI) This course awards a CMI Level 7 Certificate in Strategic Management & Leadership Practice and offers CMI Foundation Chartered Manager Status * The Chartered Management Institute (CMI) promotes excellence in UK management and leadership. As the CMI possesses a Royal Charter, they are the only organisation in the UK that can award Chartered Manager status to their members – the gold standard in management. With 140,000 members, the institute aims to boost career development across the management sector and connect like-minded professionals. As an Arden student, you’ll have free CMI Membership throughout your studies, giving you access to a range of additional resources including a mentoring service and invitations to networking events both online and offline. Upon completion of this CMI-accredited course, you will be awarded CMI Level 7 Certificate in Strategic Management & Leadership Practice and gain CMI Foundation Chartered Manager Status. This recognises you have the skills needed to be an effective manager, helping you stand out from the competition and start your management career journey - with a CMI qualification and a clear pathway to full Chartered Manager status. *Upon completion of your course, the CMI award and level of chartered status awarded will depend on your level and length of study, whether you entered your course with Recognition for Prior Learning (RPL) or if any compensation is applied on your modules throughout the duration of study. If this criteria applies to you, you may receive one of the 2 different levels; an Award or Certificate. Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business (AACSB) membership. Arden University is a member of the prestigious Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business (AACSB). AACSB International is a global association of leaders in education and business dedicated to supporting and advancing quality business education worldwide. This membership reflects the fact that Arden University has successfully matched the high standards required by the AACSB, and enables the sharing of ideas and the exchange best practises between global business schools. Membership also gives our faculty members access to in-depth data and research to support the development of our courses and teaching methods, ensuring that we are able to provide you with the best possible university experience. Business Graduates Association (BGA) The BGA is a membership and quality assurance body. As a member, Arden University have signed up to the BGA Charter, committing their institution to responsible management practices and lifelong learning, positively impacting their students, communities, and the economy. This shows our students that we are demonstrating responsible management ourselves, as well as it being a central theme that runs through our own courses. As Arden University is a member of the Business Graduates Association (BGA), students will receive complementary BGA student and graduate membership. Through this membership, current students will have access to the BGA Career Development Centre, packed with interactive tools, e-learning content, partner discounts and the latest job opportunities. This is a lifetime access, which means students will continue to have access to these services even after they graduate. Arden Enterprise Incubator As an Arden University student, you’ll have access to the Arden Enterprise Incubator (AEI) online platform to support you in the area of entrepreneurship. Whether students are exploring the idea of setting up their own company or need help and guidance launching or growing an existing business, the AEI provides everything students need to kick start their entrepreneurial journey, as well as to support and empower them along the way. The AEI has a wealth of resources available including monthly master classes, boot camps, podcasts, blogs, external events, and mentorship. Mentors include Arden University lecturers and industry experts, so our students receive the very best support and expertise. As an IOEE Centre of Excellence, we foster an entrepreneurial culture among our students. We are dedicated to supporting their continuous growth by promoting enterprising thinking and practical entrepreneurial skills. Criminology degree Faculty of Social Sciences and Technology Locations Online Attendance Flexible (Online) Duration Full-time: 1 year (Online) Apply today Speak to an advisor Register interest What makes Arden University special? Education for everyone, everywhere Whether you're constrained by location, cost, time, or other life commitments, we're passionate about giving you access to higher education that fits into your busy, modern life. You decide how and where to study We offer a wide range of flexible undergraduate and postgraduate degrees in both our online and blended study modes. Full support both online and on-site We're also proud to offer non-standard entry, meaning your work experience and previous qualifications are taken into account when assessing your application. Strong focus on employability You will gain in-depth subject knowledge and transferable skills that employers from a huge range of industries will value. Many of our courses at Arden are also accredited by leading professional bodies in the UK. Course Overview This practical and innovative programme equips you with the skills and knowledge to tackle serious and violent crimes. You will graduate with a deep understanding of critical issues, ready to apply this expertise directly in your career. Developed by experts with real-world criminal justice experience, the course takes a hands-on approach to solving the sector’s most pressing challenges. It’s tailored for both current criminal justice professionals and those seeking to transition into the field. Focusing on practical application, the PG Cert covers essential criminological topics, including terrorism, the dark web, the psychology of serious offending, and managing intelligence and investigations. By the end of the programme, you will have both the theoretical knowledge and practical skills needed to navigate complex situations in criminal justice environments. Why choose this course? Career advancement: Whether you’re looking to enter the sector or progress in your current role, this course equips you with the expertise and skills to gain a competitive edge and stand out to employers. Tailored for professionals: This programme is ideal for those already working in criminal justice. Whether you’re in law enforcement, security, intelligence, or national security, you’ll gain the skills to tackle serious crime more effectively. Accessible admission: Admission is more accessible if you are already employed in a role in criminal justice, law enforcement or security services, evaluated on a case-by-case basis. This means you can continue your education without disrupting your career. Flexible learning: Balance your career with academic growth. Based entirely online, this course prioritises practical assessments over traditional exams, making it ideal for busy professionals. Funding opportunities: Choose from a range of funding opportunities, including government scholarships, employer sponsorships, and flexible payment plans, so you can focus on your education without financial stress. Why choose Arden Video • 1 min Quick tools Explore your brochure Download the course brochure to take a look at your course modules and syllabus content. Download brochure Speak to an advisor Want to speak to one of our subject experts? Our advisors are ready to answer your questions! Click below to get started. Show me how Career development resources You'll have online access to a huge range of career development tools from the day you start studying. Learn more Course details and modules This PG Cert in Serious and Violent Crime takes an applied approach, ensuring everything you learn can be directly applied to your career. Modules cover topics that are crucial for modern criminal justice practice and reflect the demands of today’s criminal justice system. Reflective Practice and Leadership : Develop your leadership style while considering the ethical and professional challenges of dealing with serious crime. The Psychology of Serious Offending : Understand the psychological factors that drive serious crime, with a focus on violent offenders and their patterns. Managing Intelligence and Investigations : Learn to manage large volumes of data and intelligence, supporting strategic decisions and operational effectiveness in serious crime cases. Terrorism, Extremism, and Hate : Study the global and local dynamics of terrorism and extremism, including preventive strategies and counterterrorism efforts. Cybercrime and the Dark Web : Gain insight into the growing threat of cybercrime, particularly focusing on the dark web, and develop skills to investigate digital crime. The Criminal Justice System and Globalisation : Explore how crime and justice are impacted by globalisation and the challenges it poses for policing, legal frameworks, and the wider system. The course is a real breath of fresh air, the content and learning is extremely current and the assignments are pieces of work that can be easily applied to the workplace. I thought that I would struggle working full time and completing this course but if anything, working full time in the field makes it easier. It is also extremely valuable to have lecturers who have working experience of the criminal justice system to enhance learning. Lorna Griffiths MA Serious & Violent Crime Modules Core module Reflective Practice and Leadership (20 credits) Elective modules (select two) The Criminal Justice System and Globalisation (20 credits) The Psychology of Serious Offending (20 credits) Managing Intelligence and Investigations (20 credits) Terrorism, Extremism and Hate (20 credits) Cybercrime and the Dark Web (20 credits) How do we assess you? We take a practical, forward-thinking approach to assessment. No exams, no essays, and no dissertation. Instead, assessments are designed to reflect the tasks and situations you will face within the criminal justice sector. These include: Strategic business pitches Reports and presentations Intelligence analysis Operational strategy documents For example, in the Managing Intelligence and Investigations module, you will complete a 'Senior Level Strategic Briefing Document'—an assessment designed to reflect the type of task a senior team lead or above would perform during an ongoing incident, operation, or investigation. The support you need to succeed You will receive extensive support throughout your studies. Our team of practitioners with real-world experience in criminal justice will be your guides. You will also benefit from flexible online resources and personal support from your module leaders. Additional support services: Personalised academic support through the A-PASS (Arden Pathway to Academic Student Success). Career events, training, and networking opportunities Access to learning resources, journals, and events, which will help you progress in your career. Study options Having flexible study is so important to me… I’ve had to do last-minute school runs to drop my nephews off, but Arden has been so understanding and the flexibility of study suits my life perfectly. Ryan-Jay Walsh BA (Hons) Criminology and Psychology Online learning How does it work? Studying this course online gives you the ultimate in convenience. You can enrol with Arden from anywhere in the world and study your degree from the comfort of home, without the requirement to attend classes in a physical location. Our online students study their degree through ilearn, Arden’s university campus in the cloud. ilearn provides everything you need to study at university. It offers an integrated virtual learning experience, including your virtual classroom, lecture theatre, and access to our Library Portal. The portal includes an extensive digital library including thousands of journal titles, eBooks, and academic and industry databases which you can use to research your assignments and projects. All of these materials are provided to you free of charge, and contain all the research information you’ll need to complete your degree with us. ilearn is also integrated with Zoom, making it easier to chat with your course tutor during your scheduled seminar sessions. You can even integrate our study materials into your Kindle, making it possible to study wherever you have your Kindle handy. Studying online doesn’t mean studying alone. As well as receiving regular feedback and guidance from your course tutor, you’ll be studying with like-minded students who you can meet with through our Unitu community, and you’ll have access to community message boards to discuss your course and the topics being raised within it. We’ve even set up community boards embedded into each of the course modules so you can have discussions with your tutor and classmates on the topics you’re currently learning. Online learning students resident in the UK can apply for a Maintenance Loan if they cannot attend their course in person because of a disability. Please find more information on our fees and funding page . If you're a student from Scotland, Wales, or Northern Ireland you can find information on Living Cost Loans from your student finance body. Learn more about online learning . Introducing your Digital Backpack Once you’ve enrolled with Arden, you’ll get access to your Digital Backpack, a toolkit of digital resources we’ve put together to help you succeed during your time studying with us. Here are some of the digital resources you’ll have available throughout your course: Office 365 subscription Integrated Zoom video conferencing Career services through the Arden Futures Target Connect platform Free online access to our Library Portal with thousands of eBooks, journals, and industry databases Subscription to Togetherall for mental health support Entry requirements At Arden University we consider applications on a case by case basis. If you have significant work experience, have qualifications you have gained elsewhere, or a degree or qualification that isn't a clear pathway to this degree - we are more than happy to discuss your application. What do you need to study with us? Our aim is to make learning as accessible as possible by ensuring that you can study your degree in a flexible and convenient way. That's why we keep our requirements simple. All you need is a laptop or desktop PC (we recommend one running the latest version of Windows), and a good internet connection. Through ilearn, our online university campus in the cloud, you'll be able to access your course calendar, support services, learning materials, and our online library containing almost half a million texts, as well as creating assignments, keeping notes, and collaborating with other students on your course. Eligibility Entry requirements for our Postgraduate Certificate in Serious and Violent Crime: Standard entry: A 2:2 undergraduate degree. Non-standard entry: At least 3 years of relevant industry work experience (guaranteed interview/offer). Acceptable work experience includes: Police service (uniformed officer or civilian) Her Majesty's Prison and Probation Service (HMPPS) National Crime Agency (NCA) Border Force/Interpol Youth Justice or relevant NGOs Less relevant work experience includes: Hospitality, healthcare, retail, education, and administrative roles Course fees and funding Find your country I am a student from Please select ... Meet the faculty Dr. Emma Winlow obtained her undergraduate and postgraduate degrees in Criminology and Crime & Justice from the University of Chester and completed her PhD at the University of Gloucestershire. A public criminologist, Emma has extensive leadership and management experience in higher education and is passionate about accessibility, inclusion, and employability in teaching and learning. She established the School of Criminal Justice with these practices in mind. Emma is also a member of the British Society of Criminology and the British Society of Criminology's Teaching and Learning Network. Dr Emma Winlow Head of School - Criminal Justice Career prospects Upon completion of the PG Cert, you will be prepared to move into higher-level positions within law enforcement or related sectors. Many graduates advance to leadership roles in policing or national security or work for agencies like the National Crime Agency or MI5. Alternatively, you may choose to apply your skills to policy development or research in the criminal justice sector. Related Courses BA (Hons) Criminology BA (Hons) Criminology with Cybercrime BA (Hons) Criminology and Psychology Related Articles Meet the Criminology team Latest news Career advice What will this course do for me? The PG Cert in Serious and Violent Crime will provide you with the expertise to advance within your current role or transition into a new career in criminal justice. By completing this programme, you will develop essential industry skills such as: In-depth knowledge of crime prevention and response strategies for serious and violent crime. Enhanced leadership and decision-making skills in complex and high-pressure environments. Practical experience in managing crime data and intelligence. An advanced understanding of terrorism, cybercrime, and the evolving threats within the criminal landscape. What can I do after Arden University? Graduates of the PG Cert in Serious and Violent Crime will be well-equipped for roles in various areas of the criminal justice system, including law enforcement, intelligence agencies, and NGOs. Possible career paths include: Policing and National Crime Agency (NCA) Border Force or MI5 Prison and Probation Services Crime Prevention and Community Safety Intelligence Agencies and Local Authorities Additionally, this qualification can serve as a stepping stone to more senior roles in criminal justice, law enforcement, or policy-making. Industry skills Campaign for Social Science Arden University is a member of the Campaign for Social Science. The Campaign demonstrates how social science improves public policy, society, and all our lives. It highlights the value of applied social science research and advocates for its greater use in decision-making and in government. It is supported by a coalition of universities, social science societies, and publishers. As a member, Arden receives access to case studies, research into the value provided by social sciences, and insights into the employability of social science graduates. Through this, you will gain a better understanding of the skills you are learning and their value to employers. Arden University special? Education for everyone, everywhere Whether you're constrained by location, cost, time, or other life commitments, we're passionate about giving you access to higher education that fits into your busy, modern life. You decide how and where to study We offer a wide range of flexible undergraduate and postgraduate degrees in both our online and blended study modes. Full support both online and on-site We're also proud to offer non-standard entry, meaning your work experience and previous qualifications are taken into account when assessing your application. Strong focus on employability You will gain in-depth subject knowledge and transferable skills that employers from a huge range of industries will value. Many of our courses at Arden are also accredited by leading professional bodies in the UK. Course Overview Are you interested in the fascinating world of forensic and criminal investigation? Our BSc (Hons) Forensic and Criminal Investigation course will fully immerse you in diverse aspects of the investigative process using cutting-edge technology, giving you valuable practical insight into real-life investigations. The course starts by taking you on an immersive journey through the entire investigative process, illustrating the natural progress of criminal investigations and the interlinked areas of policing and forensics. Through this, you will gain knowledge of how the various personnel involved in an investigation work together to achieve a common goal. Not only is the course delivered by skilled academic staff with years of experience in the field, but the additional use of guest lectures and webinars will provide you with a solid grounding of real practises in modern forensic and criminal investigations. Just one of the ways this course stands out is our immersive virtual crime world, which allows you to place yourself in real-world scenarios. To supplement your learning, this environment will be integrated seamlessly with your modules so that you can put the theory you learn during your lessons, seminars, and workshops into practice. You’ll have the opportunity to take on a range of investigative roles as you navigate different environments such as crime scenes, the police custody suite, the major incident room, police cells, the courtroom, the forensics lab, and a burial site where you uncover partially clothed bones. Through this, you’ll gain insight into important processes and roles in forensic and criminal investigations, preparing you for future work in the field of forensic investigation. This course shares the same level 4 modules as our BSc (Hons) Policing and Criminal Investigation . After completing the first year of your course, you’ll have the option to switch over to this pathway if it better suits your interests. Learn more Course details and modules Your course modules begin by taking you through the entire forensic investigative process, from the scene of the crime to the courtroom. Each module will link offences, offenders, law enforcement, forensic personnel, laws, and legislation, helping bring evidence to life. Using our unique virtual environment, you’ll also have the opportunity to assume the role of a crime scene investigator, detective, civilian investigator, and coroner, helping you translate theoretical principles to the real-world scenarios you might face in your future role. Later in the course you’ll study the academic components of forensic science, and the use of a wide range of modern forensic techniques, including forensic trace analysis, forensic biology and anthropology, and environmental forensics. Through level 5 elective modules, you’ll also be able to adapt your curriculum to your individual areas of interest. The Virtual Reality scenes per module added a 'real-life' touch that was extremely helpful. The online course felt personal - the teachers' support was exceptional. Lectures, tutors, and a goldmine of online resources made my journey even better. Emma Gera BSc (Hons) Forensic and Criminal Investigation Modules Level 4 Introduction to Forensic Investigation (20 credits) Introduction to Criminal Investigation (20 credits) Police Custody (20 credits) Witnesses: An Introduction (20 credits) Criminal Investigation: Procedures and Practices (20 credits) Analysis and Application of Forensics (20 credits) Level 5 Core Modules Forensic Trace Analysis (20 credits) Forensic Biology (20 credits) Civilian Employability (20 credits) Death Investigation and the Coroner (20 credits) Optional Modules Transnational Organised Crime (20 credits) Intelligence (20 credits) Community Policing (20 credits) Level 6 Core Modules Forensic Anthropology (20 credits) Environmental Forensics (20 credits) Special Investigations Portfolio (60 credits) Optional Modules Law Enforcement: Vulnerability and Risk (20 credits) The Professionalisation of the Investigative Interview (20 credits) Authentic assessments. No exams. Unlike on more traditional degree programmes, you won’t be sitting any exams on this BSc (Hons) Forensic and Criminal Investigation. Instead, the course utilises authentic, real-world assessments that replicate the observations, interviews, and reports that would be conducted in the field as part of a real forensic and criminal investigation. Study options Distance Learning has allowed me to study whilst maintaining a full-time job, as lessons can be accessed at a time that suits my schedule. The tutors and guest speakers have a wealth of experience from careers in forensics and criminal investigation, and I have particularly enjoyed hearing cases from their perspective. Louise Harris BSc (Hons) Forensic and Criminal Investigation Online learning How does it work? Studying this course online gives you the ultimate in convenience. As one of our online students, you'll study your degree through iLearn, Arden’s university campus in the cloud, which provides everything you need to study at university. Learn within an immersive virtual reality environment This ground-breaking course uses a custom-built immersive virtual environment to put you at the heart of the crime scene. You’ll be able to place yourself into the scenario that is being presented, providing a seamless integration between your course content and our supplementary virtual crime world. Each of the modules studied in each year are linked by offences, offenders, law enforcement and forensic personnel. You will be assuming these different roles as you navigate through the crime world, investigating various offences that have been presented to you. As well as receiving regular feedback and guidance from your course tutor, you’ll also be studying with like-minded students who you can meet with through our Unitu community, and you’ll have access to community message boards to discuss your course and the topics being raised within it. You’ll also have access to our Library Portal. The portal includes an extensive digital library including thousands of journal titles, eBooks, and academic and industry databases which you can use to research your assignments and projects. All of these materials are provided to you free of charge, and contain all the research information you’ll need to complete your degree with us. Online learning students resident in the UK can apply for a Maintenance Loan if they cannot attend their course in person because of a disability. Please find more information on our fees and funding page . If you're a student from Scotland, Wales or Northern Ireland you can find information on Living Cost Loans from your student finance body. Learn more about online learning Entry requirements At Arden University we consider applications on a case by case basis. If you have significant work experience, have qualifications you have gained elsewhere, or a degree or qualification that isn't a clear pathway to this degree - we are more than happy to discuss your application. Eligibility To be eligible for our BSc (Hons) Forensic and Criminal Investigation, you should normally have: Two subjects at GCE A level or equivalent, plus passes at grade C or above in three subjects at GCSE level or equivalent. Alternative level 3 qualifications will also be considered, including Access to HE, a BTEC Extended Diploma, or internationally equivalent. We’re also happy to consider your application if you can demonstrate your ability to study the course via previous work experience, references, and a personal statement. English proficiency IELTS 6.0 (no less than 5.5 in any element); or TOEFL iBT 90; or equivalent. Alternatively, evidence you have previously studied in English, such as a letter to show that the medium of instruction was in English can be accepted. Meet the faculty Dr. Emma Winlow obtained her undergraduate and postgraduate degrees in Criminology and Crime & Justice from the University of Chester and completed her PhD at the University of Gloucestershire. A public criminologist, Emma has extensive leadership and management experience in higher education and is passionate about accessibility, inclusion, and employability in teaching and learning. She established the School of Criminal Justice with these practices in mind. Emma is also a member of the British Society of Criminology and the British Society of Criminology’s Teaching and Learning Network. Dr. Emma Winlow Head of School – School of Criminology, Criminal Justice and Law Career prospects Our BSc (Hons) Forensic and Criminal Investigation will provide you with the foundations you need to continue on with further study and for future work in the field of forensic and criminal investigation. related courses BSc (Hons) Policing and Criminal Investigation BA (Hons) Criminology and Law Criminology and Law articles Career Advice What will the BSc (Hons) Forensic and Criminal Investigation do for me? You’ll graduate from this course with real practical insight into forensic and criminal investigation, including an in-depth understanding of: The major themes and practical underpinnings of forensic and criminal investigations The knowledge and skills required to undertake a forensic investigation from start to completion The roles of different personnel and how they work together to achieve a common goal A wide range of forensic techniques used for collecting and analysing criminal evidence What can I do after Arden University? This course is for anyone interested in learning more about forensic investigation and pursuing a career within the wider forensic area. It is also an opportunity to take a fascinating deep dive into how forensic investigation works to provide you with universal skills for your future. Additional benefits of the course include: This degree qualifies graduates for entry to the UK police force through the degree holders entry route. You’ll gain the academic knowledge needed for the entry route into a variety of civilian roles, such as civilian investigative officer, private financial investigator, or intelligence analyst. If you’re currently working as a police officer or civilian within the law enforcement family, but don’t have a degree, the flexibility of this course and its online format means you can study part-time while working. Industry skills Introducing your Digital Backpack Once you’ve enrolled on your course with Arden you’ll get access to your Digital Backpack, a toolkit of digital resources we’ve put together to help you succeed during your time studying with us. Here are some of the digital resources you’ll have available throughout your course: Office 365 subscription Integrated zoom video conferencing Careers support available through Arden Futures, your careers platform, to help you throughout your career journey whether you are a Career Starter, Changer or Developer Perlego online library, giving you access to over half a million books, journals, and articles Subscription to Togetherall for an abundance of mental health support. Arden University special? Education for everyone, everywhere Whether you're constrained by location, cost, time, or other life commitments, we're passionate about giving you access to higher education that fits into your busy, modern life. You decide how and where to study We offer a wide range of flexible undergraduate and postgraduate degrees in both our online and blended study modes. Full support both online and on-site We're also proud to offer non-standard entry, meaning your work experience and previous qualifications are taken into account when assessing your application. Strong focus on employability You will gain in-depth subject knowledge and transferable skills that employers from a huge range of industries will value. Many of our courses at Arden are also accredited by leading professional bodies in the UK. Course Overview Are you interested in a rewarding career within  criminal investigation, the policing family or wider law enforcement arena? Then our BSc (Hons) Policing and Criminal Investigation might be the perfect fit for you. The course will fully immerse you in the investigative process using cutting-edge technology, giving you valuable practical insight into real-life investigations. The course starts by taking you on an immersive journey through the entire investigative process, illustrating the natural progress of criminal investigations and the interlinked areas of policing and forensics. Through this, you will gain knowledge of how the various personnel involved in an investigation work together to achieve a common goal. Not only is the course delivered by skilled academic staff with years of experience in the field, but the additional use of guest lectures and webinars will provide you with a solid grounding of real practises in modern policing and criminal investigations. Just one of the ways this course stands out is our immersive virtual crime world, which allows you to place yourself in real-world scenarios. To supplement your learning, this environment will be integrated seamlessly with your modules so that you can put the theory you learn during your lessons, seminars, and workshops into practice. You’ll have the opportunity to take on a range of investigative roles as you navigate different environments such as crime scenes, the police custody suite, the major incident room, police cells, the courtroom, and the forensics lab. Through this, you’ll gain insight into important processes and roles within civilian and operational policing and criminal investigations as a whole, preparing you for future work in the field. Arden University's Immersive Learning Environment Video • 1 min Quick tools Explore your brochure Download the course brochure to take a look at your course modules and syllabus content. Download brochure Speak to an advisor Want to speak to one of our subject experts? Our advisors are ready to answer your questions! Click below to get started. Show me how Career development resources You'll have online access to a huge range of career development tools from the day you start studying. Learn more Course details and modules Your course modules begin by taking you through the entire criminal investigative process, from the scene of the crime to the courtroom. Each module will link offences, offenders, law enforcement, forensic personnel, laws, and legislation, helping bring evidence to life. Using our unique virtual environment, you’ll also have the opportunity to assume the role of a crime scene investigator, detective, analyst and civilian detention officer, helping you translate theoretical principles to the real-world scenarios you might face in your future role. Later in the course you’ll study the academic components of policing and how these can be applied to practice, including leadership, communication, and investigative interviewing skills, as well as gain knowledge of a range of specialised areas within the field. These modules will showcase the civilian roles within the police service and the wider law enforcement family. Through level 5 and 6, you will select elective modules, which are also shared with the BSc (Hons) Forensic and Criminal Investigation programme. Arden is for winners. Nobody will beg you to sit down and start working on your career, if you don’t do it yourself! At Arden, if you have an honest interest for what you learn and you want to reach out for more, you will be welcomed, helped, and advised. But to do that, you must be determined. Bettina Finna BSc (Hons) Psychology When studying online you’ll have the flexibility to study on a schedule that works for you. While most of our students aim to complete the course within 3 to 6 years, you’ll have the option to extend the time in takes to complete the course if you need to. Studying full-time, through our blended learning option, means you have 3 years to complete the course. This course shares the same level 4 modules as our BSc (Hons) Forensic and Criminal Investigation. (You can find out more about this course here .) Modules Level 4 Introduction to Forensic Investigation (20 credits) Introduction to Criminal Investigation (20 credits) Police Custody (20 credits) Witnesses: An Introduction (20 credits) Criminal Investigation: Procedures and Practises (20 credits) Analysis and Application of Forensics (20 credits) Level 5 Core Modules Leadership in Policing and Law Enforcement (20 credits) Police Procedures and Evidence (20 credits) Policing and Human Rights (20 credits) Civilian Employability (20 credits) Optional modules Intelligence (20 credits) Community Policing (20 credits) Transnational Organised Crime (20 credits) Level 6 Police Ethics and Professional Standards (20 credits) Law Enforcement: Vulnerability and Risk (20 credits) The Professionalism of the Investigative Interview (20 credits) Special Investigations Portfolio (60 credits) Authentic assessments. No exams. Unlike on more traditional degree programmes, you won’t be sitting any exams on this BSc (Hons) Policing and Criminal Investigation. Instead, the course utilises authentic, real-world assessments that replicate the observations, interviews, and reports that would be conducted in the field as part of a real policing and criminal investigation. Study options I chose online learning because it suited my lifestyle and work schedule. Being able to access the online portal and libraries 24/7 has been extremely helpful for me to be able to keep up with my studies. Studying while working isn’t the easiest thing to do, but Arden gives you the support you need. Ornella Russo BA (Hons) Law & Psychology Online learning How does it work? Studying this course online gives you the ultimate in convenience. As one of our online students, you’ll  study your degree through ilearn, Arden’s university campus in the cloud, which provides everything you need to study at university. Learn within an immersive virtual reality environment This ground-breaking course uses a custom-built immersive virtual environment to put you at the heart of the crime scene. You’ll be able to place yourself into the scenario that is being presented, providing a seamless integration between your course content and our supplementary virtual crime world. Each of the modules studied in each year are linked by offences, offenders, law enforcement and forensic personnel. You will be assuming these different roles as you navigate through the crime world, investigating various offences that have been presented to you. As well as receiving regular feedback and guidance from your course tutor, you’ll also be studying with like-minded students who you can meet with through our Unitu community, and you’ll have access to community message boards to discuss your course and the topics being raised within it. You’ll also have access to our Library Portal. The portal includes an extensive digital library including thousands of journal titles, eBooks, and academic and industry databases which you can use to research your assignments and projects. All of these materials are provided to you free of charge, and contain all the research information you’ll need to complete your degree with us. Online learning students resident in the UK can apply for a Maintenance Loan if they cannot attend their course in person because of a disability. Please find more information on our fees and funding page. If you're a student from Scotland, Wales or Northern Ireland you can find information on Living Cost Loans from your student finance body. Learn more about online learning Introducing your Digital Backpack Once you’ve enrolled on your course with Arden you’ll get access to your Digital Backpack, a toolkit of digital resources we’ve put together to help you succeed during your time studying with us. Here are some of the digital resources you’ll have available throughout your course: Office 365 subscription Integrated zoom video conferencing Careers support available through Arden Futures, your careers platform, to help you throughout your career journey whether you are a Career Starter, Changer or Developer Free online access to our Library Portal, which includes thousands of eBooks and journals, as well as industry databases which we’ve carefully hand-picked to support your studies – all yours for free while you study with us. Subscription to Togetherall for an abundance of mental health support. Entry requirements At Arden University we consider applications on a case by case basis. If you have significant work experience, have qualifications you have gained elsewhere, or a degree or qualification that isn't a clear pathway to this degree - we are more than happy to discuss your application. Eligibility To be eligible for our BSc (Hons) Policing and Criminal Investigation, you should normally have: Two subjects at GCE A level or equivalent, plus passes at grade C or above in three subjects at GCSE level or equivalent. Alternative level 3 qualifications will also be considered, including Access to HE, a BTEC Extended Diploma, or internationally equivalent. We’re also happy to consider your application if you can demonstrate your ability to study the course via previous work experience, references, and a personal statement. English proficiency IELTS 6.0 (no less than 5.5 in any element); or TOEFL iBT 90; or equivalent. Alternatively, evidence you have previously studied in English, such as a letter to show that the medium of instruction was in English can be accepted.
