Meet the faculty Dr. Emma Winlow obtained her undergraduate and postgraduate degrees in Criminology and Crime & Justice from the University of Chester and completed her PhD at the University of Gloucestershire. A public criminologist, Emma has extensive leadership and management experience in higher education and is passionate about accessibility, inclusion, and employability in teaching and learning. She established the School of Criminal Justice with these practices in mind. Emma is also a member of the British Society of Criminology and the British Society of Criminology’s Teaching and Learning Network. Dr. Emma Winlow Head of School – School of Criminology, Criminal Justice and Law Career prospects Our BSc (Hons) Policing and Criminal Investigation will provide you with the foundations you need to continue on with further study and for future work in the field of policing and criminal investigation. Related Courses BSc (Hons) Forensic and Criminal Investigation BA (Hons) Criminology and Law Criminology and Law articles Career Advice What will the BSc (Hons) Policing and Criminal Investigation do for me? You’ll graduate from this course with real practical insight into the various roles and responsibilities within policing and criminal investigation, including an in-depth understanding of: The major themes and practical underpinnings of policing and criminal investigations The knowledge and skills required to undertake a criminal investigation from start to completion The roles of different personnel and how they work together to achieve a common goal Leadership, communication, and investigative interviewing skills that you can transfer to your future role What can I do after Arden University? This course is for anyone interested in learning more about civilian roles within policing and criminal investigation and pursuing a career within wider law enforcement. It is also an opportunity to take a fascinating deep dive into how criminal investigations work to provide you with universal skills for your future. Additional benefits of the course include: You’ll gain the academic knowledge needed for the entry route into a variety of civilian roles, such as crime and intelligence analyst, Intelligence officer, civilian detention officer, civilian investigating officer and Police Community Support Officer. You could join the police as a police constable through the Degree Holders Entry Programme (DHEP). Industry skills Career Development Resources Once you’ve enrolled with Arden, our careers centre is easily accessible directly from inside our online platform, ilearn. The careers centre is here to help you discover the areas of your academic and professional life that you find most meaningful and rewarding, and then apply this to your career pathway.                                   Holborn, 
                                  Stratford) Manchester Nottingham Online Attendance Evenings (Blended) Weekdays (Blended) Weekends (Blended) Flexible (Online) Duration Full-time: 3 years (Blended) Part-time: 3 years+ (Online) Apply today Speak to an advisor Register interest What makes Arden University special? Education for everyone, everywhere Whether you're constrained by location, cost, time, or other life commitments, we're passionate about giving you access to higher education that fits into your busy, modern life. You decide how and where to study We offer a wide range of flexible undergraduate and postgraduate degrees in both our online and blended study modes. Full support both online and on-site We're also proud to offer non-standard entry, meaning your work experience and previous qualifications are taken into account when assessing your application. Strong focus on employability You will gain in-depth subject knowledge and transferable skills that employers from a huge range of industries will value. Many of our courses at Arden are also accredited by leading professional bodies in the UK. Course Overview In today’s interconnected global economy, graduates with strong business management skills and in-depth knowledge of the latest business technologies are in high demand. Arden’s undergraduate degree in business management will teach you the modern skills, competencies, and technological know-how required to lead and manage successfully in today’s business environment. Our aim with this newly updated business degree is to help you make a valuable and lasting impact, wherever your professional career takes you. The BA (Hons) Business Management will provide you with a taste of all the fundamentals of business, so you don’t need to have a particular career path in mind to enrol on the course. As you explore areas of business such as finance, digital marketing, innovation, people management, and data analysis, you will start to form ideas about where you want to go in the future. This broad range of subjects will help you identify and evaluate the roles and contributions of the key business functions applicable to contemporary business, helping you become a well-rounded professional with a keen awareness of how business works. In your second and third year of study, you’ll start to identify and assess which business solutions best meet the challenges and hurdles organisations face today. The BA (Hons) Business Management has been developed by industry experts with your long-term future in mind. When you graduate from the course, you will do so as a well-rounded, highly-employable and self-motivated professional ready to take on any number of roles and challenges. When you graduate from this course you will receive: BA (Hons) Business Management CMI Level 5 Diploma in Management & Leadership Foundation Chartered Manager Status and the post nominal fCMgr IOEE Professional Diploma in Enterprise and Entrepreneurship BA Hons Business Degree Video • 1 min Accreditation and Memberships CMI Accredited This course awards a CMI Level 5 Diploma in Management & Leadership and offers CMI Foundation Chartered Manager Status. BGA Membership Arden University is a member of the Business Graduates Association (BGA), meaning students will receive complementary BGA membership. AACSB Membership Arden University is a member of the prestigious Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business (AACSB). The Institute of Enterprise and Entrepreneurs (IOEE) This course awards the IOEE Professional Extended Diploma in Business Innovation and Growth. Quick tools Explore your brochure Download the course brochure to take a look at your course modules and syllabus content. Download brochure Speak to an advisor Want to speak to one of our subject experts? Our advisors are ready to answer your questions! Click below to get started. Show me how Professional accreditation This course is accredited by the Chartered Management Institute, supporting your career and connecting you with likeminded professionals. Learn more Course details and modules By providing you with the knowledge of the fundamentals of business - and teaching you exactly how an organisation works – we will prepare you to become a skilled and informed business practitioner, leader, or entrepreneur. During your studies you will gain a wider understanding of business functions, operations, and cutting edge technologies in a range of exciting industries. You will also develop inspiring personal and management attributes in dedicated skills-related modules to help build your soft skills and leadership abilities. Learning research and data analysis techniques using academic and industry focused texts, articles, and reports, you will gain a better understanding of contemporary business and management, with the ability to analyse practical case studies drawn from a range of international organisations. Using our business simulation software, you will be able to access a virtual business and run it as your own enterprise – managing activities such as marketing, sales, finances, people, product development, operations, and your supply chain. This will give you the chance to practice making critical decisions within a safe environment, helping you develop your ability to interpret commercial information and apply your learnings to generate a profit for your enterprise. You will also have access to our Digital Enterprise Hub throughout your course, which provides you with additional software and resources as well as real-world mentors and industry experts to draw knowledge from. The Digital Enterprise Hub also gives you the chance to engage in social learning with your classmates, developing your collaborative skills and providing the opportunity for networking with fellow professionals. The course gave me the confidence and skills to go for senior jobs that I wouldn’t have previously. I have been promoted several times since. Martin Scahill BSc (Hons) Business & Computing (Top-Up) Modules You have 3-9 years to complete this course, which means you can take up to 3 years to complete each level. Most of our students, however, aim to complete the course within 3 to 6 years. Level 4 Digital Skills & Professional Development (20 credits) Contemporary Business Environment (20 credits) Marketing Dynamics (20 credits) Introduction to Business Finance (20 credits) People Management (20 credits) Technology & Innovation (20 credits) Level 5 Data Analytics & Management (20 credits) Business Start-up (20 credits) Sales Management (20 credits) Digital & Social Media Marketing (20 credits) Managing and Leading Teams in International Business (20 credits) Operations & Supply Chain Management (20 credits) Level 6 Business Transformation (20 credits) Entrepreneurship and Innovation (20 credits) Corporate Governance, Law & Ethics (20 credits) Independent Study (20 credits) Project Management (20 credits) International Business Management (20 credits) How do we assess you? Assessments Unlike on more traditional degree courses, you do not need to sit any exams on the BA (Hons) Business Management, and you will not need to spend the summer at home writing a dissertation either. Your assessments have been designed to help you apply your learning to real-word scenarios. This means you will be better prepared to apply the skills you have gained on the course to your professional role after graduation. As you work through your course modules you will have the chance to complete a range of useful assessment methods such as individual reports, case study analyses, group presentations, and personal independent assignments devised in consultation with your course module leader. Your assessments will have an emphasis upon personal discovery, digital technology, the application of theory to real world business, and management practice and innovative thinking. We encourage you to be innovative when carrying out your assignments and assessments. You can create podcasts, videos, infographics, consultancy reports, campaigns, posters, interviews, debate sessions, and more. This approach will help you develop skills you will use in the real world, and most of all, is a fun and engaging way to demonstrate your knowledge and development. Study options This course is available to study through Arden’s blended learning study mode. Daytime classes are available in London Ealing , London Stratford , London Holborn , Manchester , Birmingham , Leeds and Berlin, Germany . Evening classes are available in London Tower Hill, London Holborn, Leeds and Birmingham campuses. Friday Evening and Saturdays are another option. You’ll have one class on a Friday evening and one class on Saturday each week. These are available in London Stratford and Leeds campuses. The course is also available to students via online learning . This gives you the convenience of being able to study from anywhere in the UK or worldwide, providing you with the same high standards of teaching but with lower tuition fees. "I was already in the working world and running two businesses. Not to mention I also have a young family, so the freedom online learning offered, and the cost effectiveness of the course, was a big draw for me." Adrian Williams BA Business (Human Resource Management) Part time online learning How does it work? Studying the BA (Hons) Business Management online gives you the ultimate in convenience. You can enrol with Arden from anywhere in the world and study your degree from the comfort of home, without the requirement to attend classes in a physical location. Our online students study their degree through iLearn, Arden’s university campus in the cloud.  iLearn provides everything you need to study at University. It offers an integrated virtual learning experience, including your virtual classroom, lecture theatre, and access to our Library Portal. The portal includes an extensive digital library including thousands of journal titles, eBooks, and academic and industry databases which you can use to research your assignments and projects. All of these materials are provided to you free of charge, and contain all the research information you’ll need to complete your degree with us. iLearn is also integrated with Zoom, making it easier to chat with your course tutor during your scheduled seminar sessions. You can even integrate our study materials into your Kindle, making it possible to study wherever you have you Kindle handy. Studying online does not mean studying alone. As well as receiving regular feedback and guidance from your course tutor, you will be studying with likeminded students who you can meet with through our Unitu community, and you will have access to community message boards to discuss your course and the topics being raised within it. We have even set up community boards embedded into each of the course modules so you can have discussions with your tutor and classmates on the topics you are currently learning. Online learning students resident in the UK can apply for a Maintenance Loan if they cannot attend their course in person because of a disability. Learn more about online learning Full-time blended learning How does it work? When you choose our blended learning study mode, you’ll have eight hours of timetabled classes spread over two days at the Arden campus of your choice. This is combined with around 25 hours of independent study, which takes place through ilearn, our university campus in the cloud. ilearn contains all the resources you need to study successfully. As a blended learning student you’ll also have access to our Library Portal, an extensive digital library with thousands of journal titles, eBooks, and a range of academic and industry databases that you can use to research and gain in-depth information on your area of study. At Arden, all of your course materials are provided free of charge, removing the need for you to buy expensive textbooks to study your degree successfully. Blended learning is the best option for students who prefer the structure of regular face to face classes with their tutor and fellow classmates, and is particularly suited to students who live within commuting or driving distance of one of our UK campuses. If you're a student from England who is enrolling on a blended learning course with Arden (based in one of our UK campuses) then you can apply for a Tuition Fee Loan and Maintenance Loan to help pay for your living expenses. You can find more information on our fees and funding page . If you're a student from Scotland, Wales or Northern Ireland you can find information about obtaining a student loan to cover your costs from your student finance body. Meet the faculty Paul is an experienced academic leader with broad expertise across business management and significant specialist knowledge in assessment, quality, and academic governance. Prior to joining Arden University, he served as an Associate Head of School at Coventry University. This breadth of experience has given him a strong grounding in all aspects of higher education provision. Paul has led major curriculum transformation projects, extensive staff training initiatives, and complex regulatory compliance activity, and has contributed to the development of numerous courses both internally and in partnership with external institutions. His academic background is in sport business management, and he has undertaken research collaborations with organisations such as UEFA and the International Olympic Committee, with whom he secured a research grant. Paul brings an inclusive, collaborative leadership style grounded in integrity, innovation, and student-centred practice, and has forged his career within widening participation institutions. today Speak to an advisor Events & Open Days Download brochure Frequently asked questions What can I do with a business management degree? A business management degree opens the door to a wide range of careers across industries. Graduates commonly move into roles in marketing, finance, operations, HR, consultancy, and entrepreneurship. You could work as a business analyst, project manager, marketing executive, operations manager, or even launch your own business. Because the course develops transferable skills such as leadership, strategic thinking, data analysis, and decision-making, you’re not limited to one career path. Many graduates progress into management positions or specialise further through postgraduate study. Can I be an accountant with a business management degree? A business management degree can provide a strong foundation in finance, budgeting, and organisational strategy. However, if you want to become a qualified accountant, you’ll usually need specific accounting qualifications. If accounting is your main goal, you may wish to explore a Business Management pathway with Accounting and Finance, which includes more specialist financial modules aligned to accounting careers. Will I have a work placement? This course does not include a mandatory work placement. However, you’ll develop practical, career-focused skills throughout your studies, applying theory to real business scenarios. Many students choose to gain work experience alongside their studies to strengthen their CV. How will I be assessed? Assessment is designed to reflect real-world business practice. Instead of relying on traditional exams, you’ll typically complete coursework such as reports, presentations, case studies, portfolios, and practical projects. This approach allows you to demonstrate applied knowledge and build skills that are directly relevant to the workplace. Is a business management degree worth it? A business management degree equips you with versatile skills that employers value across sectors. You’ll develop leadership capability, commercial awareness, analytical thinking, and strategic decision-making skills. For many students, the long-term career flexibility, earning potential, and professional growth opportunities make it a worthwhile investment. How long does a business management degree take? A full-time undergraduate business management degree typically takes three years to complete. Part-time and online study options allow you to spread your studies over a longer period, offering greater flexibility around work and personal commitments. Arden University special? Education for everyone, everywhere Whether you're constrained by location, cost, time, or other life commitments, we're passionate about giving you access to higher education that fits into your busy, modern life. You decide how and where to study We offer a wide range of flexible undergraduate and postgraduate degrees in both our online and blended study modes. Full support both online and on-site We're also proud to offer non-standard entry, meaning your work experience and previous qualifications are taken into account when assessing your application. Strong focus on employability You will gain in-depth subject knowledge and transferable skills that employers from a huge range of industries will value. Many of our courses at Arden are also accredited by leading professional bodies in the UK. Course Overview Accounting and finance professionals perform important roles in almost all sectors of business. They use their specialist knowledge to help organisations make critical decisions and devise strategies for increasing organisational success. On our Ba (Hons) Business Management (Accounting and Finance) course*, we’ll help you develop a thorough understanding of modern financial theories, together with learning how and why organisations make those all-important accounting and finance and decisions. On your first academic year of the course, you’ll develop broad knowledge in key areas of business management, including managing people and an introduction to how modern organisations function. On the second and third years of your degree, you’ll learn how to use the key accounting and finance skills and technologies required to be successful in today’s workplace, as well as studying financial and cost accounting, risk management, business transformation, corporate governance, and more. You’ll also develop your understanding of the theoretical and practical aspects of a range of key accounting and finance functions, including an awareness of the legal and ethical environment in which domestics and international organisations now operate. This course has been launched with input from world-leading organisations and researchers so that you are exposed to the most relevant advancements in accounting and finance. That means you’ll be able to show future employers that you have the knowledge required to fill current skills gaps in the field. And because you’ll also graduate with a keen awareness of business areas such as operational planning, finance, and management theory, you’ll have gained important transferable skills that will give you flexible, future-proof career ahead. When you graduate from this course you will receive: BA (Hons) Business Management (Accounting & Finance) IOEE Professional Diploma in Enterprise and Entrepreneurship 5 exemptions from ACCA exams Find out more about Business at Arden Video • 2 mins Accreditation and Memberships ACCA Accredited This course is accredited by the ACCA and has been awarded five ACCA exemptions. CIMA Accredited This course has eight exemptions from CIMA at operational and certificate levels, and also awards the CIMA Diploma in Management Accounting. BGA Membership Arden University is a member of the Business Graduates Association (BGA), meaning students will receive complementary BGA membership. AACSB Membership Arden University is a member of the prestigious Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business (AACSB). Quick tools Explore your brochure Download the course brochure to take a look at your course modules and syllabus content. Download brochure Speak to an advisor Want to speak to one of our subject experts? Our advisors are ready to answer your questions! Click below to get started. Show me how Professional Accreditation This course is accredited by the Association of Chartered Certified Accountants (ACCA) and The Chartered Institute of Management Accountants (CIMA). Find out more Course details and modules By providing you with knowledge of the fundamentals of business and then developing your core skills and knowledge in modern accounting and finance, we’ll prepare you to become a skilled and informed professional in this exciting and rewarding career choice. During your studies you’ll gain a wider understanding of accounting and finance functions, operations, and technologies. You’ll also develop new personal and professionals attributes in dedicated skills-related modules to help build your soft skills and decision-making abilities. Learning research and data analysis techniques using academic and industry focused texts, articles, and reports, you’ll gain a better understanding of contemporary accounting and finance, management, and overall business functions, with the ability to analyse practical case studies drawn from a range of international organisations. Using our business simulation software, you’ll be able to access a virtual business and run it as your own enterprise – managing activities such as accounting and finance, sales, finances, people, product development, operations, and your supply chain. This will give you the chance to practice making critical decisions within a safe environment, helping you develop your ability to interpret commercial information and apply your learnings to generate a profit for your enterprise. You’ll also have access to our Digital Enterprise Hub throughout your course, which provides you with additional software and resources as well as real-world mentors and industry experts to draw knowledge from. The Digital Enterprise Hub also gives you the chance to engage in social learning with your classmates, developing your collaborative skills and providing the opportunity for networking with fellow professionals. "I was already in the working world and running two businesses. Not to mention I also have a young family, so the freedom online learning offered, and the cost effectiveness of the course, was a big draw for me." Adrian Williams BA Business (Human Resource Management) Modules You have 3-9 years to complete this course, which means you can take up to 3 years to complete each level. Most of our students, however, aim to complete the course within 3 to 6 years. Assessments Unlike on more traditional degree courses, you don’t need to sit any exams on the BA (Hons) Business Management (Accounting and finance), and you won’t need to spend the summer at home writing a dissertation either. Your assessments have been designed to help you apply your learning to real-word scenarios. This means you’ll be better prepared to apply the skills you’ve gained on the course to your professional role after graduation. As you work through your course modules you’ll have the chance to complete a range of useful assessment methods such as individual reports, case study analyses, group presentations, and personal independent assignments devised in consultation with your course module leader. Your assessments will have an emphasis upon personal discovery, digital technology, the application of theory to real world business, and management practice and innovative thinking. We encourage you to be innovative when carrying out your assignments and assessments. You can create podcasts, videos, infographics, consultancy reports, campaigns, posters, interviews, debate sessions, and more. This approach will help you develop skills you'll use in the real world, and most of all, is a fun and engaging way to demonstrate your knowledge and development. Online learning has actually helped me become very good with time management and given me the ability to prioritise tasks. Toby Bradley BA (Hons) Business & Accountancy Part time online learning How does it work? Studying the BA (Hons) Business Management  (Accounting & Finance) online gives you the ultimate in convenience. You can enrol with Arden from anywhere in the world and study your degree from the comfort of home, without the requirement to attend classes in a physical location. Our online students study their degree through iLearn, Arden’s university campus in the cloud. iLearn provides everything you need to study at University. It offers an integrated virtual learning experience, including your virtual classroom, lecture theatre, and access to our Library Portal. The portal includes an extensive digital library including thousands of journal titles, eBooks, and academic and industry databases which you can use to research your assignments and projects. All of these materials are provided to you free of charge, and contain all the research information you’ll need to complete your degree with us. iLearn is also integrated with Zoom, making it easier to chat with your course tutor during your scheduled seminar sessions. You can even integrate our study materials into your Kindle, making it possible to study wherever you have you Kindle handy. Studying online doesn’t mean studying alone. As well as receiving regular feedback and guidance from your course tutor, you’ll be studying with likeminded students who you can meet with through our Unitu community, and you’ll have access to community message boards to discuss your course and the topics being raised within it. We’ve even set up community boards embedded into each of the course modules so you can have discussions with your tutor and classmates on the topics you’re currently learning. Online learning students resident in the UK can apply for a Maintenance Loan if they cannot attend their course in person because of a disability. Please find more information on our fees and funding page . If you're a student from Scotland, Wales or Northern Ireland you can find information on Living Cost Loans from your student finance body. Meet the faculty Paul is an experienced academic leader with broad expertise across business management and significant specialist knowledge in assessment, quality, and academic governance. Prior to joining Arden University, he served as an Associate Head of School at Coventry University. He entered higher education in 2008 following a career in further education, progressing from Graduate Teaching Assistant through to Lecturer, Senior Lecturer, Principal Lecturer, Head of Department, Associate Head, and Head of School. This breadth of experience has given him a strong grounding in all aspects of higher education provision. Paul has led major curriculum transformation projects, extensive staff training initiatives, and complex regulatory compliance activity, and has contributed to the development of numerous courses both internally and in partnership with external institutions. His academic background is in sport business management, and he has undertaken research collaborations with organisations such as UEFA and the International Olympic Committee, with whom he secured a research grant. Paul brings an inclusive, collaborative leadership style grounded in integrity, innovation, and student-centred practice, and has forged his career within widening participation institutions. Paul Salisbury Head of School for Business Management and Creativity Career prospects Perhaps you have a strong idea of where you want to go with your accounting and finance degree, or maybe you want to keep your career options open for now? Either way, don’t worry if you’re still a little unclear about what the future holds. Our accounting and finance bachelor’s course will give you a range of in-demand and transferable skills that will help you understand how modern organisations work. This gives you the freedom to take your time deciding where in the business ecosystem you’ll fit best, be it as an entrepreneur, manager, or if you’re an experienced professional looking for a career change. As well as developing important soft skills, up-to-date knowledge of business functions, and career planning abilities, you’ll also be encouraged to develop a Personal Development Plan as you work through your degree. With support from our lecturers, this will help you track your progress and identify areas where you excel. On the course, your assessments will be linked to real-world workplace issues and practices. Added to the benefits of our enterprise simulation software and Digital Business Hub, you’ll graduate with hands-on experience in problem solving and identifying areas for business growth – all highly desirable skills for today’s employers. The BA (Hons) Business Management (Accounting and finance) will also give you the chance to: Comprehend and appreciate the importance of the key skills, technologies, and competencies required to be successful in the finance and accounting sector. Identify and evaluate the roles and contributions of the key business and finance functions applicable to contemporary organisations. Produce and evaluate relevant and robust solutions to meet the challenges located in modern accounting and finance practice. Apply and evaluate accounting theories and accounting principles to a range of business contexts, challenges, and situations. Develop your research and analytical skills. What can I do after Arden University? Your degree in accounting and finance will open up a wide range of career opportunities across industries. As you study with us you’ll have access to our dedicated career services portal, where you can access additional 'bolt-on' e-learning courses, employer presentations, and search for jobs worldwide. Of course, your course lecturers are always on-hand to provide advice and guidance when it come to your professional future. Just a few of the possible roles you might want to consider after graduation could include: Business Analyst Business Development Executive Buying Assistant Accounting Technician Actuarial Analyst Company Secretary Stockbroker Industry skills This course is accredited by the Association of Chartered Certified Accountants (ACCA) and The Chartered Institute of Management Accountants (CIMA). It is also aligned with available certificates from Amazon and Salesforce which you will be able to pursue independently as you study. Association of Chartered Certified Accountants (ACCA) Our BA (Hons) Business Management (Accounting and Finance) has been awarded five ACCA exemptions. This means that students who go on to study ACCA after graduation will start their studies at the appropriate level, studying only nine ACCA papers out of the standard 14 that make up the ACCA qualification. Chartered Institute of Management Accountants (CIMA) The Chartered Institute of Management Accountants (CIMA) provides continuing professional development services, funds academic research, develops thought leadership, and monitors professional standards in the accountancy sector. Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business (AACSB) membership. Arden University is a member of the prestigious Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business (AACSB). AACSB International is a global association of leaders in education and business dedicated to supporting and advancing quality business education worldwide. This membership reflects the fact that Arden University has successfully matched the high standards required by the AACSB, and enables the sharing of ideas and the exchange best practises between global business schools. Membership also gives our faculty members access to in-depth data and research to support the development of our courses and teaching methods, ensuring that we are able to provide you with the best possible university experience. The Institute of Enterprise and Entrepreneurs (IOEE) Arden University is an approved IOEE Centre of Excellence, highlighting our commitment to staying at the forefront of education and industry standards. We continuously update our services to meet market and student needs and offer IOEE membership to our staff, students, and learners. This course awards the IOEE Professional Diploma in Enterprise and Entrepreneurship The Institute of Enterprise and Entrepreneurs (IOEE) is the first learning institute dedicated to developing and recognising enterprise and entrepreneurial skills. Arden University has been recognised as an IOEE Academy and our courses are accredited. This demonstrates our commitment to enterprise and equipping students with the skills needed to set up and run their own business, work in a small enterprise, or bring entrepreneurial skills to a larger organisation. Aligned to Salesforce and AWS Educate (Amazon) During the course you will learn about some of the most prominent cloud-based tools used in business currently, allowing you to independently acquire certification from Salesforce and Amazon to add to your degree qualification. Certification from Salesforce and Amazon will help you understand how to process real time data and insights to create more meaningful relationships with your customers. Business Graduates Association (BGA) The BGA is a membership and quality assurance body. As a member, Arden University have signed up to the BGA Charter, committing their institution to responsible management practices and lifelong learning, positively impacting their students, communities, and the economy. This shows our students that we are demonstrating responsible management ourselves, as well as it being a central theme that runs through our own courses. As Arden University is a member of the Business Graduates Association (BGA), students will receive complementary BGA student and graduate membership. Through this membership, current students will have access to the BGA Career Development Centre, packed with interactive tools, e-learning content, partner discounts and the latest job opportunities. This is a lifetime access, which means students will continue to have access to these services even after they graduate. Arden Enterprise Incubator As an Arden University student, you’ll have access to the Arden Enterprise Incubator (AEI) online platform to support you in the area of entrepreneurship. Whether students are exploring the idea of setting up their own company or need help and guidance launching or growing an existing business, the AEI provides everything students need to kick start their entrepreneurial journey, as well as to support and empower them along the way. The AEI has a wealth of resources available including monthly master classes, boot camps, podcasts, blogs, external events, and mentorship. Mentors include Arden University lecturers and industry experts, so our students receive the very best support and expertise. As an IOEE Centre of Excellence, we foster an entrepreneurial culture among our students. We are dedicated to supporting their continuous growth by promoting enterprising thinking and practical entrepreneurial skills. Register interest What makes Arden University special? Education for everyone, everywhere Whether you're constrained by location, cost, time, or other life commitments, we're passionate about giving you access to higher education that fits into your busy, modern life. You decide how and where to study We offer a wide range of flexible undergraduate and postgraduate degrees in both our online and blended study modes. Full support both online and on-site We're also proud to offer non-standard entry, meaning your work experience and previous qualifications are taken into account when assessing your application. Strong focus on employability You will gain in-depth subject knowledge and transferable skills that employers from a huge range of industries will value. Many of our courses at Arden are also accredited by leading professional bodies in the UK. Course Overview The perfect choice for anyone who’s already completed a HND in business or an equivalent qualification, this course will equip you with the knowledge and skills that provide the perfect platform for a career in professional accounting and finance through six carefully selected degree modules. On the course, you’ll learn how to use the key accounting and finance skills and technologies required to be successful in today’s workplace, as financial risk management, business transformation, corporate governance, and more. You’ll also develop your understanding of the theoretical and practical aspects of a range of key accounting and finance functions, including an awareness of the legal and ethical environment in which domestics and international organisations now operate. This course has been launched with input from world-leading organisations and researchers so that you are exposed to the most relevant advancements in accounting and finance. That means you’ll be able to show future employers that you have the knowledge required to fill current skills gaps in the field. Find out more about Business at Arden Video • 2 mins Accreditation and Memberships ACCA Accredited This course is accredited by the ACCA and has been awarded five ACCA exemptions. BGA Membership Arden University is a member of the Business Graduates Association (BGA), meaning students will receive complementary BGA membership. AACSB Membership Arden University is a member of the prestigious Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business (AACSB). Quick tools Explore your brochure Download the course brochure to take a look at your course modules and syllabus content. Download brochure Speak to an advisor Want to speak to one of our subject experts? Our advisors are ready to answer your questions! Click below to get started. Show me how Professional accreditation This course is accredited by the ACCA, a leading professional organisation in accountancy. Learn more Course details and modules During your studies you’ll gain a wider understanding of accounting and finance functions, operations, and technologies. You’ll also develop new personal and professionals attributes in dedicated skills-related modules to help build your soft skills and decision-making abilities. Learning research and data analysis techniques using academic and industry focused texts, articles, and reports, you’ll gain a better understanding of contemporary accounting and finance, management, and overall business functions, with the ability to analyse practical case studies drawn from a range of international organisations. Using our business simulation software, you’ll be able to access a virtual business and run it as your own enterprise – managing activities such as accounting and finance, sales, finances, people, product development, operations, and your supply chain. This will give you the chance to practice making critical decisions within a safe environment, helping you develop your ability to interpret commercial information and apply your learnings to generate a profit for your enterprise. You’ll also have access to our Arden Enterprise Incubator throughout your course, which provides you with additional software and resources as well as real-world mentors and industry experts to draw knowledge from. The Arden Enterprise Incubator also gives you the chance to engage in social learning with your classmates, developing your collaborative skills and providing the opportunity for networking with fellow professionals. "I was already in the working world and running two businesses. Not to mention I also have a young family, so the freedom online learning offered, and the cost effectiveness of the course, was a big draw for me." Adrian Williams BA Business (Human Resource Management) Modules You have 1-3 years to complete this top up degree course, which means you can study at a pace that works best for you. Level 6 Modules Business Transformation (20 credits) Entrepreneurship and Innovation (20 credits) Corporate Governance, Law & Ethics (20 credits) Independent Study (20 credits) Financial Management (20 credits) Business Risk Management (20 credits) How do we assess you? Assessments Unlike on more traditional degree courses, you don’t need to sit any exams on the BA (Hons) Business Management (Accounting and finance), and you won’t need to spend the summer at home writing a dissertation either. Your assessments have been designed to help you apply your learning to real-word scenarios. This means you’ll be better prepared to apply the skills you’ve gained on the course to your professional role after graduation. As you work through your course modules you’ll have the chance to compete a range of useful assessment methods such as individual reports, case study analyses, group presentations, and personal independent assignments devised in consultation with your course module leader. Your assessments will have an emphasis upon personal discovery, digital technology, the application of theory to real world business, and management practice and innovative thinking. We encourage you to be innovative when carrying out your assignments and assessments. You can create podcasts, videos, infographics, consultancy reports, campaigns, posters, interviews, debate sessions, and more. This approach will help you develop skills you'll use in the real world, and most of all, is a fun and engaging way to demonstrate your knowledge and development. Study options This course is currently available to students as a fully online degree course, which gives you the convenience of being able to study from anywhere worldwide. It’s a great way to study if you’re looking for flexibility. It was challenging to balance a full-time job with my degree but once I was in a routine, it was much easier to manage everything. Online learning has actually helped me become very good with time management and given me the ability to prioritise tasks. Toby Bradley BA (Hons) Business & Accountancy Part time online learning How does it work? Studying the BA (Hons) Business Management (Accounting and Finance) (Top-Up) online gives you the ultimate in convenience. You can enrol with Arden from anywhere in the world and study your degree from the comfort of home, without the requirement to attend classes in a physical location. Our online students study their degree through ilearn, Arden’s university campus in the cloud.  ilearn provides everything you need to study at University. It offers an integrated virtual learning experience, including your virtual classroom, lecture theatre, and online library (which when used along with our supplementary library, Perlego, gives you access to almost half a million books and journals – yours for free while you study with us). ilearn is also integrated with Zoom, making it easier to chat with your course tutor during your scheduled seminar sessions. You can even integrate our study materials into your Kindle, making it possible to study wherever you have you Kindle handy. Studying online doesn’t mean studying alone. As well as receiving regular feedback and guidance from your course tutor, you’ll be studying with likeminded students who you can meet with through our Unitu community, and you’ll have access to community message boards to discuss your course and the topics being raised within it. We’ve even set up community boards embedded into each of the course modules so you can have discussions with your tutor and classmates on the topics you’re currently learning. Online learning students resident in the UK can apply for a Maintenance Loan if they cannot attend their course in person because of a disability. Please find more information on our fees and funding page . If you're a student from Scotland, Wales or Northern Ireland you can find information on Living Cost Loans from your student finance body. Learn more about online learning Entry requirements At Arden University we consider applications on a case by case basis. If you have significant work experience, have qualifications you have gained elsewhere, or a degree or qualification that isn't a clear pathway to this degree - we are more than happy to discuss your application. Eligibility To be eligible for our BA (Hons) Business Management (Accounting and finance) (Top-Up) course, you must have: A pass or above in GSCE mathematics (or equivalent) to entry requirements. A HND in Business or equivalent, provided that your prior learning is consistent with Level 5 of the functional areas of business such as finance, marketing, operations management, human resource management, etc. English proficiency IELTS 6.0 (no less than 5.5 in any element); or TOEFL iBT 80; or equivalent Alternatively, evidence you have previously studied in English, such as a letter to show that the Medium of Instruction was in English can be accepted. Meet the faculty Paul is an experienced academic leader with broad expertise across business management and significant specialist knowledge in assessment, quality, and academic governance. Prior to joining Arden University, he served as an Associate Head of School at Coventry University. He entered higher education in 2008 following a career in further education, progressing from Graduate Teaching Assistant through to Lecturer, Senior Lecturer, Principal Lecturer, Head of Department, Associate Head, and Head of School. This breadth of experience has given him a strong grounding in all aspects of higher education provision. Paul has led major curriculum transformation projects, extensive staff training initiatives, and complex regulatory compliance activity, and has contributed to the development of numerous courses both internally and in partnership with external institutions. His academic background is in sport business management, and he has undertaken research collaborations with organisations such as UEFA and the International Olympic Committee, with whom he secured a research grant. Paul brings an inclusive, collaborative leadership style grounded in integrity, innovation, and student-centred practice, and has forged his career within widening participation institutions. Paul Salisbury Head of School for Business Management and Creativity Career prospects Perhaps you have a strong idea of where you want to go with your accounting and finance top up degree, or maybe you want to keep your career options open for now? Either way, don’t worry if you’re still a little unclear about what the future holds. Your accounting and finance bachelor’s course will give you a range of in-demand and transferable skills that will help you understand how modern organisations work. This gives you the freedom to take your time deciding where in the business ecosystem you’ll fit best, be it as an entrepreneur, manager, or if you’re an experienced professional looking for a career change. Related courses BA Business Management (Top-up) BA Business Management (Marketing) (Top-Up) BA Business Management (HRM) (Top-Up) Accounting and Finance Articles Career Advice What will the BA (Hons) Business Management (Accounting and finance) (Top-Up) do for me? As well as developing important soft skills, up-to-date knowledge of business functions, and career planning abilities, you’ll also be encouraged to develop a Personal Development Plan as you work through your degree. With support from our lecturers, this will help you track your progress and identify areas where you excel. On the course, your assessments will be linked to real-world workplace issues and practices. Added to the benefits of our enterprise simulation software and Digital Business Hub, you’ll graduate with hands-on experience in problem solving and identifying areas for business growth – all highly desirable skills for today’s employers. The BA (Hons) Business Management (Accounting and finance) (Top-Up) will also give you the chance to: Comprehend and appreciate the importance of the key skills, technologies, and competencies required to be successful in the finance and accounting sector. Identify and evaluate the roles and contributions of the key business and finance functions applicable to contemporary organisations. Produce and evaluate relevant and robust solutions to meet the challenges located in modern accounting and finance practice. Apply and evaluate accounting theories and accounting principles to a range of business contexts, challenges, and situations. Develop your research and analytical skills. What can I do after Arden University? Your top up degree in accounting and finance will open up a wide range of career opportunities across industries. As you study with us you’ll have access to our dedicated career services portal, where you can access additional 'bolt-on' e-learning courses, employer presentations, and search for jobs worldwide. Of course, your course lecturers are always on-hand to provide advice and guidance when it come to your professional future. Just a few of the possible roles you might want to consider after graduation could include: Business Analyst Business Development Executive Buying Assistant Accounting Technician Actuarial Analyst Company Secretary Stockbroker Industry skills Association of Chartered Certified Accountants (ACCA) The Association of Chartered Certified Accountants (ACCA) is a powerful global presence within the accountancy profession, inspiring its members and students towards greater success and prosperity. Chartered Institute of Management Accountants (CIMA) The Chartered Institute of Management Accountants (CIMA) provides continuing professional development services, funds academic research, develops thought leadership, and monitors professional standards in the accountancy sector. The Institute of Enterprise and Entrepreneurs (IOEE) This course awards the IOEE Professional Diploma in Enterprise and Entrepreneurship The Institute of Enterprise and Entrepreneurs (IOEE) is the first learning institute dedicated to developing and recognising enterprise and entrepreneurial skills. Arden University has been recognised as an IOEE Academy and our courses are accredited. This demonstrates our commitment to enterprise and equipping students with the skills needed to set up and run their own business, work in a small enterprise, or bring entrepreneurial skills to a larger organisation. Aligned to Salesforce and AWS Educate (Amazon) During the course you will learn about some of the most prominent cloud-based tools used in business currently, allowing you to independently acquire certification from Salesforce and Amazon to add to your degree qualification. Certification from Salesforce and Amazon will help you understand how to process real time data and insights to create more meaningful relationships with your customers. Business Graduates Association (BGA) Arden University’s Faculty of Business is an esteemed member institution of the Business Graduates Association (BGA) . Arden Enterprise Incubator As an Arden University student, you’ll have access to the Arden Enterprise Incubator (AEI) online platform to support you in the area of entrepreneurship. Whether students are exploring the idea of setting up their own company or need help and guidance launching or growing an existing business, the AEI provides everything students need to kick start their entrepreneurial journey, as well as to support and empower them along the way. The AEI has a wealth of resources available including monthly master classes, boot camps, podcasts, blogs, external events, and mentorship. Mentors include Arden University lecturers and industry experts, so our students receive the very best support and expertise. As an IOEE Centre of Excellence, we foster an entrepreneurial culture among our students. We are dedicated to supporting their continuous growth by promoting enterprising thinking and practical entrepreneurial skills. Education for everyone, everywhere Whether you're constrained by location, cost, time, or other life commitments, we're passionate about giving you access to higher education that fits into your busy, modern life. You decide how and where to study We offer a wide range of flexible undergraduate and postgraduate degrees in both our online and blended study modes. Full support both online and on-site We're also proud to offer non-standard entry, meaning your work experience and previous qualifications are taken into account when assessing your application. Strong focus on employability You will gain in-depth subject knowledge and transferable skills that employers from a huge range of industries will value. Many of our courses at Arden are also accredited by leading professional bodies in the UK. Course Overview The BA (Hons) Business Management (Applied AI) prepares you to apply AI across modern business. You will combine core management knowledge with practical AI skills to solve business problems, support innovation and make informed decisions. This programme brings together business strategy and practical AI knowledge. You will explore how AI can be applied across different business functions, while also developing the skills to use AI effectively in your own studies. You will have access to Google Gemini Enterprise throughout your degree. Gemini Enterprise can help you work with complex course content by creating revision notes, audio overviews and visual summaries to support your learning. You will also take part in agentic AI simulations and management projects developed with Google Cloud. These practical activities will help you develop leadership, communication and project management skills in realistic business settings. You will have the chance to: Develop business management skills: Build knowledge across digital strategy, customer engagement and leadership. Explore AI in business: Learn how AI can be applied across different business functions and commercial challenges. Build leadership through simulations: Develop decision-making and management skills through practical scenarios. Use Gemini Enterprise in your studies: Adapt course content into formats that support your learning needs and pace. Explore responsible technology: Consider the ethical and wider social impact of AI in business. Course subject to validation Foundation Year available Quick tools Explore your brochure Download the course brochure to take a look at your course modules and syllabus content. Download brochure Speak to an advisor Want to speak to one of our subject experts? Our advisors are ready to answer your questions! Click below to get started. Show me how Career development resources You'll have online access to a huge range of career development tools from the day you start studying. Learn more Course details and modules As businesses continue to adopt AI, managers need to understand both business strategy and how new technologies can be applied effectively. This course helps you develop the knowledge and practical skills to work across this changing business environment. Throughout the degree, you will learn to lead teams, manage digital projects and apply AI to business challenges. You will also gain practical experience through projects and simulations developed with Google Cloud. By bringing together business management, AI and practical project experience, you will develop skills that can be applied across a range of roles and industries. You will graduate with the confidence and adaptability to take the next step in your career and continue developing as AI changes the workplace. Modules Foundation Year available Foundations of Business (30 credits) Fundamentals of Business Growth (30 credits) Foundation Year Project (30 credits) Skills for University Study (30 credits) Level 4 Skills Toolkit for Success: Build, Apply, Thrive (30 credits) Business, AI & Beyond (30 credits) Being a Successful Manager (30 credits) he Innovation Lab: Sustainable Solutions (30 credits) Level 5 The Innovation Lab: RE: Think, Enterprise and Mindset (30 credits) Digital Business and Customer Engagement (30 credits) Future Horizons: Data, AI and Insight (30 credits) AI Integration for Business Decision Making and Problem Solving. (30 credits) Level 6 Arden Impact Module (30 credits) Project Management (30 credits) Competitive Advantage and Strategic Value Creation (30 credits) AI Ethics, Equity, and Responsible Innovation. (30 credits) How do we assess you? Our assessments are designed to help you apply what you learn to real-world business situations. Rather than relying on traditional exams, you’ll complete a range of practical assessments that help you develop the skills, confidence and experience you’ll need for your future career. You will complete reports, case studies, presentations, projects, consultancy-style assignments and independent research. You’ll explore topics such as innovation, digital technology, AI, strategy, sustainability, leadership and management, with a focus on applying your learning to real business challenges. You’ll also have opportunities to demonstrate your knowledge in creative ways, such as podcasts, videos, infographics, campaigns, interviews and debates. This gives you the flexibility to play to your strengths while developing practical communication, problem-solving, digital and professional skills. Study options This course is available to study through Arden’s blended learning study mode at our campuses in London Ealing , London Stratford , London Holborn , Manchester , Birmingham , Leeds , Newcastle , and Nottingham . The course is also available to students via online learning . This gives you the convenience of being able to study from anywhere in the UK or worldwide, providing you with the same high standards of teaching but with lower tuition fees. Blended learning How does it work? When you choose our blended learning study mode, each week you’ll have eight hours of timetabled classes spread over two days at the Arden campus of your choice. This is combined with around 25 hours of independent study, which takes place through ilearn, our university campus in the cloud. ilearn contains all the resources you need to study successfully. As a blended learning student you’ll also have access to our Library Portal, an extensive digital library with thousands of journal titles, eBooks, and a range of academic and industry databases that you can use to research and gain in-depth information on your area of study. At Arden, all of your course materials are provided free of charge, removing the need for you to buy expensive textbooks to study your degree successfully. Blended learning is the best option for students who prefer the structure of regular face to face classes with their tutor and fellow classmates, and is particularly suited to students who live within commuting or driving distance of one of our UK campuses. If you're a student from England who is enrolling on a blended learning course with Arden (based in one of our UK campuses) then you can apply for a Tuition Fee Loan and Maintenance Loan to help pay for your living expenses. You can find more information on our fees and funding page . If you're a student from Scotland, Wales or Northern Ireland you can find information about obtaining a student loan to cover your costs from your student finance body. Learn more about blended learning Part time online learning How does it work? Studying the BA (Hons) Business Management online gives you the ultimate in convenience. You can enrol with Arden from anywhere in the world and study your degree from the comfort of home, without the requirement to attend classes in a physical location. Our online students study their degree through iLearn, Arden’s university campus in the cloud.  iLearn provides everything you need to study at University. It offers an integrated virtual learning experience, including your virtual classroom, lecture theatre, and access to our Library Portal. The portal includes an extensive digital library including thousands of journal titles, eBooks, and academic and industry databases which you can use to research your assignments and projects. All of these materials are provided to you free of charge, and contain all the research information you’ll need to complete your degree with us. iLearn is also integrated with Zoom, making it easier to chat with your course tutor during your scheduled seminar sessions. You can even integrate our study materials into your Kindle, making it possible to study wherever you have you Kindle handy. Studying online does not mean studying alone. As well as receiving regular feedback and guidance from your course tutor, you will be studying with likeminded students who you can meet with through our Unitu community, and you will have access to community message boards to discuss your course and the topics being raised within it. We have even set up community boards embedded into each of the course modules so you can have discussions with your tutor and classmates on the topics you are currently learning. Online learning students resident in the UK can apply for a Maintenance Loan if they cannot attend their course in person because of a disability. Please find more information on our fees and funding page . If you're a student from Scotland, Wales or Northern Ireland you can find information on Living Cost Loans from your student finance body. Meet the faculty Paul is an experienced academic leader with broad expertise across business management and significant specialist knowledge in assessment, quality, and academic governance. Prior to joining Arden University, he served as an Associate Head of School at Coventry University. He entered higher education in 2008 following a career in further education, progressing from Graduate Teaching Assistant through to Lecturer, Senior Lecturer, Principal Lecturer, Head of Department, Associate Head, and Head of School. This breadth of experience has given him a strong grounding in all aspects of higher education provision. Paul has led major curriculum transformation projects, extensive staff training initiatives, and complex regulatory compliance activity, and has contributed to the development of numerous courses both internally and in partnership with external institutions. His academic background is in sport business management, and he has undertaken research collaborations with organisations such as UEFA and the International Olympic Committee, with whom he secured a research grant. Paul brings an inclusive, collaborative leadership style grounded in integrity, innovation, and student-centred practice, and has forged his career within widening participation institutions. Education for everyone, everywhere Whether you're constrained by location, cost, time, or other life commitments, we're passionate about giving you access to higher education that fits into your busy, modern life. You decide how and where to study We offer a wide range of flexible undergraduate and postgraduate degrees in both our online and blended study modes. Full support both online and on-site We're also proud to offer non-standard entry, meaning your work experience and previous qualifications are taken into account when assessing your application. Strong focus on employability You will gain in-depth subject knowledge and transferable skills that employers from a huge range of industries will value. Many of our courses at Arden are also accredited by leading professional bodies in the UK. Course Overview The BA (Hons) Business Management (Business Intelligence & AI) helps you use data and AI to understand business challenges and make informed decisions. You will combine core business knowledge with practical skills in data analysis and digital technologies. Developed with Google Cloud, this programme brings together business management and practical AI skills. You will explore how businesses can use AI and data to understand customers, improve processes and support strategic decision-making. You’ll have access to Google Gemini Enterprise throughout your degree. This will help you to work with course materials in different ways, including creating revision notes, audio overviews and visual summaries to support your learning. You will also work with AI simulations that reflect real-world business challenges. These practical activities will give you experience in areas such as data visualisation, market analysis, strategic forecasting and more. You will have the chance to: Develop business intelligence skills: Build knowledge across data analysis, market research and strategic management. Learn with Google Cloud: Explore how AI and data are being used in modern business. Apply AI to business challenges: Use data-driven insights to explore practical commercial problems. Use Gemini Enterprise in your studies: Adapt course content into formats that support your learning needs and pace. Explore responsible AI use: Understand how to use business data and AI appropriately and ethically. Course subject to validation Foundation Year available Quick tools Explore your brochure Download the course brochure to take a look at your course modules and syllabus content. Download brochure Speak to an advisor Want to speak to one of our subject experts? Our advisors are ready to answer your questions! Click below to get started. Show me how Career development resources You'll have online access to a huge range of career development tools from the day you start studying. Learn more Course details and modules Businesses use data to understand their customers, markets and operations, creating opportunities for people who can turn information into useful insights. This course develops the business and digital skills needed to work with data and AI in a commercial setting. Throughout the degree, you will explore how businesses gather, analyse and use data to support decisions. You will also develop practical skills through projects and simulations developed with Google Cloud. By applying business knowledge to practical data and AI challenges, you will build the confidence and skills to support a future career in business, business intelligence and digital roles. Modules Foundation Year available Foundations of Business (30 credits) Fundamentals of Business Growth (30 credits) Foundation Year Project (30 credits) Skills for University Study (30 credits) Level 4 Skills Toolkit for Success: Build, Apply, Thrive (30 credits) Business, AI & Beyond (30 credits) Being a Successful Manager (30 credits) The Innovation Lab: Sustainable Solutions (30 credits) Level 5 The Innovation Lab: RE:Think, Enterprise and Mindset (30 credits) Digital Business and Customer Engagement (30 credits) Future Horizons: Data, AI and Insight (30 credits) Business Intelligence and Decision-making (30 credits) Level 6 Business Intelligence, AI and Competitive Advantage (30 credits) Data-driven Business Strategy (30 credits) Arden Impact Module (30 credits) Project Management (30 credits) How do we assess you? Assessments are designed to help you apply business intelligence, data and AI to real-world business challenges. You’ll use data to investigate problems, identify trends and opportunities, and develop evidence-based recommendations. You’ll complete a range of practical assessments, including data analysis, business intelligence reports, case studies, presentations, dashboards, projects and consultancy-style assignments. This approach will help you develop the ability to turn complex information into clear, useful insights that can support business decisions. Study options This course is available to study through Arden’s blended learning study mode at our campuses in London Ealing , London Stratford , London Holborn , Manchester , Birmingham , Leeds , Newcastle , and Nottingham . The course is also available to students via online learning . This gives you the convenience of being able to study from anywhere in the UK or worldwide, providing you with the same high standards of teaching but with lower tuition fees. Blended learning How does it work? When you choose our blended learning study mode, each week you’ll have eight hours of timetabled classes spread over two days at the Arden campus of your choice. This is combined with around 25 hours of independent study, which takes place through ilearn, our university campus in the cloud. ilearn contains all the resources you need to study successfully. As a blended learning student you’ll also have access to our Library Portal, an extensive digital library with thousands of journal titles, eBooks, and a range of academic and industry databases that you can use to research and gain in-depth information on your area of study. At Arden, all of your course materials are provided free of charge, removing the need for you to buy expensive textbooks to study your degree successfully. Blended learning is the best option for students who prefer the structure of regular face to face classes with their tutor and fellow classmates, and is particularly suited to students who live within commuting or driving distance of one of our UK campuses. If you're a student from England who is enrolling on a blended learning course with Arden (based in one of our UK campuses) then you can apply for a Tuition Fee Loan and Maintenance Loan to help pay for your living expenses. You can find more information on our fees and funding page . If you're a student from Scotland, Wales or Northern Ireland you can find information about obtaining a student loan to cover your costs from your student finance body. Learn more about blended learning Part time online learning How does it work? Studying the BA (Hons) Business Management online gives you the ultimate in convenience. You can enrol with Arden from anywhere in the world and study your degree from the comfort of home, without the requirement to attend classes in a physical location. Our online students study their degree through iLearn, Arden’s university campus in the cloud.  iLearn provides everything you need to study at University. It offers an integrated virtual learning experience, including your virtual classroom, lecture theatre, and access to our Library Portal. The portal includes an extensive digital library including thousands of journal titles, eBooks, and academic and industry databases which you can use to research your assignments and projects. All of these materials are provided to you free of charge, and contain all the research information you’ll need to complete your degree with us. iLearn is also integrated with Zoom, making it easier to chat with your course tutor during your scheduled seminar sessions. You can even integrate our study materials into your Kindle, making it possible to study wherever you have you Kindle handy. Studying online does not mean studying alone. As well as receiving regular feedback and guidance from your course tutor, you will be studying with likeminded students who you can meet with through our Unitu community, and you will have access to community message boards to discuss your course and the topics being raised within it. We have even set up community boards embedded into each of the course modules so you can have discussions with your tutor and classmates on the topics you are currently learning. Online learning students resident in the UK can apply for a Maintenance Loan if they cannot attend their course in person because of a disability. Please find more information on our fees and funding page . If you're a student from Scotland, Wales or Northern Ireland you can find information on Living Cost Loans from your student finance body. Learn more about online learning Entry requirements At Arden University we consider applications on a case by case basis. If you have significant work experience, have qualifications you have gained elsewhere, or a degree or qualification that isn't a clear pathway to this degree - we are more than happy to discuss your application. Eligibility To be able to study this course, we need to see that you have: Two subjects at GCE A level or equivalent, plus passes at grade C or above in three subjects at GCSE level or equivalent We’re happy to consider an application from you if you can show us that you have the motivation and at least two years of work relevant experience to study this degree. We’ll ask you for a personal statement that demonstrates your ability to study the course, along with references and evidence of your previous work experience. If you don’t meet the entry requirements an additional Foundation Year might be right for you: A minimum of 45 credits at Level 3 completed within the last 3 years, or equivalent. Applicants may be considered based on a minimum of 2 years of appropriate professional work experience evidenced with a CV and Reference if they do not meet the qualification requirements. English Proficiency IELTS 6.0 (no less than 5.5 in any element); or TOEFL iBT 80; or equivalent We’ll ask you for a personal statement that demonstrates your ability to study the course. We may also want references and evidence of relevant experiences. Course fees and funding Find your country I am a student from Please select ...
