University special? Education for everyone, everywhere Whether you're constrained by location, cost, time, or other life commitments, we're passionate about giving you access to higher education that fits into your busy, modern life. You decide how and where to study We offer a wide range of flexible undergraduate and postgraduate degrees in both our online and blended study modes. Full support both online and on-site We're also proud to offer non-standard entry, meaning your work experience and previous qualifications are taken into account when assessing your application. Strong focus on employability You will gain in-depth subject knowledge and transferable skills that employers from a huge range of industries will value. Many of our courses at Arden are also accredited by leading professional bodies in the UK. Course Overview Our online Level 4 CertHE Health and Care Management course has been developed in consultation with senior leaders from the NHS, Skills for Care, and Skills for Health to ensure you gain the professional expertise needed to get your career started in the sector. Taking a modern and digital-first approach, our course content is regularly updated to meet the needs of the sector. That means you’ll gain the leadership skills required to face today’s most pressing health and care challenges. During your studies, you’ll have access to valuable learning and networking resources from the Chartered Management Institute (CMI) and the Institute for Health and Social Care Management (IHSCM). This CertHE is the ideal choice if you’re currently unsure about committing to a full degree course, for newcomers wanting to enter the field, and for current professionals looking to gain a qualification to progress their careers. After you graduate, you’ll also have the chance to progress onto our DipHE and gain your diploma or complete a full undergraduate degree if you wish to do so. Arden is one of the only universities in the UK offering CertHE leadership courses contextualised for health and care. By undertaking this course, you’ll have better opportunities to apply for workplace funding than on a standard undergraduate degree. Health and Care Management at Arden Video • 1 min Accreditation and Memberships IHSCM Endorsed This course offers IHSCM student membership, giving you access to a diverse range of workshops, conferences  and networking. Quick tools Explore your brochure Download the course brochure to take a look at your course modules and syllabus content. Download brochure Speak to an advisor Want to speak to one of our subject experts? Our advisors are ready to answer your questions! Click below to get started. Show me how Professional accreditation This course is accredited by the Chartered Management Institute, supporting your career and connecting you with likeminded professionals. Learn more Course details and modules An innovative approach to health and care management is the only answer to the extensive changes the sector has experienced in the last years. This course has been developed in line with the ever-growing needs of the health and social care sector, highlighting the emerging skills required of today’s professionals and managers. I chose online learning because I do not currently have the capacity to attend classes as my days are full with running my household, my elderly parents’ household and tending to the needs of my 3-year-old. Online studying has been extremely helpful because it provides the flexibility I need in order to study at random times during the day or night. Cynthia Blow BSc (Hons) Psychology Modules The course has been developed in line with the ever-growing needs of the health and social care sector, highlighting the emerging digital and leadership competencies required of today’s professionals and managers. By covering the most relevant topics in the field, your modules ensure you’ll graduate with the skills you need to succeed. Level 4 core modules (20 credits each) Essential Skills for Health & Care Management Meeting the Needs of Service Users Communication & Interprofessional Collaboration Health Promotion Inclusive Rights Based Safeguarding in Health and Care Independent Regulation of Health and Care in the UK How will you learn? Extra support You will receive the same excellent support provided to all Arden students including success coaches, academic skills tutors and workshops, our careers team, and much more. You will also receive an additional four hours of online academic knowledge and study skills sessions as part of your course. Assessments Unlike on more traditional programmes, you won't be sitting any exams on the CertHE Health and Care Management. Your assessments will instead link your course material to health, care, and management practice, providing you with key transferable workplace skills for your future role. This will include things like essays, presentations, academic posters, reports, case studies, and podcasts. Study options I chose to study with Arden University because the staff members were really supportive and nice. The course also fitted around my job. With Arden, I’ve finally learned to cope and understand my learning pattern, and my dyslexia. I’m on a Blended Learning degree, which involves a couple of days a week in the classroom with other students and tutors at Arden’s University centre in Ealing, West London plus fully supported online study. Cemene Wellington BA (Hons) Healthcare Part-time online learning How does it work? Studying this course online gives you the ultimate in convenience. You can enrol with Arden from anywhere in the world and study your degree from the comfort of home, without the requirement to attend classes in a physical location. Our online students study their degree through ilearn, Arden’s university campus in the cloud. ilearn provides everything you need to study at university. It offers an integrated virtual learning experience, including your virtual classroom, lecture theatre, and access to our Library Portal. The portal includes an extensive digital library including thousands of journal titles, eBooks, and academic and industry databases which you can use to research your assignments and projects. All of these materials are provided to you free of charge and contain all the research information you’ll need to complete your degree with us. ilearn is also integrated with Zoom, making it easier to chat with your course tutor during your scheduled seminar sessions. You can even integrate our study materials into your Kindle, making it possible to study wherever you have your Kindle handy. Studying online doesn’t mean studying alone. As well as receiving regular feedback and guidance from your course tutor, you’ll be studying with like-minded students who you can meet with through our Unitu community, and you’ll have access to community message boards to discuss your course and the topics being raised within it. We’ve even set up community boards embedded into each of the course modules so you can have discussions with your tutor and classmates on the topics you’re currently learning. Online learning students resident in the UK can apply for a Maintenance Loan if they cannot attend their course in person because of a disability. Please find more information on our fees and funding page. If you're a student from Scotland, Wales, or Northern Ireland you can find information on Living Cost Loans from your student finance body. Learn more about online learning Introducing your Digital Backpack Once you’ve enrolled on your CertHE course with Arden you’ll get access to your Digital Backpack, a toolkit of digital resources we’ve put together to help you succeed during your time studying with us. Here are some of the digital resources you’ll have available from day one of your course: Office 365 subscription We set you up with a subscription to Microsoft Office 365 during your studies, completely free of charge, helping you create and manage your coursework and assignments in one handy cloud location. Zoom video conferencing Zoom is integrated into our online learning platform, ilearn. This makes it seamless to attend lectures​​ from any location and on any device. Career services through Arden Futures Careers support available through Arden Futures, your careers platform, to help you throughout your career journey whether you are a Career Starter, Changer or Developer. Library Portal Free online access to our Library Portal, which includes thousands of eBooks and journals, as well as industry databases which we’ve carefully hand-picked to support your studies – all yours for free while you study with us. To discover more about the resources available in our Digital Backpack, click here . Entry requirements At Arden University we consider applications on a case by case basis. If you have significant work experience, have qualifications you have gained elsewhere, or a degree or qualification that isn't a clear pathway to this degree - we are more than happy to discuss your application. Eligibility Level 4 CertHE Heath and Care Management Passes in two subjects at GCE A Level or equivalent, plus passes at grade C or above in three subjects at GCSE level or equivalent​. If you can’t fulfil these requirements, we will also consider applications that demonstrate significant skills and responsibility in a health and/or care role. English proficiency For students whose English is not their first language, IELTS 6.0 (no less than 5.5 in any element); or TOEFL iBT 80; or equivalent. We’ll give you all the support you need to succeed. Then, when you graduate from the CertHE course, you'll be able to progress on to the rest of the degree course if you decide it’s right for you. To find out more about the CertHE, click here . Course fees and funding Find your country I am a student from Please select ... Meet the faculty Dr. Stephanie West joined Arden University in November 2020 and is the Head of the School of School of Leadership & Service Industry Management. In addition to her wealth of healthcare industry experience, Stephanie has held a number of Senior Academic and Leadership positions in Health, Social Care and Applied Science faculties at a variety of universities across the UK. Stephanie will provide leadership to the School of School of Leadership & Service Industry Management, ensuring that it delivers high quality academic provision and student satisfaction across all courses. Professor Stephanie West Head of School - School of Leadership & Service Industry Management Career prospects The Level 4 CertHE Health and Care Management provides you with a solid foundation in health and social care and sets the stage for joining the profession or continuing your studies. You’ll also have the chance to progress to our DipHE Health and Care Management . Related courses BSc (Hons) Health and Care Management with Foundation Year BA (Hons) Healthcare Management (Top-Up) BA (Hons) Business Management (Human Resource Management) Related articles Health and Social Care Articles Career Advice What can I do after Arden University? With a Level 4 CertHE Health and Care Management under your belt, you could work in the National Health Service (NHS), the vast social care sector, with a private healthcare provider, or for a voluntary or not-for-profit organization. We have a dedicated careers and employability team that will support you during your studies to achieve your career ambitions. Just some of the roles you might want to consider include: Health service management ​ Social care management ​ Registered Manager roles ​ Health promotion and education ​ Public health initiatives Industry skills Chartered Management Institute (CMI) The Chartered Management Institute (CMI) promotes excellence in UK management and leadership. The institute aims to boost career development across the management sector and connect you with likeminded professionals across diverse sectors. As the CMI possesses a Royal Charter, they are the only organisation in the UK that can award Chartered Manager status to its members – the gold standard in management. They are also active in business policymaking across the globe, and ensure that their more than 140,000 members are represented in policy decision-making. As an Arden student, you’ll have free CMI Membership throughout your studies, giving you access to a range of additional resources including a mentoring service and invitations to networking events both online and offline. Institute of Health & Social Care Management (IHSCM) This course is endorsed by the Institute of Health & Social Care Management , whose aim is to create a supportive professional body that is relevant in its activities and modern in its approach and that holds sector leaders in the NHS, social care, third sector and private healthcare amongst its members. The IHSCM works with Arden University to contribute to curriculum development and delivery. As an Arden student, you’ll become a student member of the Institute, giving you access to a diverse range of events, conferences, workshops and networks as well as opportunities for mentoring and coaching. You are also encouraged to apply for full membership of the Institute once you graduate from the course.                                   Stratford) Manchester Online Attendance Evenings (Blended) Weekdays (Blended) Flexible (Online) Duration Full-time: 3 years (Blended) Part-time: 3 years+ (Online) Apply today Speak to an advisor Register interest What makes Arden University special? Education for everyone, everywhere Whether you're constrained by location, cost, time, or other life commitments, we're passionate about giving you access to higher education that fits into your busy, modern life. You decide how and where to study We offer a wide range of flexible undergraduate and postgraduate degrees in both our online and blended study modes. Full support both online and on-site We're also proud to offer non-standard entry, meaning your work experience and previous qualifications are taken into account when assessing your application. Strong focus on employability You will gain in-depth subject knowledge and transferable skills that employers from a huge range of industries will value. Many of our courses at Arden are also accredited by leading professional bodies in the UK. Course Overview Studying computing with Arden means gaining the latest practical computing skills needed to meet the demands of today’s rapidly evolving computing sector. Our undergraduate course is designed to ensure you develop the expertise today’s employers are looking for. Advanced computing skills are in high demand in today’s global job market, providing you with ample opportunities to fill industry gaps, specialise, and progress your career. That’s why we’ve structured your learning to give you a foundation for ongoing skills development. What you’ll learn Our BSc (Hons) Computing offers in-demand skills sought after in today’s tech industry. Our modules cover areas of computing such as programming (Java, Python, PHP), web development (HTML, CSS, Javascript), databases (MySQL), cloud computing, cyber security, data analysis, human-computer interaction, and computing ethics. You can tailor the skills you learn by choosing between two curated pathways depending on your aspirations: a technical pathway and an information systems pathway. Learn by doing Many of our modules are ‘hands-on’ and designed to equip you with the practical skills you need for your career. Unlike many computing courses that lack real-world preparation, our programme focuses on practical, authentic assessments. As such, you'll engage in coding, database creation, web document development, data analysis, and working with cloud services before engaging in assessments that allow you to demonstrate these skills. Why choose Arden? Video • 1 min Quick tools Explore your brochure Download the course brochure to take a look at your course modules and syllabus content. Download brochure Speak to an advisor Want to speak to one of our subject experts? Our advisors are ready to answer your questions! Click below to get started. Show me how Added industry skills Add to your skills with access to certified courses from Salesforce, Cisco, and Amazon. Find out how Course details and modules Our award-winning curriculum has been designed to give you the modern skill set needed to start your career on the right footing. Your modules take a hands-on approach to provide you with transferable real-world skills for your future. You’ll have the opportunity to master coding, database and web document creation, data analysis, cloud computing, IT project management, systems analysis soft skills, and more. Just some of the fascinating modules available on this course include: Data Mining In the modern workplace and wider society, data reigns supreme. Learn how to manipulate and visualise data to make informed business decisions across various sectors. Develop skills in Python, one of the most popular programming languages in data science. Web Application Development Today, applications are as likely to run in a web browser as on a desktop. Showcase your ability to create interactive web-based systems by combining the diverse skills you've acquired in databases, programming, web design, and user experience. Ethics, Quality and Sustainability in Technological Environments Examine the dilemmas that IT practitioners face and explore the potential impacts of their decisions using current examples. Utilise ethical frameworks and professional codes of conduct relevant to IT professionals. Recent news events highlighting the impact of faulty computer systems underscore the importance of embedding ethical practices and behaviours throughout an organisation. I have learned a lot from the course program and it has given me a good foundation for me to expand my knowledge. The module structure is designed according to my knowledge requirements of my personal IT goals. Janka Krsteva BSc Computing Online The course gave me the confidence and skills to go for senior jobs that I wouldn’t have previously. I have been promoted several times since. Martin Scahill BSc (Hons) Business & Computing (Top-Up) Modules You have between 3 to 9 years to complete this course, which means you can take up to 3 years to complete each level. Most of our students, however, aim to complete their studies within 3 to 6 years. Level 4 Introduction to Academic Skills and Professional Development (20 credits) Introduction to Operating Systems & Security (20 credits) Introduction to Databases (20 credits) Introduction to Programming (20 credits) Introduction to Web Authoring (20 credits) Introduction to Networking (20 credits) Data Analysis & Visualisation (Only available for April 2026 Online learning intake) Level 5 Human Computer Interaction (Core) Data Analysis and Visualisation (Core) IT Project Management (Core) Systems Analysis and Design (Core) Then choose either: Technical route Advanced Databases (Elective) Object Oriented Programming (Elective) or Information Systems route Digital Business (Elective) Ethics, Quality and Sustainability in Technological Environments (Elective) Level 6 Data Mining (Core) – 20 credits Distributed and Cloud Computing (Core) – 20 credits Information Security Management (Core) – 20 credits Computing Project (Core) – 40 credits Then choose either: Technical Route Web Application Development (Elective) – 20 credits or Information Systems route Technology Entrepreneurship (Elective) – 20 credits Web Application Development is available only to students who completed the Technical option set at Level 5. All other students will take Technology Entrepreneurship. Please note that if you study via our blended learning study mode, not all modules may be available at every Arden study centre. However, timetables will be coordinated to accommodate students who need to travel to other study centres or participate in live online classes. Pathways that align with your career ambitions We offer two pathways starting from Level 5, allowing you to tailor your degree to your career goals – giving you the choice to build your skills on the technical side or develop the strategic skills needed to help companies grow: Technical Pathway: Build on your programming, database, and web development skills on this path. If your ambition is to excel in software development, database design, or web development, the technical pathway is the ideal choice for you. Information Systems Pathway: This pathway focuses on digital transformation, ethical considerations, and strategic approaches to system security. If you aim to pursue leadership roles in IT management or seek strategic positions, the information systems pathway equips you with the necessary insights into contemporary workplace challenges. Free vendor courses We align our resources with industry leaders like Oracle, Cisco, and Amazon, offering you the chance to pursue certifications and badges that enhance your employability. You will have access to a variety of free courses offered by these vendors. While we don’t cover certification costs, our programme prepares you for these exams, allowing you to pay for them when you are ready. How do we assess you? Real-world alignment: Our assessments mirror professional scenarios Only one exam (Level 4, Introduction to Computer Systems and Security), through a time-controlled assessment. The rest of your modules involve hands-on activities directly relevant to computing roles. You'll engage in creating databases, coding websites and web applications, writing programs, crafting project documents, analysing case studies and scenarios, and using spreadsheets for data visualisation and analysis, including working with large datasets. All of this will allow you to start building a professional portfolio of work to show to future employers. Study options This course is available to study through Arden’s blended learning study mode at our campuses in London Ealing , London Stratford , London Holborn , Manchester , Birmingham Leeds and Berlin , Germany. The course is also available to students via online learning . This gives you the convenience of being able to study from anywhere in the UK or worldwide, providing you with the same high standards of teaching but with lower tuition fees. "I was already in the working world and running two businesses. Not to mention I also have a young family, so the freedom online learning offered, and the cost effectiveness of the course, was a big draw for me." Adrian Williams BA Business (Human Resource Management) Blended learning How does it work? When you choose our blended learning study mode, each week you’ll have eight hours of timetabled classes spread over two days at the Arden campus of your choice. This is combined with around 25 hours of independent study, which takes place through ilearn, our university campus in the cloud. ilearn contains all the resources you need to study successfully. As a blended learning student you’ll also have access to our Library Portal, an extensive digital library with thousands of journal titles, eBooks, and a range of academic and industry databases that you can use to research and gain in-depth information on your area of study. At Arden, all of your course materials are provided free of charge, removing the need for you to buy expensive textbooks to study your degree successfully. Blended learning is the best option for students who prefer the structure of regular face to face classes with their tutor and fellow classmates, and is particularly suited to students who live within commuting or driving distance of one of our UK campuses. If you're a student from England who is enrolling on a blended learning course with Arden (based in one of our UK campuses) then you can apply for a Tuition Fee Loan and Maintenance Loan to help pay for your living expenses. You can find more information on our fees and funding page . If you're a student from Scotland, Wales or Northern Ireland you can find information about obtaining a student loan to cover your costs from your student finance body. This course is also available to study full-time at our campus in Berlin, Germany, where you’ll have the opportunity to experience life as an international student in the heart of one of Europe’s most dynamic and historic cities. Learn more about blended learning Online learning How does it work? Studying this course online gives you the ultimate in convenience. You can enrol with Arden from anywhere in the world and study your degree from the comfort of home, without the requirement to attend classes in a physical location. Our online students study their degree through ilearn, Arden’s university campus in the cloud.  ilearn provides everything you need to study at University. It offers an integrated virtual learning experience, including your virtual classroom, lecture theatre, and access to our Library Portal. The portal includes an extensive digital library including thousands of journal titles, eBooks, and academic and industry databases which you can use to research your assignments and projects. All of these materials are provided to you free of charge, and contain all the research information you’ll need to complete your degree with us. ilearn is also integrated with Zoom, making it easier to chat with your course tutor during your scheduled seminar sessions. You can even integrate our study materials into your Kindle, making it possible to study wherever you have you Kindle handy. Studying online doesn’t mean studying alone. As well as receiving regular feedback and guidance from your course tutor, you’ll be studying with likeminded students who you can meet with through our Unitu community, and you’ll have access to community message boards to discuss your course and the topics being raised within it. We’ve even set up community boards embedded into each of the course modules so you can have discussions with your tutor and classmates on the topics you’re currently learning. Learn more about online learning Entry requirements At Arden University we consider applications on a case by case basis. If you have significant work experience, have qualifications you have gained elsewhere, or a degree or qualification that isn't a clear pathway to this degree - we are more than happy to discuss your application. Eligibility To be eligible to study this degree, we need to see that you have: Two subjects at GCE A-Level or equivalent, plus passes at grade C or above in three subjects at GCSE level or equivalent; or If you don’t currently hold the above qualifications, we also offer this course with an additional foundation year , which is designed for students who need extra support when starting their degree course. Please note that the Foundation Year course is offered exclusively in a blended learning mode and is not available for those wishing to study entirely online. Do you have work experience? We’re happy to consider an application from you if you can show us that you have the motivation and at least two years of work relevant experience to study this degree. We’ll ask you for a personal statement that demonstrates your ability to study the course, along with references and evidence of your previous work experience. English Proficiency IELTS 6.0 (no less than 5.5 in any element); or TOEFL iBT 60-78; or equivalent Alternatively, evidence you have previously studied in English; a letter to show that the Medium of Instruction was in English can be accepted. We will consider alternative qualifications to evidence the maths component, as this qualification includes research methods which involve statistics. We’ll ask you for a personal statement that demonstrates your ability to study the course. We may also want references and evidence of relevant experiences. Course fees and funding This course is pre-approved for second degree funding for students resident in England. This means that, even if this is your second bachelor’s degree, you may still be eligible for funding from the Student Loans Company (SLC). Find out more here . Meet the faculty Dr Steve Johnston joined Arden University in November 2025 as the new Associate Dean of the Faculty of Social Sciences and Technology. Steve holds an undergraduate degree in Astrophysics and Psychology from Keele University and earned a PhD at the Centre for Applied Mathematics and Computation (CAMAC) in Coventry in 2002. After early experience developing software for a 3D scanning firm, Steve transitioned to academia, focusing on brain imaging research at Bangor University. Following this, Steve lectured in Psychology at Brunel University before joining Swansea University in 2012 as Senior Lecturer. He became Associate Dean for the Faculty of Medicine, Health and Life Science in 2021 where he led the delivery of traditional and professional healthcare programmes, drove curriculum innovation, and implemented enhancement strategies informed by data-driven insights. He is a Fellow of the Higher Education Academy. CompTIA’s “State of the Tech Workforce U.K.” reports that organisations are projected to employ approximately 2.06 million tech workers in 2023. Through our programme, you'll gain: In-demand skills that enhance your employability and readiness for the workforce. A portfolio to showcase your projects and accomplishments to potential employers. Hands-on experience across various modern computing areas, curated from our carefully selected modules. Employers highly value graduates who have their degree plus an industry recognized certification. Education for everyone, everywhere Whether you're constrained by location, cost, time, or other life commitments, we're passionate about giving you access to higher education that fits into your busy, modern life. You decide how and where to study We offer a wide range of flexible undergraduate and postgraduate degrees in both our online and blended study modes. Full support both online and on-site We're also proud to offer non-standard entry, meaning your work experience and previous qualifications are taken into account when assessing your application. Strong focus on employability You will gain in-depth subject knowledge and transferable skills that employers from a huge range of industries will value. Many of our courses at Arden are also accredited by leading professional bodies in the UK. Course Overview The BSc (Hons) Cyber Security develops the technical knowledge, practical skills and confidence you need to protect digital systems, data and organisations from cyber threats. Developed with Google Cloud, this programme combines Google's technical expertise with Arden's academic experience. You will develop core cyber security skills alongside knowledge of how AI is being used in modern cyber defence, while also learning how AI can support your own studies. You’ll have access to Google Gemini Enterprise throughout your studies. Gemini Enterprise can help you make course content easier to work with by creating revision notes, audio overviews and visual summaries. You will also work on agentic AI simulations and security scenarios developed with Google Cloud. These practical activities give you experience in areas such as threat detection, incident response and risk management. You’ll have the chance to: Develop cyber security skills: Learn about network security, ethical hacking, cyber threat intelligence and digital forensics. Learn through Google Cloud co-development: Connect your studies with current technology and industry practice. Work with agentic AI simulations: Apply your knowledge to practical security challenges and simulated cyber incidents. Personalise your learning: Use Gemini Enterprise to work with course content in ways that support your studies and learning pace. Develop responsible security practices: Explore governance, security management and risk control. Course subject to validation Foundation Year available Quick tools Explore your brochure Download the course brochure to take a look at your course modules and syllabus content. Download brochure Speak to an advisor Want to speak to one of our subject experts? Our advisors are ready to answer your questions! Click below to get started. Show me how Added industry skills Add to your skills with access to certified courses from Salesforce, Cisco, and Amazon. Find out how Course details and modules As organisations rely more heavily on digital systems, cyber security is an important part of protecting data, services and infrastructure. This course helps you develop the technical skills needed to work in this changing field. You will progress from foundational computing knowledge to specialist cyber security topics, building your understanding through academic study and practical activities. You will also gain experience through projects and simulations developed with Google Cloud, helping you apply what you learn to practical security challenges and prepare for a career in cyber security. Modules Foundation Year available CREATE (30 credits) Fundamentals of Software Development (30 credits) Applied Tech Concepts (30 credits) Skills for University Study (30 credits) Level 4 Core Modules Professional Digital Practice (Employability) (30 credits) Network & Cloud Fundamentals (30 credits) Programming for Digital Professionals (30 credits) Applied Data Analytics & AI (30 credits) Level 5 Core Modules Applied Professional Skills (Automated Workflows) (30 credits) Digital Forensics & Incident Management (30 credits) Optional Modules Information Security and Risk Management (30 credits) Cloud Infrastructure and Services (30 credits) Applied Data Intelligence (30 credits) Human-Centred Design and User Experience (30 credits) Level 6 Core Modules Arden Impact Module (30 credits) Secure System Engineering (30 credits) Cyber Threat Defence (30 credits) Optional Modules Internet of Things & Edge Computing (30 credits) Applied AI (30 credits) Big Data Engineering (30 credits) How do we assess you? Assessment on the course is designed to reflect the real-world complexity of cyber security, AI and professional practice. You’ll experience a varied and inclusive approach to assessment, helping you develop your knowledge and skills progressively throughout the course. You’ll complete a mix of individual and group work, written and practical assessments, and formative and summative activities, such as reports, case study analyses, presentations, and portfolios. Study options This course is available to study through Arden’s blended learning study mode at our campuses in London Ealing , London Stratford , London Holborn , Manchester , Birmingham , Leeds , Newcastle , and Nottingham . The course is also available to students via online learning. This gives you the convenience of being able to study from anywhere in the UK or worldwide, providing you with the same high standards of teaching but with lower tuition fees. Blended learning How does it work? When you choose our blended learning study mode, each week you’ll have eight hours of timetabled classes spread over two days at the Arden campus of your choice. This is combined with around 25 hours of independent study, which takes place through ilearn, our university campus in the cloud. ilearn contains all the resources you need to study successfully. As a blended learning student you’ll also have access to our Library Portal, an extensive digital library with thousands of journal titles, eBooks, and a range of academic and industry databases that you can use to research and gain in-depth information on your area of study. At Arden, all of your course materials are provided free of charge, removing the need for you to buy expensive textbooks to study your degree successfully. Blended learning is the best option for students who prefer the structure of regular face to face classes with their tutor and fellow classmates, and is particularly suited to students who live within commuting or driving distance of one of our UK campuses. If you're a student from England who is enrolling on a blended learning course with Arden (based in one of our UK campuses) then you can apply for a Tuition Fee Loan and Maintenance Loan to help pay for your living expenses. You can find more information on our fees and funding page . If you're a student from Scotland, Wales or Northern Ireland you can find information about obtaining a student loan to cover your costs from your student finance body. Learn more about blended learning Part time online learning How does it work? Studying the BA (Hons) Business Management online gives you the ultimate in convenience. You can enrol with Arden from anywhere in the world and study your degree from the comfort of home, without the requirement to attend classes in a physical location. Our online students study their degree through iLearn, Arden’s university campus in the cloud.  iLearn provides everything you need to study at University. It offers an integrated virtual learning experience, including your virtual classroom, lecture theatre, and access to our Library Portal. The portal includes an extensive digital library including thousands of journal titles, eBooks, and academic and industry databases which you can use to research your assignments and projects. All of these materials are provided to you free of charge, and contain all the research information you’ll need to complete your degree with us. iLearn is also integrated with Zoom, making it easier to chat with your course tutor during your scheduled seminar sessions. You can even integrate our study materials into your Kindle, making it possible to study wherever you have you Kindle handy. Studying online does not mean studying alone. As well as receiving regular feedback and guidance from your course tutor, you will be studying with likeminded students who you can meet with through our Unitu community, and you will have access to community message boards to discuss your course and the topics being raised within it. We have even set up community boards embedded into each of the course modules so you can have discussions with your tutor and classmates on the topics you are currently learning. Online learning students resident in the UK can apply for a Maintenance Loan if they cannot attend their course in person because of a disability. Please find more information on our fees and funding page . If you're a student from Scotland, Wales or Northern Ireland you can find information on Living Cost Loans from your student finance body. Learn more about online learning Entry requirements At Arden University we consider applications on a case by case basis. If you have significant work experience, have qualifications you have gained elsewhere, or a degree or qualification that isn't a clear pathway to this degree - we are more than happy to discuss your application. Eligibility To be able to study this course, we need to see that you have: Two subjects at GCE A level or equivalent, plus passes at grade C or above in three subjects at GCSE level or equivalent We’re happy to consider an application from you if you can show us that you have the motivation and at least two years of work relevant experience to study this degree. We’ll ask you for a personal statement that demonstrates your ability to study the course, along with references and evidence of your previous work experience. If you don’t meet the entry requirements an additional Foundation Year might be right for you: A minimum of 45 credits at Level 3 completed within the last 3 years, or equivalent. Applicants may be considered based on a minimum of 2 years of appropriate professional work experience evidenced with a CV and Reference if they do not meet the qualification requirements. English Proficiency IELTS 6.0 (no less than 5.5 in any element); or TOEFL iBT 80; or equivalent We’ll ask you for a personal statement that demonstrates your ability to study the course. We may also want references and evidence of relevant experiences. Course fees and funding Find your country I am a student from Please select ... Meet the faculty A future-facing faculty preparing graduates for an AI-enabled world Hello, I’m Professor John Parkinson, Dean of the Faculty of Social Sciences & Technology (FoSST) at Arden University. I joined Arden after twenty-five years of research, teaching, and leadership in UK higher education. Throughout my career, I have been driven by a passion for understanding human behaviour and creating learning environments that help people thrive. My academic career has centred on behavioural science, human motivation, applied research, and public policy. Beyond academia, I am a qualified counsellor and a strong advocate for student-centred, future-focused education. These experiences have shown me how quickly society shifts — and how vital it is that education keeps pace. At Arden, we are committed to ensuring that every student encounters an AI-infused curriculum, develops the literacies needed to thrive in data-rich workplaces, and learns to apply technology ethically and insightfully to real-world challenges. Throughout the Faculty, we have a deep commitment to applied, interdisciplinary learning, preparing students for the complexities of an evolving world. Across psychology, computing and data science, criminology, law, and the social sciences, our faculty brings together disciplines that are all being reshaped by artificial intelligence and rapid technological change. With the university’s new investment and strategic focus on digital transformation, our mission is clear: to prepare graduates who can harness the power of AI responsibly, creatively, and confidently. We champion interdisciplinary thinking because the future will demand nothing less. Whatever programme you study, you will experience learning that is flexible, applied, technology-enabled, and grounded in strong academic foundations. Our goal is to not only help you succeed academically, but to ensure you graduate ready for the emerging AI-augmented professions of the future — resilient, skilled, and able to make a positive impact on society. Welcome to the Faculty of Social Sciences & Technology. I look forward to supporting you as we build this ambitious, future-ready community together. Professor John Parkinson, PhD, PGDip, FHEA Dean of the Faculty of Social Sciences & Technology Career prospects In a collaboration with Google Cloud, we’ve created brand-new, future-focused degree programmes. Designed with Google Cloud experts, these courses bridge the gap between higher education and cutting-edge tech industry demands, helping you build skills for a successful career across cyber security, data and intelligence, and AI. A New Partnership in AI Education | Arden University & Google Cloud related courses BSc (Hons) Data Science and AI BSc (Hons) Applied AI Engineering BEng (Hons) Digital Engineering BEng (Hons) AI Systems Design Engineering What will the BSc (Hons) Cyber Security do for me? The course will help you develop a strong technical foundation before specialising in cyber security. You’ll build practical digital and computing skills alongside your cyber security knowledge, giving you the confidence to understand, assess and respond to security challenges. You’ll also develop an understanding of AI and emerging technologies, including how they can support learning, problem-solving and professional practice. Through Arden’s partnership with Google Cloud, you’ll have opportunities to engage with Google Cloud expertise and technology as the partnership develops, and prepare for a career in cyber security and technology with industry-relevant knowledge and experience. What can I do after Arden University? Cyber security is an increasingly important part of the digital economy, with organisations across every sector needing skilled professionals to protect their systems, data and people. This course will give you a broad technical foundation alongside specialist cyber security skills, helping you prepare for a range of roles as you develop your experience. Potential career paths could include: Cyber Security Analyst Security Analyst Cyber Security Consultant SOC Analyst Information Security Analyst Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst Digital Forensics Analyst Network Security Specialist IT Security Specialist Incident Response Analyst Security Engineer Junior Cyber Security Technician Industry skills Future-defining degrees, developed with Google Cloud Designed with Google Cloud experts, our created brand-new, future-focused degree programmes bridge the gap between higher education and cutting-edge tech industry demands covering cyber security, data science, AI systems engineering, applied AI in business management, and more. Education for everyone, everywhere Whether you're constrained by location, cost, time, or other life commitments, we're passionate about giving you access to higher education that fits into your busy, modern life. You decide how and where to study We offer a wide range of flexible undergraduate and postgraduate degrees in both our online and blended study modes. Full support both online and on-site We're also proud to offer non-standard entry, meaning your work experience and previous qualifications are taken into account when assessing your application. Strong focus on employability You will gain in-depth subject knowledge and transferable skills that employers from a huge range of industries will value. Many of our courses at Arden are also accredited by leading professional bodies in the UK. Course Overview On the BSc (Hons) Data Science and AI you’ll develop the technical and analytical skills you need to turn data into useful insights and support better decision-making. Developed with Google Cloud, this programme combines Google's technical expertise with Arden's academic experience. You will build strong foundations in data science alongside practical AI skills, learning how AI works and how to use it effectively in your studies and future career. You will have access to Google Gemini Enterprise throughout your degree. Gemini Enterprise can help you work with complex topics by creating revision notes, audio overviews and visual guides to support your learning. You will also work on agentic AI simulations and real-world projects developed with Google Cloud. These practical experiences will help you apply your skills in cloud, database and data analytics environments. You’ll have the chance to: Develop practical data science and AI skills , including programming, machine learning and AI-enabled systems. Build technical knowledge across SQL, databases, data management, data pipelines and cloud technologies. Gain practical experience through agentic AI simulations and projects co-developed with Google Cloud. Personalise your learning using Gemini Enterprise to support your studies and learning pace. Understand data security and governance , including the responsible and ethical use of AI. Course subject to validation Foundation Year available Quick tools Explore your brochure Download the course brochure to take a look at your course modules and syllabus content. Download brochure Speak to an advisor Want to speak to one of our subject experts? Our advisors are ready to answer your questions! Click below to get started. Show me how Added industry skills Add to your skills with access to certified courses from Salesforce, Cisco, and Amazon. Find out how Course details and modules Organisations across many industries are using AI and data to improve how they work. This course helps you develop the technical skills needed to work with data, AI and cloud technologies. You will build your knowledge across programming, analytics, cloud platforms and data governance, while applying what you learn through practical projects. By combining academic learning with experience developed alongside Google Cloud, you will graduate with practical data science and AI skills to support your future career. Modules Foundation Year available CREATE (30 credits) Fundamentals of Software Development (30 credits) Applied Tech Concepts (30 credits) Skills for University Study (30 credits) Level 4 Core Modules Programming for Digital Professionals (30 credits) Networking (30 credits) Data Foundations (30 credits) Professional Digital Practice (30 credits) Level 5 Core Modules Applied Professional Skills (Automated Workflows) (30 credits) Advanced Programming (30 credits) Optional Modules Information Security (InfoSec/GRAC) (30 credits) UX/UI Design (HCI) (30 credits) Database Systems and SQL (30 credits) Cloud Infrastructure and Services (30 credits) Applied Data Intelligence (30 credits) Level 6 AI / LLMs (30 credits) Machine Learning / Deep Learning (30 credits) Capstone Project (30 credits) Optional Modules Secure System Design (30 credits) Tech Entrepreneurship for Sustainability (30 credits) App Development (30 credits) Big Data Computing (30 credits) How do we assess you? Our assessments are designed to reflect the complexity of real-world technology, data and AI practice. You’ll develop your knowledge progressively, with varied and inclusive assessment approaches designed to support different ways of learning and demonstrate your skills. You will complete reports, case studies, presentations, portfolios and project work that allow you to apply your learning to realistic challenges. You will demonstrate practical skills by building databases, analysing datasets, developing data pipelines, creating data visualisations and evaluating AI solutions. This approach helps you build experience with the types of technical challenges you may encounter in your future career. Study options This course is available to study through Arden’s blended learning study mode at our campuses in London Ealing , London Stratford , London Holborn , Manchester , Birmingham , Leeds , Newcastle , and Nottingham . The course is also available to students via online learning . This gives you the convenience of being able to study from anywhere in the UK or worldwide, providing you with the same high standards of teaching but with lower tuition fees. Blended learning How does it work? When you choose our blended learning study mode, each week you’ll have eight hours of timetabled classes spread over two days at the Arden campus of your choice. This is combined with around 25 hours of independent study, which takes place through ilearn, our university campus in the cloud. ilearn contains all the resources you need to study successfully. As a blended learning student you’ll also have access to our Library Portal, an extensive digital library with thousands of journal titles, eBooks, and a range of academic and industry databases that you can use to research and gain in-depth information on your area of study. At Arden, all of your course materials are provided free of charge, removing the need for you to buy expensive textbooks to study your degree successfully. Blended learning is the best option for students who prefer the structure of regular face to face classes with their tutor and fellow classmates, and is particularly suited to students who live within commuting or driving distance of one of our UK campuses. If you're a student from England who is enrolling on a blended learning course with Arden (based in one of our UK campuses) then you can apply for a Tuition Fee Loan and Maintenance Loan to help pay for your living expenses. You can find more information on our fees and funding page . If you're a student from Scotland, Wales or Northern Ireland you can find information about obtaining a student loan to cover your costs from your student finance body. Learn more about blended learning Part time online learning How does it work? Studying the BA (Hons) Business Management online gives you the ultimate in convenience. You can enrol with Arden from anywhere in the world and study your degree from the comfort of home, without the requirement to attend classes in a physical location. Our online students study their degree through iLearn, Arden’s university campus in the cloud.  iLearn provides everything you need to study at University. It offers an integrated virtual learning experience, including your virtual classroom, lecture theatre, and access to our Library Portal. The portal includes an extensive digital library including thousands of journal titles, eBooks, and academic and industry databases which you can use to research your assignments and projects. All of these materials are provided to you free of charge, and contain all the research information you’ll need to complete your degree with us. iLearn is also integrated with Zoom, making it easier to chat with your course tutor during your scheduled seminar sessions. You can even integrate our study materials into your Kindle, making it possible to study wherever you have you Kindle handy. Studying online does not mean studying alone. As well as receiving regular feedback and guidance from your course tutor, you will be studying with likeminded students who you can meet with through our Unitu community, and you will have access to community message boards to discuss your course and the topics being raised within it. We have even set up community boards embedded into each of the course modules so you can have discussions with your tutor and classmates on the topics you are currently learning. Online learning students resident in the UK can apply for a Maintenance Loan if they cannot attend their course in person because of a disability. Please find more information on our fees and funding page . If you're a student from Scotland, Wales or Northern Ireland you can find information on Living Cost Loans from your student finance body. Learn more about online learning Entry requirements At Arden University we consider applications on a case by case basis. If you have significant work experience, have qualifications you have gained elsewhere, or a degree or qualification that isn't a clear pathway to this degree - we are more than happy to discuss your application. Eligibility To be able to study this course, we need to see that you have: Two subjects at GCE A level or equivalent, plus passes at grade C or above in three subjects at GCSE level or equivalent We’re happy to consider an application from you if you can show us that you have the motivation and at least two years of work relevant experience to study this degree. We’ll ask you for a personal statement that demonstrates your ability to study the course, along with references and evidence of your previous work experience. If you don’t meet the entry requirements an additional Foundation Year might be right for you: A minimum of 45 credits at Level 3 completed within the last 3 years, or equivalent. Applicants may be considered based on a minimum of 2 years of appropriate professional work experience evidenced with a CV and Reference if they do not meet the qualification requirements. English Proficiency IELTS 6.0 (no less than 5.5 in any element); or TOEFL iBT 80; or equivalent We’ll ask you for a personal statement that demonstrates your ability to study the course. Meet the faculty A future-facing faculty preparing graduates for an AI-enabled world Hello, I’m Professor John Parkinson, Dean of the Faculty of Social Sciences & Technology (FoSST) at Arden University. I joined Arden after twenty-five years of research, teaching, and leadership in UK higher education. Throughout my career, I have been driven by a passion for understanding human behaviour and creating learning environments that help people thrive. My academic career has centred on behavioural science, human motivation, applied research, and public policy. Beyond academia, I am a qualified counsellor and a strong advocate for student-centred, future-focused education. These experiences have shown me how quickly society shifts — and how vital it is that education keeps pace. At Arden, we are committed to ensuring that every student encounters an AI-infused curriculum, develops the literacies needed to thrive in data-rich workplaces, and learns to apply technology ethically and insightfully to real-world challenges. Throughout the Faculty, we have a deep commitment to applied, interdisciplinary learning, preparing students for the complexities of an evolving world. Across psychology, computing and data science, criminology, law, and the social sciences, our faculty brings together disciplines that are all being reshaped by artificial intelligence and rapid technological change. With the university’s new investment and strategic focus on digital transformation, our mission is clear: to prepare graduates who can harness the power of AI responsibly, creatively, and confidently. We champion interdisciplinary thinking because the future will demand nothing less. Whatever programme you study, you will experience learning that is flexible, applied, technology-enabled, and grounded in strong academic foundations. Our goal is to not only help you succeed academically, but to ensure you graduate ready for the emerging AI-augmented professions of the future — resilient, skilled, and able to make a positive impact on society. Welcome to the Faculty of Social Sciences & Technology. I look forward to supporting you as we build this ambitious, future-ready community together. Professor John Parkinson, PhD, PGDip, FHEA Dean of the Faculty of Social Sciences & Technology Career prospects In a collaboration with Google Cloud, we’ve created brand-new, future-focused degree programmes. Designed with Google Cloud experts, these courses bridge the gap between higher education and cutting-edge tech industry demands, helping you build skills for a successful career across systems, data infrastructure, analytics and AI technologies. A New Partnership in AI Education | Arden University & Google Cloud related courses BSc (Hons) Applied AI Engineering BEng (Hons) AI Systems Design Engineering What will the BSc (Hons) Data Science and AI do for me? The degree will give you the technical skills to help organisations make better use of their data. You’ll develop practical experience in designing data solutions, working with databases, understanding data infrastructure and applying analytical and AI technologies. Develop an understanding of data security, governance and responsible technology, helping you consider not just how data can be used, but how it should be managed and protected.. Build practical data skills, including database design, SQL and data management. Explore AI and analytics and how they can turn data into valuable insights. Develop knowledge of cloud and data infrastructure supporting modern organisations. Understand data security, governance and risk and the responsible use of AI. Apply your skills to real-world challenges, developing solutions for data-driven organisations. Become a data-driven technology professional Data is one of the most valuable assets for modern organisations, but turning data into meaningful value requires the right technology, infrastructure and expertise. This course focuses on the systems and solutions that make data useful, accessible and secure. What can I do after Arden University? The growing use of data, analytics and AI across almost every industry is creating demand for professionals who can build, manage and secure the data environments behind these technologies. This degree can prepare you for roles across data, technology, AI and information management. Potential career paths could include: Data Analyst Data Engineer Database Administrator Data Scientist Business Intelligence Analyst Data Governance Specialist Cloud Data Engineer AI Engineer Machine Learning Engineer Information Security Analyst AI Governance Specialist AI Risk Analyst Data Security Analyst Technology Consultant Industry skills Future-defining degrees, developed with Google Cloud Designed with Google Cloud experts, our created brand-new, future-focused degree programmes bridge the gap between higher education and cutting-edge tech industry demands covering cyber security, data science, AI systems engineering, applied AI in business management, and more.                                   Stratford) Attendance Weekdays (Blended) Duration Full-time: 2 years (Blended) Apply today Speak to an advisor Register interest What makes Arden University special? Education for everyone, everywhere Whether you're constrained by location, cost, time, or other life commitments, we're passionate about giving you access to higher education that fits into your busy, modern life. You decide how and where to study We offer a wide range of flexible undergraduate and postgraduate degrees in both our online and blended study modes. Full support both online and on-site We're also proud to offer non-standard entry, meaning your work experience and previous qualifications are taken into account when assessing your application. Strong focus on employability You will gain in-depth subject knowledge and transferable skills that employers from a huge range of industries will value. Many of our courses at Arden are also accredited by leading professional bodies in the UK. Course Overview Future-proof your career with a foundation in tech innovation Studying the FdSc Computing and Digital Futures at Arden University gives you the essential skills and knowledge to succeed in today’s tech-driven world. This two-year foundation degree builds a strong understanding of areas such as artificial intelligence, digital strategy, technology management, and ethical computing—preparing you for the demands of modern business and computing environments. Alongside core subject knowledge, you’ll develop vital academic and professional skills in critical thinking,research, and communication—ensuring you’re prepared not just for study, but for a successful career in technology. Whether you’re looking to launch your career in tech, specialise further, or progress onto a full BSc (Hons) degree, this course provides a practical and accessible pathway to your goals. Why study this course? Focus on business transformation through digital technology Learn to solve problems with computational thinking and user-centred design Explore programming, web and database development, and data-driven business strategy Build foundational academic and study skills with a dedicated module No exams—only real-world practical assessments using industry-standard tools Undertake a work-based project module to apply your knowledge in a real environment Quick tools Explore your brochure Download the course brochure to take a look at your course modules and syllabus content. Download brochure Speak to an advisor Want to speak to one of our subject experts? Our advisors are ready to answer your questions! Click below to get started. Show me how Career development resources You'll have online access to a huge range of career development tools from the day you start studying. Learn more Course details and modules Build your digital career with a 2-year foundation degree This Level 5 FdSc course gives you the tools to thrive in a wide range of computing and business roles. You’ll study practical skills alongside theoretical frameworks in areas like business intelligence, digital business, and user-centred systems. Our expert computing faculty keeps the course content updated to reflect industry trends—ensuring you’re learning the skills today’s employers want. Flexible study with support Delivered full-time via blended learning, the course is designed for flexibility. You’ll attend campus just one day per week, freeing up the rest of your time for independent study, work, or other responsibilities. This programme was developed to support students balancing their studies with career or life commitments. Pathway to a full degree Once you’ve completed your FdSc, you can progress to the final year (Level 6) of a related BSc degree to deepen your expertise and expand your career opportunities. I’ve found that studying my degree online with Arden has given me a much more comprehensive foundation of knowledge around the topics I don’t often encounter in my work role, including financial decision-making, ethics and strategy. This knowledge will enable me to progress to more strategic roles in the future. Simon Henry MBA Online What you’ll learn You’ll study one core module per study block. Alongside this, you’ll also work on Learning for Life: Skills for Study in your first year and the Workplace Impact Project in your second year—both of which run across three blocks to support deeper learning and real-world application. Modules Level 4 Core Modules Digital Skills for the Modern Workplace (30 credits) Learning for Life: Skills for Study and Work (Computing) (30 credits) Principles of Problem Solving and Programming (30 credits) Web and Database Technologies (30 credits) Level 5 Core Modules Business Intelligence (30 credits) Digital Business Transformation (30 credits) User Centred Design (30 credits) Workplace Impact Project - Applied Work-Based Learning for Computing and Design (30 credits) Study options This course is available to study through Arden’s blended learning study mode. Daytime classes are available in London Holborn and Birmingham. Full-time blended learning How does it work? Our blended learning model combines the structure of in-person teaching with the flexibility of online learning. You’ll attend eight hours of timetabled classes in person one day per week at your chosen Arden campus—designed to free up the rest of your week for work or other responsibilities. You’ll also engage in around 25 hours of independent study each week via iLearn, our virtual learning environment. iLearn gives you access to all the resources you need, including recorded lectures, learning materials, and our Library Portal—an extensive digital library with thousands of journals, eBooks, and academic databases. Blended learning is the best option for students who prefer the structure of regular face to face classes with their tutor and fellow classmates, and is particularly suited to students who live within commuting or driving distance of one of our UK campuses. If you're a student from England who is enrolling on a blended learning course with Arden (based in one of our UK campuses) then you can apply for a Tuition Fee Loan and Maintenance Loan to help pay for your living expenses. You can find more information on our fees and funding page. If you're a student from Scotland, Wales or Northern Ireland you can find information about obtaining a student loan to cover your costs from your student finance body. This course is also available to study full-time at our campus in Berlin, Germany, where you’ll have the opportunity to experience life as an international student in the heart of one of Europe’s most dynamic and historic cities. Learn more about blended learning Entry requirements At Arden University we consider applications on a case by case basis. If you have significant work experience, have qualifications you have gained elsewhere, or a degree or qualification that isn't a clear pathway to this degree - we are more than happy to discuss your application. Entry Requirements We welcome motivated learners from all backgrounds. Whether you're returning to education or just starting out, we’ll support you every step of the way. Standard entry: Minimum 60 credits from Level 2/3 qualification (e.g., GCSE, A-Levels, BTECs, Access to HE, or equivalent) with a minimum of 15 credits at level 3) Current professional C.V. Non-standard entry: 2 years’ work experience in a relevant role (industry specific work experience or professional certificates) of which some must have been completed in the last 12 months. English language proficiency: IELTS 6.0 (no less than 5.5 in any component) or equivalent Previous study in English may also be accepted Course fees and funding Find your country I am a student from Please select ... Qualified with Bachelors, Masters and Doctor of Philosophy, Lucy is also an avid conference presenter, guest speaker and sharer of practice in the HE community. Lucy is an experienced senior leader of foundation year provision in a HE context working with different sizes of provision and subject-areas and previous award-winning ‘Lecturer of the Year’ at the University of Northampton in 2019. Lucy’s understanding of the diverse student needs allows her to implement relevant interventions when needed as well as offering suitable pastoral support. Dr. Lucy Atkinson, PhD, MA, BSc, FHEA, AFBALEAP Director of the Centre of Academic Persistence Career prospects related articles Business and Management Articles Career Advice A future-ready qualification for the digital world This course equips you with cutting-edge computing knowledge, preparing you for roles across the digital and tech sectors. With a growing demand for professionals skilled in AI, data, and digital strategy, you’ll graduate ready to shape the future of business through technology. You’ll gain hands-on experience in modern computing areas like business intelligence, software development, and user-centred design—giving you the flexibility to follow a range of career paths, from software and web development to data analysis or digital consultancy. Upon graduation, you’ll also have the option to progress into a related degree to deepen your specialisation. Industry skills Go beyond your degree with professional skills training You’ll have access to optional micro-credentials designed to boost both your academic performance and career readiness. Unlock Your Potential Career This career-focused micro-credential will help you develop key professional skills, including digital literacy, communication, and career management—giving you the tools to build a confident and sustainable career path.
