University special? Education for everyone, everywhere Whether you're constrained by location, cost, time, or other life commitments, we're passionate about giving you access to higher education that fits into your busy, modern life. You decide how and where to study We offer a wide range of flexible undergraduate and postgraduate degrees in both our online and blended study modes. Full support both online and on-site We're also proud to offer non-standard entry, meaning your work experience and previous qualifications are taken into account when assessing your application. Strong focus on employability You will gain in-depth subject knowledge and transferable skills that employers from a huge range of industries will value. Many of our courses at Arden are also accredited by leading professional bodies in the UK. Course Overview Our online Level 5 DipHE Health and Care Management course has been developed in consultation with senior leaders from the NHS, Skills for Care, and Skills for Health to ensure you gain the professional expertise needed to advance to Registered Manager roles in the sector. Taking a modern and digital-first approach, our course content is regularly updated to meet the needs of the sector. That means you’ll gain the key leadership skills required to face today’s most pressing health and care challenges. During your studies, you’ll have access to valuable learning and networking resources from the Chartered Management Institute (CMI) and the Institute for Health and Social Care Management (IHSCM). This DipHE is the ideal choice if you’re currently unsure about committing to a full degree course and for current professionals looking to gain a qualification to progress their careers. With the Level 5 qualification under your belt, you’ll be able to apply for Registered Manager roles in health and care. After you graduate, you’ll also have the chance to progress onto your full undergraduate degree if you wish to do so. Arden is one of the only universities in the UK offering DipHE leadership courses contextualised for health and care. By undertaking this course, you’ll have better opportunities to apply for workplace funding than on a standard undergraduate degree. Health and Care Management at Arden Video • 1 min Accreditation and Memberships CMI Accredited This course awards a CMI Level 5 Diploma in Management & Leadership and offers CMI Foundation Chartered Manager Status. IHSCM Endorsed This course offers IHSCM student membership, giving you access to a diverse range of workshops, conferences  and networking. Quick tools Explore your brochure Download the course brochure to take a look at your course modules and syllabus content. Download brochure Speak to an advisor Want to speak to one of our subject experts? Our advisors are ready to answer your questions! Click below to get started. Show me how Professional accreditation This course is accredited by the Chartered Management Institute, supporting your career and connecting you with likeminded professionals. Learn more Course details and modules An innovative approach to health and care management is the only answer to the extensive changes the sector has experienced in the last years. This course has been developed in line with the ever-growing needs of the health and social care sector, highlighting the emerging skills required of today’s professionals and managers. I chose online learning because I do not currently have the capacity to attend classes as my days are full with running my household, my elderly parents’ household and tending to the needs of my 3-year-old. Online studying has been extremely helpful because it provides the flexibility I need in order to study at random times during the day or night. Cynthia Blow BSc (Hons) Psychology Modules The course has been developed in line with the ever-growing needs of the health and social care sector, highlighting the emerging digital and leadership competencies required of today’s professionals and managers. By covering the most relevant topics in the field, your modules ensure you’ll graduate with the skills you need to succeed. Level 4 CertHE modules (20 credits each) Essential Skills for Health & Care Management Meeting the Needs of Service Users Communication & Interprofessional Collaboration Health Promotion Inclusive Rights Based Safeguarding in Health and Care Independent Regulation of Health and Care in the UK Level 5 DipHE modules (20 credits each) Fundamentals of Health & Care Finance Leadership Theory & Concepts for Health & Care Management Resource Planning in Multidisciplinary Working Digital Health Leadership Evidence-Based Practice Compassionate Leadership How will you learn? Extra support You will receive the same excellent support provided to all Arden students including success coaches, academic skills tutors and workshops, our careers team, and much more. You will also receive an additional four hours of online academic knowledge and study skills sessions as part of your course. Assessments Unlike on more traditional programmes, you won't be sitting any exams on the Level 5 DipHE Health and Care Management. Your assessments will instead link your course material to health, care, and management practice, providing you with key transferable workplace skills for your future role. This will include things like essays, presentations, academic posters, reports, case studies, and podcasts. Study options I chose to study with Arden University because the staff members were really supportive and nice. The course also fitted around my job. With Arden, I’ve finally learned to cope and understand my learning pattern, and my dyslexia. I’m on a Blended Learning degree, which involves a couple of days a week in the classroom with other students and tutors at Arden’s University centre in Ealing, West London plus fully supported online study. Cemene Wellington BA (Hons) Healthcare Part-time online learning How does it work? Studying this course online gives you the ultimate in convenience. You can enrol with Arden from anywhere in the world and study your degree from the comfort of home, without the requirement to attend classes in a physical location. Our online students study their degree through ilearn, Arden’s university campus in the cloud. ilearn provides everything you need to study at university. It offers an integrated virtual learning experience, including your virtual classroom, lecture theatre, and access to our Library Portal. The portal includes an extensive digital library including thousands of journal titles, eBooks, and academic and industry databases which you can use to research your assignments and projects. All of these materials are provided to you free of charge and contain all the research information you’ll need to complete your degree with us. ilearn is also integrated with Zoom, making it easier to chat with your course tutor during your scheduled seminar sessions. You can even integrate our study materials into your Kindle, making it possible to study wherever you have your Kindle handy. Studying online doesn’t mean studying alone. As well as receiving regular feedback and guidance from your course tutor, you’ll be studying with like-minded students who you can meet with through our Unitu community, and you’ll have access to community message boards to discuss your course and the topics being raised within it. We’ve even set up community boards embedded into each of the course modules so you can have discussions with your tutor and classmates on the topics you’re currently learning. Online learning students resident in the UK can apply for a Maintenance Loan if they cannot attend their course in person because of a disability. Please find more information on our fees and funding page . If you're a student from Scotland, Wales, or Northern Ireland you can find information on Living Cost Loans from your student finance body. Learn more about online learning Introducing your Digital Backpack Once you’ve enrolled on your CertHE course with Arden you’ll get access to your Digital Backpack, a toolkit of digital resources we’ve put together to help you succeed during your time studying with us. Here are some of the digital resources you’ll have available from day one of your course: Office 365 subscription We set you up with a subscription to Microsoft Office 365 during your studies, completely free of charge, helping you create and manage your coursework and assignments in one handy cloud location. Zoom video conferencing Zoom is integrated into our online learning platform, ilearn. This makes it seamless to attend lectures from any location and on any device. Career services through Arden Futures Careers support available through Arden Futures, your careers platform, to help you throughout your career journey whether you are a Career Starter, Changer or Developer. Library Portal Free online access to our Library Portal, which includes thousands of eBooks and journals, as well as industry databases which we’ve carefully hand-picked to support your studies – all yours for free while you study with us. Togetherall mental health support All Arden University students have access to mental health support from Togetherall, which includes free online welfare services, as well as advice for students and well-being support. To discover more about the resources available in our Digital Backpack, click here . Entry requirements At Arden University we consider applications on a case by case basis. If you have significant work experience, have qualifications you have gained elsewhere, or a degree or qualification that isn't a clear pathway to this degree - we are more than happy to discuss your application. Eligibility Level 5 Diploma HE Health and Care Management Passes in two subjects at GCE A Level or equivalent, plus passes at grade C or above in three subjects at GCSE level or equivalent. If you can’t fulfil these requirements, we will also consider applications that demonstrate significant skills and responsibility in a health and/or care role. English proficiency For students whose English is not their first language, IELTS 6.0 (no less than 5.5 in any element); or TOEFL iBT 80; or equivalent. We’ll give you all the support you need to succeed. Then, when you graduate from the CertHE course, you'll be able to progress on to the rest of the degree course if you decide it’s right for you. To find out more about the CertHE, click here . Course fees and funding Find your country I am a student from Please select ... Meet the faculty Dr. Stephanie West joined Arden University in November 2020 and is the Head of the School of School of Leadership & Service Industry Management. In addition to her wealth of healthcare industry experience, Stephanie has held a number of Senior Academic and Leadership positions in Health, Social Care and Applied Science faculties at a variety of universities across the UK. Stephanie will provide leadership to the School of School of Leadership & Service Industry Management, ensuring that it delivers high quality academic provision and student satisfaction across all courses. Professor Stephanie West Head of School - School of Leadership & Service Industry Management Career prospects The Level 5 DipHE Health and Care Management provides you with a solid foundation in health and social care and sets the stage for joining the profession or continuing your studies. You’ll also have the chance to progress to our BSc (Hons) Health and Care Management . Related Courses BSc (Hons) Health and Care Management BSc (Hons) Health and Care Management (Top-Up) BSc (Hons) Health and Care Management with Foundation Year Related Articles Health and Social Care Articles Career Advice What can I do after Arden University? With a Level 5 Diploma HE Health and Care Management under your belt, you could work in the National Health Service (NHS), the vast social care sector, with a private healthcare provider, or for a voluntary or not-for-profit organization. We have a dedicated careers and employability team that will support you during your studies to achieve your career ambitions. Just some of the roles you might want to consider include: Health service management Social care management Registered Manager roles Health promotion and education Public health initiatives Industry skills Chartered Management Institute (CMI) This course awards a CMI Level 5 Certificate in Management & Leadership* The Chartered Management Institute (CMI) promotes excellence in UK management and leadership. As the CMI possesses a Royal Charter, they are the only organisation in the UK that can award Chartered Manager status to their members – the gold standard in management. With 140,000 members, the institute aims to boost career development across the management sector and connect like-minded professionals. As an Arden student, you’ll have free CMI Membership throughout your studies, giving you access to a range of additional resources including a mentoring service and invitations to networking events both online and offline. Upon completion of this CMI-accredited course, you will be awarded CMI Level 5 Certificate in Management & Leadership.This recognises you have the skills needed to be an effective manager, helping you stand out from the competition and start your management career journey - with a CMI qualification and a clear pathway to full Chartered Manager status. *Upon completion of your course, the CMI award and level of chartered status awarded will depend on your level and length of study, whether you entered your course with Recognition for Prior Learning (RPL) or if any compensation is applied on your modules throughout the duration of study. If this criteria applies to you, you may receive one of the 2 different levels; an Award or Certificate. Institute of Health & Social Care Management (IHSCM) This course is endorsed by the Institute of Health & Social Care Management , whose aim is to create a supportive professional body that is relevant in its activities and modern in its approach and that holds sector leaders in the NHS, social care, third sector and private healthcare amongst its members. The IHSCM works with Arden University to contribute to curriculum development and delivery. As an Arden student, you’ll become a student member of the Institute, giving you access to a diverse range of events, conferences, workshops and networks as well as opportunities for mentoring and coaching. You are also encouraged to apply for full membership of the Institute once you graduate from the course. Education for everyone, everywhere Whether you're constrained by location, cost, time, or other life commitments, we're passionate about giving you access to higher education that fits into your busy, modern life. You decide how and where to study We offer a wide range of flexible undergraduate and postgraduate degrees in both our online and blended study modes. Full support both online and on-site We're also proud to offer non-standard entry, meaning your work experience and previous qualifications are taken into account when assessing your application. Strong focus on employability You will gain in-depth subject knowledge and transferable skills that employers from a huge range of industries will value. Many of our courses at Arden are also accredited by leading professional bodies in the UK. Course Overview The BEng (Hons) Digital Engineering prepares you to use digital technology to improve how products and industrial processes are designed, tested and manufactured. You will develop practical skills in programming, digital design, materials science, data simulation and automation. Developed with Google Cloud, this programme combines Google's industry expertise with Arden's academic experience. You will develop core digital engineering skills alongside AI knowledge and tools, learning how technology can support your studies and future career. You’ll have access to Google Gemini Enterprise throughout your degree, which will help you study course content in different formats, from revision notes and audio overviews to visual summaries. You will also work with AI simulations that reflect contemporary engineering projects and working processes. These practical scenarios give you experience in digital twin modelling, process automation, predictive maintenance and more. You will have the chance to: Develop digital engineering skills , covering CAD design, materials performance, programming and automated manufacturing. Learn through Google Cloud co-development , connecting your studies with current technology and industry practice. Work with agentic AI simulations , using digital tools to solve engineering and manufacturing challenges. Personalise your learning using Gemini Enterprise to support your studies and work at your own pace. Build workplace skills , including data-driven decision-making, problem-solving and project management. Learn more Course details and modules Engineering and manufacturing are increasingly using digital design tools and AI to improve processes and efficiency. This course helps you develop the technical and digital skills employers are looking for. Throughout the course, you will learn to evaluate products, analyse operational data and improve manufacturing processes. You will also gain practical experience through projects developed with Google Cloud. By combining academic learning with practical digital engineering experience, you will build the knowledge, skills and confidence to prepare for a career in modern engineering and manufacturing. Modules Foundation Year available CREATE (30 credits) Fundamentals of Software Development (30 credits) Applied Tech Concepts (30 credits) Skills for University Study (30 credits) Level 4 Professional Digital Practice (Employability) (30 credits) Programming for Digital Professionals (30 credits) Simulating Material Behaviour (30 credits) Computer Aided Design and Design Practice (30 credits) Level 5 Applied Professional Skills: Automated Workflows (30 credits) Applied Data Intelligence (30 credits) Materials and Manufacturing (30 credits) Advanced Design Simulation & Material Performance (30 credits) Level 6 Arden Impact Module: Design Engineering (30 credits) Future Design: AI Tools, Creativity & Critical Evaluation (30 credits) Sustainable Design & Lifecycle Engineering (30 credits) Applied Simulation & Digital Prototyping (30 credits) How do we assess you? Assessment is designed to help you apply your learning to real-world engineering challenges. You could complete practical, industry-focused assessments including design and modelling projects, simulations, technical reports, presentations and projects. This gives you the flexibility to play to your strengths while developing practical communication, problem-solving, digital and professional skills. Study options This course is available to study through Arden’s blended learning study mode at our campuses in London Ealing , London Stratford , London Holborn , Manchester , Birmingham , Leeds , Newcastle , and Nottingham . The course is also available to students via online learning . This gives you the convenience of being able to study from anywhere in the UK or worldwide, providing you with the same high standards of teaching but with lower tuition fees. Blended learning How does it work? When you choose our blended learning study mode, each week you’ll have eight hours of timetabled classes spread over two days at the Arden campus of your choice. This is combined with around 25 hours of independent study, which takes place through ilearn, our university campus in the cloud. ilearn contains all the resources you need to study successfully. As a blended learning student you’ll also have access to our Library Portal, an extensive digital library with thousands of journal titles, eBooks, and a range of academic and industry databases that you can use to research and gain in-depth information on your area of study. At Arden, all of your course materials are provided free of charge, removing the need for you to buy expensive textbooks to study your degree successfully. Blended learning is the best option for students who prefer the structure of regular face to face classes with their tutor and fellow classmates, and is particularly suited to students who live within commuting or driving distance of one of our UK campuses. If you're a student from England who is enrolling on a blended learning course with Arden (based in one of our UK campuses) then you can apply for a Tuition Fee Loan and Maintenance Loan to help pay for your living expenses. You can find more information on our fees and funding page . If you're a student from Scotland, Wales or Northern Ireland you can find information about obtaining a student loan to cover your costs from your student finance body. Learn more about blended learning Part time online learning How does it work? Studying the BA (Hons) Business Management online gives you the ultimate in convenience. You can enrol with Arden from anywhere in the world and study your degree from the comfort of home, without the requirement to attend classes in a physical location. Our online students study their degree through iLearn, Arden’s university campus in the cloud.  iLearn provides everything you need to study at University. It offers an integrated virtual learning experience, including your virtual classroom, lecture theatre, and access to our Library Portal. The portal includes an extensive digital library including thousands of journal titles, eBooks, and academic and industry databases which you can use to research your assignments and projects. All of these materials are provided to you free of charge, and contain all the research information you’ll need to complete your degree with us. iLearn is also integrated with Zoom, making it easier to chat with your course tutor during your scheduled seminar sessions. You can even integrate our study materials into your Kindle, making it possible to study wherever you have you Kindle handy. Studying online does not mean studying alone. As well as receiving regular feedback and guidance from your course tutor, you will be studying with likeminded students who you can meet with through our Unitu community, and you will have access to community message boards to discuss your course and the topics being raised within it. We have even set up community boards embedded into each of the course modules so you can have discussions with your tutor and classmates on the topics you are currently learning. Online learning students resident in the UK can apply for a Maintenance Loan if they cannot attend their course in person because of a disability. Please find more information on our fees and funding page . If you're a student from Scotland, Wales or Northern Ireland you can find information on Living Cost Loans from your student finance body. Meet the faculty A future-facing faculty preparing graduates for an AI-enabled world Hello, I’m Professor John Parkinson, Dean of the Faculty of Social Sciences & Technology (FoSST) at Arden University. I joined Arden after twenty-five years of research, teaching, and leadership in UK higher education. Throughout my career, I have been driven by a passion for understanding human behaviour and creating learning environments that help people thrive. My academic career has centred on behavioural science, human motivation, applied research, and public policy. Beyond academia, I am a qualified counsellor and a strong advocate for student-centred, future-focused education. These experiences have shown me how quickly society shifts — and how vital it is that education keeps pace. At Arden, we are committed to ensuring that every student encounters an AI-infused curriculum, develops the literacies needed to thrive in data-rich workplaces, and learns to apply technology ethically and insightfully to real-world challenges. Throughout the Faculty, we have a deep commitment to applied, interdisciplinary learning, preparing students for the complexities of an evolving world. Across psychology, computing and data science, criminology, law, and the social sciences, our faculty brings together disciplines that are all being reshaped by artificial intelligence and rapid technological change. With the university’s new investment and strategic focus on digital transformation, our mission is clear: to prepare graduates who can harness the power of AI responsibly, creatively, and confidently. We champion interdisciplinary thinking because the future will demand nothing less. Whatever programme you study, you will experience learning that is flexible, applied, technology-enabled, and grounded in strong academic foundations. Our goal is to not only help you succeed academically, but to ensure you graduate ready for the emerging AI-augmented professions of the future — resilient, skilled, and able to make a positive impact on society. Welcome to the Faculty of Social Sciences & Technology. I look forward to supporting you as we build this ambitious, future-ready community together. Education for everyone, everywhere Whether you're constrained by location, cost, time, or other life commitments, we're passionate about giving you access to higher education that fits into your busy, modern life. You decide how and where to study We offer a wide range of flexible undergraduate and postgraduate degrees in both our online and blended study modes. Full support both online and on-site We're also proud to offer non-standard entry, meaning your work experience and previous qualifications are taken into account when assessing your application. Strong focus on employability You will gain in-depth subject knowledge and transferable skills that employers from a huge range of industries will value. Many of our courses at Arden are also accredited by leading professional bodies in the UK. Course Overview The BEng (Hons) AI Systems Design Engineering develops the skills you need to design, model and improve intelligent engineering systems. You will build practical knowledge in programming, digital design, data, simulation and prototyping, helping you solve complex design challenges. Developed with input from Google Cloud, this programme combines engineering principles with practical AI skills. You will learn how AI can be used in systems design, while also developing the digital skills needed to support your own studies and future career. You will have access to Google Gemini Enterprise throughout your degree. Gemini Enterprise can help you work with complex course content by creating revision notes, audio overviews and visual summaries to support your learning. You will also work with AI simulations that reflect challenging engineering projects and contemporary working processes. These practical activities will give you experience in automated process design, system testing digital prototyping, and more. You will have the chance to: Develop systems design skills: Build knowledge across AI programming, digital prototyping, system modelling and data analytics. Learn with Google Cloud: Explore AI tools and approaches relevant to modern engineering systems. Apply AI through simulations: Use intelligent design solutions to tackle practical engineering challenges. Use Gemini Enterprise in your studies: Adapt course content to support your learning needs and pace. Explore human-centred technology: Develop the critical thinking needed to consider how emerging systems affect people and society. Course subject to validation Foundation Year available Quick tools Explore your brochure Download the course brochure to take a look at your course modules and syllabus content. Download brochure Speak to an advisor Want to speak to one of our subject experts? Our advisors are ready to answer your questions! Click below to get started. Show me how Career development resources You'll have online access to a huge range of career development tools from the day you start studying. Learn more Course details and modules AI is changing how engineering systems are designed, tested and operated. This course helps you develop the technical and analytical skills needed to understand these systems and apply AI to practical design challenges. Throughout the course, you will learn to analyse problems, automate processes and make informed design decisions. You will develop your skills through practical projects, simulations and engineering activities. Projects developed with Google Cloud will give you opportunities to apply what you learn, building practical experience in systems design, AI and engineering that can support your future career. Modules Foundation Year available CREATE (30 credits) Fundamentals of Software Development (30 credits) Applied Tech Concepts (30 credits) Skills for University Study (30 credits) Level 4 Professional Digital Practice (Employability) (30 credits) Programming for Digital Professionals (30 credits) Simulating Material Behaviour (30 credits) Computer Aided Design and Design Practice (30 credits) Level 5 Applied Professional Skills: Automated Workflows (30 credits) Applied Data Intelligence (30 credits) Thinking in Systems: AI Enhanced Design (30 credits) Advanced Design Simulation & Material Performance (30 credits) Level 6 Arden Impact Module: Design Engineering (30 credits) Future Design: AI Tools, Creativity & Critical Evaluation (30 credits) Rise of the Machines: Human-Tech Interface (30 credits) Applied Simulation & Digital Prototyping (30 credits) How do we assess you? Assessment is designed to help you apply your learning to real-world systems engineering challenges. You could complete practical, industry-focused assessments including design and modelling projects, simulations, technical reports, presentations and projects. This gives you the flexibility to play to your strengths while developing practical communication, problem-solving, digital and professional skills. Study options This course is available to study through Arden’s blended learning study mode at our campuses in London Ealing , London Stratford , London Holborn , Manchester , Birmingham , Leeds , Newcastle , and Nottingham . The course is also available to students via online learning . This gives you the convenience of being able to study from anywhere in the UK or worldwide, providing you with the same high standards of teaching but with lower tuition fees. Blended learning How does it work? When you choose our blended learning study mode, each week you’ll have eight hours of timetabled classes spread over two days at the Arden campus of your choice. This is combined with around 25 hours of independent study, which takes place through ilearn, our university campus in the cloud. ilearn contains all the resources you need to study successfully. As a blended learning student you’ll also have access to our Library Portal, an extensive digital library with thousands of journal titles, eBooks, and a range of academic and industry databases that you can use to research and gain in-depth information on your area of study. At Arden, all of your course materials are provided free of charge, removing the need for you to buy expensive textbooks to study your degree successfully. Blended learning is the best option for students who prefer the structure of regular face to face classes with their tutor and fellow classmates, and is particularly suited to students who live within commuting or driving distance of one of our UK campuses. If you're a student from England who is enrolling on a blended learning course with Arden (based in one of our UK campuses) then you can apply for a Tuition Fee Loan and Maintenance Loan to help pay for your living expenses. You can find more information on our fees and funding page . If you're a student from Scotland, Wales or Northern Ireland you can find information about obtaining a student loan to cover your costs from your student finance body. Learn more about blended learning Part time online learning How does it work? Studying the BA (Hons) Business Management online gives you the ultimate in convenience. You can enrol with Arden from anywhere in the world and study your degree from the comfort of home, without the requirement to attend classes in a physical location. Our online students study their degree through iLearn, Arden’s university campus in the cloud.  iLearn provides everything you need to study at University. It offers an integrated virtual learning experience, including your virtual classroom, lecture theatre, and access to our Library Portal. The portal includes an extensive digital library including thousands of journal titles, eBooks, and academic and industry databases which you can use to research your assignments and projects. All of these materials are provided to you free of charge, and contain all the research information you’ll need to complete your degree with us. iLearn is also integrated with Zoom, making it easier to chat with your course tutor during your scheduled seminar sessions. You can even integrate our study materials into your Kindle, making it possible to study wherever you have you Kindle handy. Studying online does not mean studying alone. As well as receiving regular feedback and guidance from your course tutor, you will be studying with likeminded students who you can meet with through our Unitu community, and you will have access to community message boards to discuss your course and the topics being raised within it. We have even set up community boards embedded into each of the course modules so you can have discussions with your tutor and classmates on the topics you are currently learning. Online learning students resident in the UK can apply for a Maintenance Loan if they cannot attend their course in person because of a disability. Please find more information on our fees and funding page . If you're a student from Scotland, Wales or Northern Ireland you can find information on Living Cost Loans from your student finance body. Learn more about online learning Entry requirements At Arden University we consider applications on a case by case basis. If you have significant work experience, have qualifications you have gained elsewhere, or a degree or qualification that isn't a clear pathway to this degree - we are more than happy to discuss your application. Eligibility To be able to study this course, we need to see that you have: Two subjects at GCE A level or equivalent, plus passes at grade C or above in three subjects at GCSE level or equivalent We’re happy to consider an application from you if you can show us that you have the motivation and at least two years of work relevant experience to study this degree. We’ll ask you for a personal statement that demonstrates your ability to study the course, along with references and evidence of your previous work experience. If you don’t meet the entry requirements an additional Foundation Year might be right for you: A minimum of 45 credits at Level 3 completed within the last 3 years, or equivalent. Applicants may be considered based on a minimum of 2 years of appropriate professional work experience evidenced with a CV and Reference if they do not meet the qualification requirements. English Proficiency IELTS 6.0 (no less than 5.5 in any element); or TOEFL iBT 80; or equivalent We’ll ask you for a personal statement that demonstrates your ability to study the course. We may also want references and evidence of relevant experiences. Course fees and funding Find your country I am a student from Please select ... Meet the faculty A future-facing faculty preparing graduates for an AI-enabled world Hello, I’m Professor John Parkinson, Dean of the Faculty of Social Sciences & Technology (FoSST) at Arden University. I joined Arden after twenty-five years of research, teaching, and leadership in UK higher education. Throughout my career, I have been driven by a passion for understanding human behaviour and creating learning environments that help people thrive. My academic career has centred on behavioural science, human motivation, applied research, and public policy. Beyond academia, I am a qualified counsellor and a strong advocate for student-centred, future-focused education. These experiences have shown me how quickly society shifts — and how vital it is that education keeps pace. At Arden, we are committed to ensuring that every student encounters an AI-infused curriculum, develops the literacies needed to thrive in data-rich workplaces, and learns to apply technology ethically and insightfully to real-world challenges. Throughout the Faculty, we have a deep commitment to applied, interdisciplinary learning, preparing students for the complexities of an evolving world. Across psychology, computing and data science, criminology, law, and the social sciences, our faculty brings together disciplines that are all being reshaped by artificial intelligence and rapid technological change. With the university’s new investment and strategic focus on digital transformation, our mission is clear: to prepare graduates who can harness the power of AI responsibly, creatively, and confidently. We champion interdisciplinary thinking because the future will demand nothing less. Whatever programme you study, you will experience learning that is flexible, applied, technology-enabled, and grounded in strong academic foundations. Our goal is to not only help you succeed academically, but to ensure you graduate ready for the emerging AI-augmented professions of the future — resilient, skilled, and able to make a positive impact on society. Welcome to the Faculty of Social Sciences & Technology. I look forward to supporting you as we build this ambitious, future-ready community together. Professor John Parkinson, PhD, PGDip, FHEA Dean of the Faculty of Social Sciences & Technology Career prospects In a collaboration with Google Cloud, we’ve created brand-new, future-focused degree programmes. Designed with Google Cloud experts, these courses bridge the gap between higher education and cutting-edge tech industry demands, helping you build skills for a successful career across engineering, manufacturing, product development, design and digital technology. A New Partnership in AI Education | Arden University & Google Cloud related courses BSc (Hons) Applied AI Engineering BSc (Hons) Data Science and AI BEng (Hons) Digital Engineering Apply AI and systems skills across growing industries The combination of AI, systems engineering, digital design, data and simulation can prepare you for opportunities across technology, engineering, manufacturing and digital industries. What will BEng (Hons) AI Systems Engineering do for me? Turn AI and digital technologies into practical solutions During the course, you’ll learn how artificial intelligence can be applied to real-world systems and design challenges. You’ll build your programming knowledge and explore how code, AI and automated workflows can be used to solve complex problems and improve processes, as well as confidence in digital design, modelling and simulation skills, using virtual testing and digital prototyping to explore, evaluate and refine solutions before implementation - with Google Cloud’s world-leading technical expertise. What can I do after Arden University? Take your skills into AI, engineering and emerging technology Your degree will give you a broad technical foundation to support progression into AI, systems engineering, digital engineering, design, simulation, data and automation roles in industries increasingly using AI, automation and intelligent technologies. Your skills could prepare you for roles such as: AI Engineer Machine Learning Engineer AI Application Engineer Data Engineer Big Data Engineer Software Engineer AI Solutions Architect AI Product Manager AI Technology Consultant AI Governance and Responsible AI Specialist AI Safety and Assurance Engineer Cloud Data Engineer AI Transformation Lead Agentic AI Engineer The skills you develop can be applied across sectors including technology, engineering, manufacturing, automotive, aerospace and energy, as well as other industries adopting AI and digital systems. Education for everyone, everywhere Whether you're constrained by location, cost, time, or other life commitments, we're passionate about giving you access to higher education that fits into your busy, modern life. You decide how and where to study We offer a wide range of flexible undergraduate and postgraduate degrees in both our online and blended study modes. Full support both online and on-site We're also proud to offer non-standard entry, meaning your work experience and previous qualifications are taken into account when assessing your application. Strong focus on employability You will gain in-depth subject knowledge and transferable skills that employers from a huge range of industries will value. Many of our courses at Arden are also accredited by leading professional bodies in the UK. Course Overview The BSc (Hons) Applied AI Engineering develops the technical skills you need to design, build and deploy AI solutions. You will progress from foundational programming and data analytics to machine learning, generative AI and scalable big data systems. A number of course modules on this programme have been developed with Google Cloud, giving you the opportunity to learn through content shaped by current technology practice. You will build your engineering knowledge alongside practical AI skills, including how AI can support your own studies and future work. You will have access to Google Gemini Enterprise throughout your degree. Gemini Enterprise can help you work with course content by creating revision notes, audio overviews and visual summaries to support your learning. You will also work with AI simulations that reflect engineering projects and up-to-date working processes. These practical activities will give you experience with large language models, autonomous systems, enterprise data pipelines and more. You will have the chance to: Develop AI engineering skills: Build knowledge across machine learning, generative AI, big data architecture and agentic systems. Learn from Google Cloud content: Explore technologies and approaches used in modern AI engineering. Work with agentic AI simulations: Apply your skills to practical problems involving secure and scalable AI solutions. Use Gemini Enterprise in your studies: Adapt course content into formats that support your learning needs and pace. Build responsible AI systems: Develop your understanding of data governance, system reliability and ethical AI. Course subject to validation Foundation Year available Quick tools Explore your brochure Download the course brochure to take a look at your course modules and syllabus content. Download brochure Speak to an advisor Want to speak to one of our subject experts? Our advisors are ready to answer your questions! Click below to get started. Show me how Career development resources You'll have online access to a huge range of career development tools from the day you start studying. Learn more Course details and modules As organisations continue to adopt AI, there is growing demand for people who can design, build and manage reliable AI systems. This course develops the technical knowledge and practical skills needed to work with AI across a range of applications. You will build your skills progressively, from programming and data analytics through to advanced AI engineering. Along the way, you will apply what you learn through practical projects and simulations developed with Google Cloud. By the end of the course, you will have developed a strong foundation in AI engineering, with practical experience that can support your future career in AI and technology. Modules Foundation Year available CREATE (30 credits) Fundamentals of Software Development (30 credits) Applied Tech Concepts (30 credits) Skills for University Study (30 credits) Level 4 Professional Practice (Employability) (30 credits) Build your First Intelligent System (30 credits) Programming for Digital Professionals (30 credits) Applied Data Analytics and AI (30 credits) Level 5 Core modules Applied Professional Skills (Automated Workflows) (30 credits) Machine Learning in Production (30 credits) Gen AI and LLM Applications (30 credits) Optional modules Applied Data Intelligence (30 credits) Database Systems and SQL (30 credits) Cloud Infrastructure and Services (30 credits) Level 6 Core modules Arden Impact Module (30 credits) Agentic AI & Autonomous Systems (30 credits) Advanced Gen AI & Tech Leadership (30 credits) Optional modules Applied AI (30 credits) Big Data Engineering (30 credits) Secure System Engineering (30 credits) How do we assess you? Assessment on this degree reflects the complexity of real-world engineering, AI and industry practice. You’ll encounter a range of assessment methods designed to help you develop both technical knowledge and practical skills. These may include practical projects, portfolios, case studies, presentations, technical assessments, coding and data analysis tasks, AI solution development, and system design and testing. Study options This course is available to study through Arden’s blended learning study mode at our campuses in London Ealing , London Stratford , London Holborn , Manchester , Birmingham , Leeds , Newcastle , and Nottingham . The course is also available to students via online learning . This gives you the convenience of being able to study from anywhere in the UK or worldwide, providing you with the same high standards of teaching but with lower tuition fees. Blended learning How does it work? When you choose our blended learning study mode, each week you’ll have eight hours of timetabled classes spread over two days at the Arden campus of your choice. This is combined with around 25 hours of independent study, which takes place through ilearn, our university campus in the cloud. ilearn contains all the resources you need to study successfully. As a blended learning student you’ll also have access to our Library Portal, an extensive digital library with thousands of journal titles, eBooks, and a range of academic and industry databases that you can use to research and gain in-depth information on your area of study. At Arden, all of your course materials are provided free of charge, removing the need for you to buy expensive textbooks to study your degree successfully. Blended learning is the best option for students who prefer the structure of regular face to face classes with their tutor and fellow classmates, and is particularly suited to students who live within commuting or driving distance of one of our UK campuses. If you're a student from England who is enrolling on a blended learning course with Arden (based in one of our UK campuses) then you can apply for a Tuition Fee Loan and Maintenance Loan to help pay for your living expenses. You can find more information on our fees and funding page . If you're a student from Scotland, Wales or Northern Ireland you can find information about obtaining a student loan to cover your costs from your student finance body. Learn more about blended learning Part time online learning How does it work? Studying the BA (Hons) Business Management online gives you the ultimate in convenience. You can enrol with Arden from anywhere in the world and study your degree from the comfort of home, without the requirement to attend classes in a physical location. Our online students study their degree through iLearn, Arden’s university campus in the cloud.  iLearn provides everything you need to study at University. It offers an integrated virtual learning experience, including your virtual classroom, lecture theatre, and access to our Library Portal. The portal includes an extensive digital library including thousands of journal titles, eBooks, and academic and industry databases which you can use to research your assignments and projects. All of these materials are provided to you free of charge, and contain all the research information you’ll need to complete your degree with us. iLearn is also integrated with Zoom, making it easier to chat with your course tutor during your scheduled seminar sessions. You can even integrate our study materials into your Kindle, making it possible to study wherever you have you Kindle handy. Studying online does not mean studying alone. As well as receiving regular feedback and guidance from your course tutor, you will be studying with likeminded students who you can meet with through our Unitu community, and you will have access to community message boards to discuss your course and the topics being raised within it. We have even set up community boards embedded into each of the course modules so you can have discussions with your tutor and classmates on the topics you are currently learning. Online learning students resident in the UK can apply for a Maintenance Loan if they cannot attend their course in person because of a disability. Please find more information on our fees and funding page . If you're a student from Scotland, Wales or Northern Ireland you can find information on Living Cost Loans from your student finance body. Learn more about online learning Entry requirements At Arden University we consider applications on a case by case basis. If you have significant work experience, have qualifications you have gained elsewhere, or a degree or qualification that isn't a clear pathway to this degree - we are more than happy to discuss your application. Eligibility To be able to study this course, we need to see that you have: Two subjects at GCE A level or equivalent, plus passes at grade C or above in three subjects at GCSE level or equivalent We’re happy to consider an application from you if you can show us that you have the motivation and at least two years of work relevant experience to study this degree. We’ll ask you for a personal statement that demonstrates your ability to study the course, along with references and evidence of your previous work experience. If you don’t meet the entry requirements an additional Foundation Year might be right for you: A minimum of 45 credits at Level 3 completed within the last 3 years, or equivalent. Applicants may be considered based on a minimum of 2 years of appropriate professional work experience evidenced with a CV and Reference if they do not meet the qualification requirements. English Proficiency IELTS 6.0 (no less than 5.5 in any element); or TOEFL iBT 80; or equivalent We’ll ask you for a personal statement that demonstrates your ability to study the course. We may also want references and evidence of relevant experiences. Course fees and funding Find your country I am a student from Please select ... Meet the faculty A future-facing faculty preparing graduates for an AI-enabled world Hello, I’m Professor John Parkinson, Dean of the Faculty of Social Sciences & Technology (FoSST) at Arden University. I joined Arden after twenty-five years of research, teaching, and leadership in UK higher education. Throughout my career, I have been driven by a passion for understanding human behaviour and creating learning environments that help people thrive. My academic career has centred on behavioural science, human motivation, applied research, and public policy. Beyond academia, I am a qualified counsellor and a strong advocate for student-centred, future-focused education. These experiences have shown me how quickly society shifts — and how vital it is that education keeps pace. At Arden, we are committed to ensuring that every student encounters an AI-infused curriculum, develops the literacies needed to thrive in data-rich workplaces, and learns to apply technology ethically and insightfully to real-world challenges. Throughout the Faculty, we have a deep commitment to applied, interdisciplinary learning, preparing students for the complexities of an evolving world. Across psychology, computing and data science, criminology, law, and the social sciences, our faculty brings together disciplines that are all being reshaped by artificial intelligence and rapid technological change. With the university’s new investment and strategic focus on digital transformation, our mission is clear: to prepare graduates who can harness the power of AI responsibly, creatively, and confidently. We champion interdisciplinary thinking because the future will demand nothing less. Whatever programme you study, you will experience learning that is flexible, applied, technology-enabled, and grounded in strong academic foundations. Our goal is to not only help you succeed academically, but to ensure you graduate ready for the emerging AI-augmented professions of the future — resilient, skilled, and able to make a positive impact on society. Welcome to the Faculty of Social Sciences & Technology. I look forward to supporting you as we build this ambitious, future-ready community together. Professor John Parkinson, PhD, PGDip, FHEA Dean of the Faculty of Social Sciences & Technology Career prospects In a collaboration with Google Cloud, we’ve created brand-new, future-focused degree programmes. Designed with Google Cloud experts, these courses bridge the gap between higher education and cutting-edge tech industry demands, helping you build skills for a successful career across engineering, manufacturing, product development, design and digital technology. A New Partnership in AI Education | Arden University & Google Cloud related courses BEng (Hons) Digital Engineering BEng (Hons) AI Systems Design Engineering What will the BSc (Hons) Applied AI Engineering do for me? This degree is designed to help you develop technical and professional skills that can be applied across AI, data, software and technology roles. Students will learn to understand how to build AI and data systems that are scalable, secure, reliable and responsible – developing practical problem-solving skills and exploring how AI solutions can be designed and implemented in different organisational settings. You will graduate having worked with industry-relevant AI technologies and applied your knowledge to practical problems, building experience that can support your transition into the workplace. What can I do after Arden University? This degree can bring opportunities to explore across AI, data, software, cloud technology and digital transformation. You will also have tackled challenges that reflect real organisational needs and demonstrate your technical and problem-solving abilities, with practical projects and proof-of-concept work. Depending on your experience and the career path you choose, potential roles could include: AI Engineer Machine Learning Engineer AI Application Engineer Data Engineer Big Data Engineer Software Engineer AI Solutions Architect AI Product Manager AI Technology Consultant AI Governance and Responsible AI Specialist AI Safety and Assurance Engineer Cloud Data Engineer Technical Product Lead AI Transformation Lead Agentic AI Engineer Industry skills Future-defining degrees, developed with Google Cloud Designed with Google Cloud experts, our created brand-new, future-focused degree programmes bridge the gap between higher education and cutting-edge tech industry demands covering cyber security, data science, AI systems engineering, applied AI in business management, and more. Education for everyone, everywhere Whether you're constrained by location, cost, time, or other life commitments, we're passionate about giving you access to higher education that fits into your busy, modern life. You decide how and where to study We offer a wide range of flexible undergraduate and postgraduate degrees in both our online and blended study modes. Full support both online and on-site We're also proud to offer non-standard entry, meaning your work experience and previous qualifications are taken into account when assessing your application. Strong focus on employability You will gain in-depth subject knowledge and transferable skills that employers from a huge range of industries will value. Many of our courses at Arden are also accredited by leading professional bodies in the UK. Course Overview We’ve designed this course to provide the forward-facing skills required in today’s evolving accounting and finance sector. You’ll gain an in-depth understanding of key areas in the field, including the role and scope of technology in the sector—such as FinTech and accounting software. You’ll also develop the ability to make sound investment decisions. Throughout the course, you’ll have the opportunity to put your learning into practice, helping you gain real-world skills to use in your future role. This course is accredited by the Association of Chartered Certified Accountants (ACCA), the world’s largest global professional accountancy body. This means your course content is fully aligned with the first two stages of the ACCA qualification to maximise your potential exemptions. When you graduate—provided you have passed the required modules—you’ll be eligible for up to nine exemptions from ACCA*. With these exemptions, it’s possible to become an ACCA-qualified accountant within two years of graduation. Our program is aligned with the standards of a leading professional body, preparing you to pursue qualifications from CIMA. This means you’ll be well equipped to progress along this pathway and take the next step in your professional journey. Graduates may also be eligible for exemptions, which are assessed directly by CIMA. In addition, the degree is recognised as a valid entry criterion for the Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) programme, meaning you’ll be eligible to apply for the CFA upon graduation. We have also partnered with Moody's to give you access to a wealth of financial data. Using this alongside advanced statistical software will give you the opportunity to make real-world financial decisions using live data, ensuring that you’re well-versed in modern finance before you even graduate. *All exemptions from ACCA are conditional upon passing the relevant exams at Arden University. The professional body does not award exemptions based on a compensated pass for a module that is specified as a requirement for exemption from an ACCA exam. However, many of our students complete the course in 3-6 years Level 4 Introduction to Business Economics (20 credits) Introduction to Finance (20 credits) Financial Accounting (20 credits) Introduction to Management Accounting (20 credits) Quantitative Methods for Accounting and Finance (20 credits) Introduction to Financial Technology (20 credits) Level 5 Financial Reporting (20 credits) Financial Markets and Institutions (20 credits) Performance Management (20 credits) Corporate and Business Law (20 credits) Security Analysis and Valuation (20 credits) Applied Research Skills (20 credits) Level 6 Corporate Financial Management (20 credits) International Finance (20 credits) Taxation (20 credits) Audit and Assurance (20 credits) Investment and Portfolio Management (20 credits) Financial Management Project (20 credits) How do we assess you? You’ll be assessed in a variety of ways throughout your degree. As the course complies with ACCA requirements, some modules are assessed by exams, which may provide exemptions from ACCA qualifications. It is also aligned with the knowledge and skills expected by CIMA, helping to prepare you for further qualifications while ensuring you gain practical, career-ready skills beyond exams. Other methods of assessment may include: Assignments Board presentations Consultancy projects Management of individual equity portfolio (low risk + momentum shares) Client reports Investor/broker memo Real knowledge transfer company projects Study options This course is available to study through Arden’s blended learning study mode at our study centres in London Tower Hill, London Holborn, Manchester, Leeds, and Birmingham. The course is also available to students via online learning . This gives you the convenience of being able to study from anywhere in the UK or worldwide, providing you with the same high standards of teaching but with lower tuition fees. It’s a great way to study if you’re looking for flexibility. It was challenging to balance a full-time job with my degree but once I was in a routine, it was much easier to manage everything. Online learning has actually helped me become very good with time management and given me the ability to prioritise tasks. Toby Bradley BA (Hons) Business & Accountancy Full-time blended learning How does it work? When you choose our blended learning study mode, each week you’ll have eight hours of timetabled classes spread over two days at the Arden study centre of your choice. This is combined with around 25 hours of independent study, which takes place through iLearn, our university campus in the cloud. iLearn contains all the resources you need to study successfully. As a blended learning student, you’ll also have access to our Library Portal, an extensive digital library with thousands of journal titles, eBooks, and a range of academic and industry databases that you can use to research and gain in-depth information on your area of study. At Arden, all of your course materials are provided free of charge, removing the need for you to buy expensive textbooks to study your degree successfully. Blended learning is the best option for students who prefer the structure of regular face-to-face classes with their tutor and fellow classmates, and is particularly suited to students who live within commuting distance of one of our UK study centres. If you're a student from England who is enrolling on a blended learning course with Arden (based in one of our UK study centres), then you can apply for a Tuition Fee Loan and Maintenance Loan to help pay for your living expenses. You can find more information on our Fees and Funding page. If you're a student from Scotland, Wales, or Northern Ireland, you can find information about obtaining a student loan to cover your costs from your student finance body. Learn more about blended learning Part-time online learning How does it work? Studying this course online gives you the ultimate in convenience. You can enrol with Arden from anywhere in the world and study your degree from the comfort of home, without the requirement to attend classes in a physical location. Our online students study their degree through iLearn, Arden’s university campus in the cloud. iLearn provides everything you need to study at university. It offers an integrated virtual learning experience, including your virtual classroom and lecture theatre, as well as access to our Library Portal. The portal includes an extensive digital library with thousands of journal titles, eBooks, and academic and industry databases that you can use to support your coursework. All of these materials are provided to you free of charge and include everything you’ll need to complete your degree successfully. iLearn is also integrated with Zoom, making it easier to chat with your course tutor during your scheduled seminar sessions. You can even integrate our study materials into your Kindle, making it possible to study wherever you have your Kindle handy. Studying online doesn’t mean studying alone. As well as receiving regular feedback and guidance from your course tutor, you’ll be studying with like-minded students who you can meet through our Unitu community, and you’ll have access to community message boards to discuss your course and the topics being raised within it. We’ve even set up community boards embedded into each of the course modules so you can have discussions with your tutor and classmates on the topics you’re currently learning. Online learning students living in the UK can apply for a Tuition Fee Loan to pay for their course. If you cannot attend your course in person because of a disability, you may also be entitled to a Maintenance Loan to cover living expenses. Please find more information on our Fees and Funding page. If you're a student from Scotland, Wales, or Northern Ireland, you can find information about obtaining a student loan to cover your costs from your student finance body. If you have significant work experience, have qualifications you have gained elsewhere, or a degree or qualification that isn't a clear pathway to this degree - we are more than happy to discuss your application. Eligibility Our BSc (Hons) Accounting and Finance degree has standard entry requirements. To be able to study this course, we need to see that you have: GCSE Grade C in Mathematics , or equivalent. Two subjects at GCE A-Level or equivalent, plus passes at grade C or above in three subjects at GCSE level or equivalent; OR If you don’t currently hold the above qualifications, we also offer this course with an additional foundation year , which is designed for students who need extra support when starting their degree course. We also accept applications from those with relevant work experience and recognised Accounting/Finance professional qualifications. English Proficiency IELTS 6.0 (no less than 5.5 in any element); or TOEFL iBT 80; or equivalent We are happy to consider an application from you if you can show us you have the motivation to study this degree. We’ll ask you for a personal statement that demonstrates your ability to study the course. We may also want references and evidence of relevant experience. Meet the faculty Hassaan Khan brings 15 years of experience as a senior academic in higher education. Hassaan studied accounting and finance at the University of Kent, followed by an MSc and PhD in Finance from Durham University. Prior to joining Arden, he was associate dean at the Global Banking School, looking after the finance and business management degrees. Hassaan was director of programmes at BPP University where he was responsible for degrees in finance and applied management as well as professional courses and degree apprenticeships in accountancy. Dr. Hassaan Khan Head of School - School of Management and Executive Education Career prospects This course has been created by experienced finance and accounting professionals to ensure that you gain the knowledge you’ll need to find secure employment after graduation. We aim to prepare you with universal skills that employers from a variety of organisations will value, so you’ll graduate feeling confident to decide where your future career lies. BSc (Hons) Accounting and Finance with Foundation Year BA (Hons) Business Management (Accounting & Finance) BA (Hons) Business (Finance) (Top-Up) Accounting and Finance Articles Career Advice What can an accounting and finance degree do for me? By mastering the fundamentals of accounting and finance, you will be able to demonstrate your value to employers. Important key skills you can develop with this undergraduate course include: Gaining in-depth knowledge of modern business and finance with real-world applications. Becoming prepared for Industry 4.0 by understanding the role and scope of technology in accounting and finance, including fintech, blockchain, and AI. Understanding the sector from a strategic, management, and investment perspective, covering international finance, financial technology, and management. Using advanced computer software to analyse financial data and make robust forecasts, including SPSS and STATA. Writing and interpreting financial statements, and monitoring, controlling, and planning for the ongoing success of an organisation. Gaining experience in commonly used industry practices, including consultancy reports, investor memos, and management of equity portfolios. What can I do after Arden University? As a graduate of this accounting and finance degree, you’ll be prepared to enter a variety of roles across any sector, anywhere in the world. Candidates with a solid foundation in accounting and finance are highly valued by employers, opening up a variety of potential career paths, such as: Financial Analyst Tax Advisor Auditor Financial Accountant Management Accountant Forensic Accountant Treasury Manager Financial Planner Industry skills The Chartered Institute of Management Accountants (CIMA) The Chartered Institute of Management Accountants (CIMA) is one of the most globally respected organisations in professional accountancy. Our course is closely aligned with the knowledge and skills expected by CIMA, helping to prepare you for further study with the institute. Graduates can apply directly to CIMA after completing this degree, and may be able to claim exemptions, which are assessed by CIMA. The Chartered Financial Analyst Institute (CFA) The CFA Institute is a global association of investment professionals that awards the CFA designation to candidates who successfully complete Levels I, II, and III of the CFA programme. Our course e is recognised as a valid entry criterion for the CFA programme. This means that upon graduation, you’ll be eligible to apply for CFA and begin working towards one of the most respected qualifications in global investment and financial management. Association of Chartered Certified Accountants (ACCA) The Association of Chartered Certified Accountants (ACCA) is a globally recognised professional accountancy body with a diverse community of over 252,500 members and 526,000 future members in 180 countries. This course is fully accredited by ACCA, which means you can gain up to 9 exemptions from ACCA exams — leaving you with just 4 papers to complete. At Arden, our BSc Accounting and Finance is awarded the maximum of nine ACCA exemptions. This means that students who go on to study ACCA after graduation will start their studies at the appropriate level, studying only four ACCA papers out of the standard 13 that make up the ACCA qualification. Moody's (an affiliate of Moody's Analytics) You’ll have access to Bureau van Dijk throughout your studies. Bureau van Dijk is a leading publisher of business information specialising in private company data combined with software for research and analysis. It’s the world’s most powerful comparable data resource on private companies, with information on more than 400 million companies across the globe and 41 million of these including detailed financial information. Through this, you’ll be able to gain a holistic overview of different companies and how data can be used for better decision-making and increased efficiency. You can use the database to explore areas such as credit risk, compliance and financial crime, corporate finance, business development and strategy, and much more. Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business (AACSB) membership. Arden University is a member of the prestigious Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business (AACSB). AACSB International is a global association of leaders in education and business dedicated to supporting and advancing quality business education worldwide. This membership reflects the fact that Arden University has successfully matched the high standards required by the AACSB, and enables the sharing of ideas and the exchange best practises between global business schools. Membership also gives our faculty members access to in-depth data and research to support the development of our courses and teaching methods, ensuring that we are able to provide you with the best possible university experience. Business Graduates Association (BGA) The BGA is a membership and quality assurance body. As a member, Arden University have signed up to the BGA Charter, committing their institution to responsible management practices and lifelong learning, positively impacting their students, communities, and the economy. This shows our students that we are demonstrating responsible management ourselves, as well as it being a central theme that runs through our own courses. As Arden University is a member of the Business Graduates Association (BGA), students will receive complementary BGA student and graduate membership. Through this membership, current students will have access to the BGA Career Development Centre, packed with interactive tools, e-learning content, partner discounts and the latest job opportunities. This is a lifetime access, which means students will continue to have access to these services even after they graduate.
